# Digital Marketing Specialist III

Rheem Manufacturing Company

[Atlanta, GA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Atlanta%2C-GA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8668697212661470058?p=1&pos=0&rgn=10460&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4784750448452578160&crId=US_0US_0)

Job-ID: 4290Category: Marketing & Product ManagementLocation: Atlanta, GA, United StatesSchedule: Full time, DayPosted: 2026-08-13Travel: Up to 10%Worker Category: OnsiteResults-driven Senior Digital Marketing Specialist with 5+ years of experience leading integrated marketing initiatives across digital and print channels. Expertise in managing complex, cross-functional marketing projects, including websites, digital tools, email campaigns, and sales enablement materials. Skilled in aligning brand messaging with customer experience, executing digital roadmap initiatives, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. Adept at collaborating with engineering, sales, operations, agencies, and vendors to support product launches and ongoing marketing communications in fast-paced environments.This position will support Rheem North America and our HTPG Division, located in Lawrenceville, GA.QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.5+ years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, and social media management.Expertise in social media platforms, trends, and management tools (e.g., Hootsuite, Sprout Social).Adobe Creative Suite (i.e. Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)Email Marketing & Survey Platforms (i.e. mailchimp)Proficiency in Microsoft Office SuiteStrong proficiency in video production and editing software (i.e. Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro).Demonstrated ability to work and maintain good judgment in fast-paced environments while managing workload and priorities.Strong project management skills (i.e. Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, etc.)Basic HTML/CSS knowledge (WordPress, CMS platforms) and analytics (Google Analytics)Familiarity with print production processes and fulfillment logistics.Must possess and demonstrate proficiency in the following competency areas: ethics/Integrity, accountability, adaptability, flexibility, dependability, teamwork (collaborative teaming skills), interpersonal skills, organizational skills, attention to detail, written and verbal communication.As a leader at Rheem, how you achieve results is as important as the results you achieve. While LEADING OTHERS, you will be expected to demonstrate the following competencies and behaviors:Aligning Performance for SuccessApplying Business KnowledgeBuilding TalentBuilding Trusting RelationshipsCommunicating with ImpactCustomer-OrientationDelegating TasksExecuting/Leading the TeamFacilitating ChangeFostering Relationships/Emotional IntelligenceInfluencingProblem Solving & Decision MakingSupporting InnovationEquivalent combination of education, experience, and skills may supplement above minimum job requirements.#LI-Onsite#LI-JH1ResponsibilitiesDigital Strategy, Project & Platform ManagementLead development and execution of digital marketing initiatives aligned with division objectives, including social media, websites, customer portals, quoting tools, and digital product resources.Develop comprehensive project timelines, scope documentation, and workflow plans for digital and print marketing projects.Manage cross-functional project execution across marketing, product management, engineering, sales, IT, operations, and external agencies to ensure seamless integration and on-time delivery.Track milestones and proactively mitigate risks to maintain quality and efficiency.Manage enhancements and ongoing maintenance of division websites, information databases, and customer-facing digital tools.Monitor website/social communications and maintain digital content databases to ensure current, compliant, and optimized content.Measure effectiveness of digital tools and campaigns using performance data and customer feedback.Provide recommendations for process improvements, content optimization, and digital enhancements to improve user experience and ROI.Campaign & Sales Enablement SupportDevelop and execute email marketing and social media initiatives to promote new products, brand messaging, and services.Coordinate digital sponsorship assets and marketing deliverables for industry tradeshows, conferences, and internal/external events.Align digital and print marketing initiatives to support integrated campaign performance.Oversee development, production, and maintenance of technically accurate marketing publications, including specification sheets, bulletins, manuals, operating instructions, consumer literature, and sales materials.Ensure brand consistency and technical accuracy by collaborating with subject-matter experts and engineering teams.Support product launches through coordinated release of digital and print collateral.Review activities of print suppliers and external agencies to ensure project timelines and quality standards are met.Serve as primary liaison between internal stakeholders and outside partners to maintain alignment on deliverables.About the company
At Rheem, we engineer products for life. For home life. For work life. For the life of the planet we all share. Backed by over 100 years of expertise, we’re passionate about product innovation and boldly committed to sustainability. Our full line of global air and water solutions deliver reliable performance, comfort and energy savings for residential and commercial applications worldwide. From engineers to accountants, sales professionals to support experts, Rheem depends on people to power our innovations. Join Rheem and help shape the future of products that impact lives—every day.

**Our Behavior Based Values set us apart:**
Listening to Understand – Open mind, learning from others, accepting feedback, embracing the objectiveContributing Respectfully - Sharing opinions, valuing ideas, sharing opposing perspectives with respectThinking Creatively – Applying creativity, seeking improvements, understanding from the customers’ lensActing with Responsibility – Owning decisions and actions, acting with integrity, embracing accountability
Rheem is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Rheem encourages all qualified candidates to apply, including those of any race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. The job description above has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Equivalent combination of education, experience, and skills may supplement above minimum job requirements.

For U.S. Based jobs, please note that Rheem is unable to hire candidates to be employed in the following states: Alaska, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Idaho, Mississippi, Montana, New Mexico, North Dakota, or Vermont.

Rheem and its subsidiaries do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee.

# Senior Digital Marketing Specialist for Department of Development

UTHealth Houston

[Houston, TX](https://jooble.org/jobs/Houston%2C-TX)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-409060874333284297?p=1&pos=0&rgn=46481&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7466509258057819745&crId=US_0US_0)

UTHealth Houston is seeking a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist to join the Alumni Engagement team and lead digital communication and engagement initiatives that strengthen connections between alumni and the university. This role is responsible for managing alumni email communications, coordinating virtual events and livestreams, and leveraging digital engagement platforms to enhance the alumni experience and increase participation in programs, events, and volunteer opportunities.The successful candidate will combine strong communication skills, technical proficiency, and data-driven decision-making to create meaningful digital experiences for alumni audiences. This position plays a key role in executing engagement strategies through platforms such as Constant Contact, ThankView, digital class books, virtual event and webinar technologies, and alumni engagement systems.Experience working in any sector with a content management system is required, and experience working with cloud-based CRM and online giving platforms is considered a plus. Basic knowledge of CRM or SQL databases is helpful. Digital and web writing skills are desirable as this person may also produce content.Key Responsibilities Include: • Lead marketing and outreach efforts for in-person, virtual, and hybrid programs, including promotion, registration, attendee communications, livestream support, and post-event engagement strategies. Serve as the primary point of contact for alumni virtual programming and continuing education opportunities, ensuring a seamless and engaging participant experience.• Manage and optimize alumni-focused digital platforms, including ThankView, digital yearbooks, webinar and virtual event platforms, continuing education programs, and other engagement tools that enhance alumni connectivity and participation.• Coordinate and execute alumni-focused email communications that promote events, volunteer opportunities, alumni awards, and school-specific programs to drive engagement, volunteerism, and participation.• Collaborate with Development Communications and Public Affairs to ensure alumni engagement priorities are incorporated into broader communication strategies while identifying and cultivating compelling alumni stories, testimonials, and content opportunities that can support institutional storytelling efforts.• Utilize data and engagement metrics to inform strategy, improve outreach effectiveness, and identify innovative approaches that strengthen alumni relationships, increase participation, and enhance the overall alumni experience.What we do here changes the world. UTHealth Houston is Texas’s resource for healthcare education, innovation, scientific discovery, and excellence in patient care. That’s where you come in.Once you join us, you won't want to leave. It’s because we reward our team for the excellent service they provide. Our total rewards package includes the benefits you’d expect from a top healthcare organization (benefits, insurance, etc.), plus: 100% paid medical premiums for our full-time employees Generous time off (holidays, preventative leave day, both vacation and sick time – all of which equate to around 37-38 days per year) The longer you stay, the more vacation you’ll accrue! Longevity Pay (Monthly payments after two years of service) Build your future with our awesome retirement/pension plan! We take care of our employees! As a world-renowned institution, we consider our employees’ wellbeing is important. We offer work/life services such as... Free financial and legal counseling Free mental health counseling services Gym membership discounts and access to wellness programs Other employee discounts, including entertainment, car rentals, cell phones, etc. Resources for child and elder care Plus many more! Position Summary:Responsible for leading the strategic branding, development, and execution of digital marketing campaigns, SEO/SEM, content creation, and email marketing to promote UTHealth Houston. Responsible for ensuring the messaging is clear, concise, and delivered within established timelines.Position Key Accountabilities:Plans and executes digital and direct response marketing campaigns on social media, banner ads, email marketing, video marketing, and the web content management system.Analyzes and tracks reporting models in digital marketing and generates monthly reports on all campaigns.Collaborates with internal stakeholders and marketing team members to advance projects and maintain a positive image of the university.Generates and syncs digital directory listings on various internet platforms such as Google My Business, YELP, Healthgrades, etc.Utilizes Google Analytics for measuring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), reporting, etc.Customizes email marketing campaigns and pay-per-click ads to meet the needs of the customer and to enhance the image of the university.Enforces brand standards and creates customized digital ads that conform to the university's standards.Responds promptly and courteously to all internal customers and external vendors.Assists with content management and maintenance.Ensures all protocol is followed for patient privacy in any promotional material.Crafts Search Engine Optimization (SEO) content for use on external website and digital marketing advertisements.Acquires insight into online marketing trends and keeps strategies up-to-date.Supports department-based goals to contribute to the success of the university.Maintains confidentiality per HIPAA guidelines regarding patient information.Trains other Marketing team members on digital marketing methodologies, landscape, and trends.Must be available after hours and on the weekends for certain events.Performs other duties as assigned.Minimum Education:Bachelor's Degree in Digital Marketing or a related field requiredMinimum Experience:At least 5 years of related work experience in digital marketing is required. Demonstrated experience using Google Ads and Facebook Ad Manager required. Experience in the healthcare field preferredPhysical Requirements:Exerts up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 10 pounds frequently and/or a negligible amount constantly to move objects.Security Sensitive:This position is a security-sensitive position pursuant to Texas Education Code §51.215 and Texas Government Code §411.094. To the extent that a position requires the holder to research, work on, or have access to critical infrastructure as defined in Texas Business and Commerce Code §117.001(2), the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the infrastructure is a minimum qualification to be hired for and to continue to be employed in that position. Personnel in such positions, and similarly situated state contractors, will be routinely reviewed to determine whether things such as criminal history or continuous connections to the government or political apparatus of a foreign adversary might prevent the applicant, employee, or contractor from being able to maintain the security or integrity of the infrastructure. A foreign adversary is a nation listed in 15 C.F.R. §791.4.Residency Requirement:Employees must permanently reside and work in the State of Texas.Job SummaryJob number: 260001UVProfession: Administration

# Senior Paid Search Manager - Ecommerce

$100,000 per day

Full-time

Mirasma

[San Diego, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Diego%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3821812718088400153?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7416&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3299070209248762627&crId=US_0US_0)

About the job

Paid Search Manager – Ecommerce – Mirasma

Department: Paid Media / Client Strategy

Type: Full-Time

Position Overview

The Senior Paid Search Manager will be responsible for executing, managing, and optimizing paid media campaigns across Google Ads platforms, including Search, YouTube, Performance Max, and Display. This role focuses on high-quality execution within a performance-driven environment, translating strategic direction into scalable campaigns that drive measurable results.The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Google Ads for ecommerce brands, understands direct-response marketing, and is highly analytical in optimizing performance. While overall strategy is guided by the Digital Strategist, the Paid Search Manager is expected to think critically, identify optimization opportunities, and contribute insights that improve account performance.

Key Responsibilities

- Campaign Execution & OptimizationBuild, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, YouTube, Performance Max, and Display
- Execute campaign structures and bidding strategies aligned with performance goals
- Continuously optimize campaigns to improve CPA, ROAS, conversion volume, and efficiency
- Monitor daily performance and make proactive adjustments
- Maintain strong account structure and direct-response best practices

Performance Monitoring & Analysis

- Track key performance metrics and identify trends, anomalies, or risks
- Analyze data to uncover optimization opportunities and improve efficiency
- Maintain organized campaign structures, naming conventions, and documentation
- Escalate performance issues or technical blockers when necessary

Full-Funnel Awareness

- Understand how paid traffic interacts with landing pages, funnels, and offers
- Collaborate with creative, CRO, and funnel teams to align performance
- Provide feedback based on user behavior and campaign data
- Support structured testing and experimentation initiatives

Creative Testing & Optimization

- Execute creative testing strategies based on performance insights
- Rotate creatives, formats, and messaging to prevent fatigue
- Provide data-backed feedback on winning concepts and angles
- Ensure all assets meet platform policies and guidelines

Team Collaboration & Execution

- Work closely with strategists and internal teams to execute campaign roadmaps
- Participate in performance reviews and optimization discussions
- Maintain clear communication and task management within ClickUp
- Take ownership of assigned accounts and ensure consistent execution

Qualifications

- 2–4+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns
- Strong experience working with eCommerce brands
- Deep understanding of direct-response marketing and performance optimization
- Familiarity with Search, YouTube, Performance Max, and Display campaigns
- Strong analytical mindset with ability to translate data into action
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively
- Strong attention to detail and organization
- Google Ads certifications are a plus

What Success Looks Like

- Consistent execution of structured, high-performing campaigns
- Ongoing improvements in CPA, ROAS, and conversion volume
- Clean, scalable account structures that support growth
- Strong collaboration with internal teams to drive results
- Reliable ownership and accountability across accounts

What’s the Company Like?

Mirasma is a performance-driven growth agency specializing in Google and YouTube advertising for ecommerce brands. We don’t just run ads, we build complete acquisition systems including funnels, creatives, and conversion strategies designed to scale. Our team manages over $11M in monthly ad spend and has scaled multiple brands past $100K/day in revenue through Google and YouTube. We operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment focused on real performance and measurable growth.

What We Offer

- Hybrid flexibility
- High-performance, growth-focused environment
- Opportunity to work with top ecommerce brands
- Direct collaboration with experienced strategists and leadership
- Clear ownership and impact on account performance
- Fast-paced team with strong systems and structure

Compensation: $85,000–$120,000 annually

Final compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.

Benefits: Full-time W-2 employees are eligible for company-sponsored medical coverage, with Mirasma covering 100% of the employee-only premium. # Senior Performance Marketing Manager

Chess.com

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6858371267900854222?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=618357254162654470&crId=US_0US_0)

About Us
Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.
We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!
We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.
About You
First off, you love to play chess and want to help others discover that same joy.
Secondly, you have extensive experience running paid acquisition for a consumer app or subscription business. You've built that experience the hard way: testing channels, defending budget with rigor, and proving out what's actually incremental. You're comfortable being the person in the room who insists on a clean incrementality test before anyone scales spend.
Finally, you have the operator's instinct for performance marketing. You move fast between channels, creative, and data. You know when a metric is telling you something real versus noise, and you can turn a promising early signal into a durable, scalable channel. You have the expertise to grow and own a budget into the 8-9 figures, while having the judgment and integrity to say when spend is getting inefficient and should be pulled back.
What you'll do
Own and scale a performance marketing engine with real momentum. The foundations are already in place and working. App Store and Android Ads are running highly efficiently, and Meta and YouTube video are proving out as channels with a clear path to target. You'll take full ownership of this portfolio and drive the acceleration and scale that comes next.
Set the bar for measurement rigor. Build out best-in-class incrementality testing, saturation modeling, and 7-day ROAS and LTV frameworks. We should always know precisely what our spend is buying us, so we can confidently push harder where it's working.
Scale creative production. Partner with our content and partnerships teams to bring best practices from other UGC agencies to ensure high ROAS on a hybrid creator + performance strategy. Build the testing infrastructure to find winners fast.
Optimize through DSPs and AdTech partners. Manage and grow our relationships with partners like LiftOff, AdFuel, and Eyeo to squeeze more performance out of every channel.
Shape our long-term investment strategy. Partner with leadership to translate channel performance into LTV- and ROI-backed budget plans. Grow spend where the returns support it, and have the judgment to pull back or reallocate spend the moment efficiency slips, so every dollar keeps working for the business.
Operate in public. As a globally remote company spanning many time zones, async Slack communication is how decisions get made. Work out loud in channels: share results and reasoning transparently, flag what's working and what isn't, and pull in the right people by name to keep things moving.
Manage the operational details. Own budgets, vendor contracts, and ad account setup across platforms (Meta, Google, App Store, DSPs). Keep attribution and tracking (AppsFlyer and friends) clean and trustworthy.
Build close ties with our social media and growth teams. Stay plugged into what's happening across the chess calendar and the broader business: tournaments, viral moments, product launches, seasonal swings. Read when we're heading into a boom (or viral moment) versus a quiet stretch, and flex spend accordingly between defensive, standard, and aggressive postures.
Required Skills
5+ years in performance marketing or paid user acquisition. You have a track record of taking a channel from test to scale, and the judgment to know when to hold, cut, or reallocate spend as efficiency changes.
Real experience with incrementality testing, saturation analysis, and LTV/ROAS modeling. You don't just report on these metrics. You know how to build and defend them.
Hands-on channel expertise across Meta, Google/App Store Ads, YouTube, and DSP/AdTech platforms, plus fluency with mobile attribution tools like AppsFlyer.
Creative taste maker , familiar with content and social media trends
High-velocity written communicator. You communicate clearly and concisely at speed, operate primarily in writing, and can move between tactical channel optimization and board-level ROI conversations in the same day.
Preferred Skills
Background in gaming, subscription, or other high-engagement consumer apps, ideally with millions of daily users.
Experience scaling creative production through UGC agencies, creator marketplaces, or an in-house creator network.
A track record of syncing paid spend with organic demand cycles. You tie budget decisions to product launches, seasonal moments, or community/viral events rather than running a flat, always-on plan.
Experience discussing budget and ROI cases with executive leadership or a board.
About the Opportunity
This is a full-time opportunity
We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!)
This role is open to candidates who can work with significant overlap with both United States Eastern and Pacific time zones.

# Senior Paid Social Manager

Sage Intacct

[Atlanta, GA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Atlanta%2C-GA)

Job TitleSenior Paid Social Manager
Job DescriptionPaid social is one of the most important ways B2B buyers discover, evaluate, and engage with software brands before they ever speak with Sales. At Sage, we’re looking for a Senior Paid Social Media Manager to own how paid social supports demand generation, pipeline, and revenue across North America.

This role sits within the Performance Media team and is focused on strategy, planning, execution, testing, optimization, and performance measurement across paid social channels. You will lead paid social programs across platforms such as LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, and emerging channels, with a clear focus on reaching the right audiences, improving creative performance, and driving high-quality leads, sales-qualified opportunities, pipeline, and return on investment.

This is a hands-on performance marketing role for someone who understands that strong paid social is not just media buying. It requires audience strategy, creative testing, platform fluency, data analysis, agency management, and close partnership across Brand, Organic Social, Creative, Performance Marketing, Product Marketing, BDR/SDR, agency, and platform teams.

You will use performance data, platform insights, creative learnings, and AI tools to improve how Sage plans, tests, scales, and measures paid social across North America.

Location Requirement: Hybrid 3 days per week from our Atlanta office (Ponce City Market)

Minimum Qualifications

- At least 5+ years of experience in B2B paid social marketing within B2B SaaS/tech
- Hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns across major platforms such as LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, or similar channels.
- Background owning paid social strategy, audience planning, creative testing, optimization, and performance measurement.
- Experience managing agencies, platform partners, campaign budgets, timelines, and performance expectations.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect paid social performance to lead quality, sales-qualified opportunities, pipeline, revenue, and return on investment.
- Experience partnering cross-functionally with Brand, Creative, Organic Social, Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Sales Development, agencies, or platform teams.
- Experience using AI tools to improve marketing effectiveness, creative variation, testing, optimization, reporting, or workflow efficiency.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to own initiatives, make recommendations, and drive execution with minimal direction.
- Experience working directly with social platform representatives and agency partners.
- Experience testing new social platforms, formats, audiences, creative approaches, or campaign structures.

Who is Sage?
Sage helps small and medium-sized businesses succeed with AI-powered accounting, finance, ERP, payroll and HR software. Knowing that over 6+ million of our global customers depend on our solutions, motivates us to keep innovating so they keep growing with confidence.

Why Join Sage

- Own paid social strategy for North America in a role tied directly to lead quality, pipeline, revenue, and return on investment.
- Work on more than media execution by shaping audience strategy, creative testing, platform experimentation, optimization, and performance insights.
- Partner with Brand, Creative, Organic Social, Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Sales Development, agencies, and platform teams to build social programs that are connected across the buyer journey.
- Use AI in practical ways to improve creative development, campaign testing, optimization, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
- Join a global B2B SaaS company where paid social is treated as a measurable growth channel, not just a brand awareness tactic.

Key Responsibilities• Own and execute Sage’s paid social strategy across North America, including LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, and emerging social platforms.

- Develop paid social channel plans, audience strategies, creative testing roadmaps, and optimization plans that support lead generation, pipeline, and revenue goals.
- Manage paid social campaign execution from planning through launch, testing, optimization, reporting, and performance improvement.
- Partner with Brand and Creative teams to develop and optimize paid social creative, messaging, formats, and content.
- Collaborate with Organic Social to create a more connected paid and organic social approach across priority campaigns and audiences.
- Work directly with agency and platform partners to plan, execute, optimize, and scale paid social campaigns.
- Use performance data to refine campaigns, identify opportunities, and improve marketing-qualified leads, sales-qualified opportunities, pipeline contribution, and return on investment.
- Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to improve creative development, testing, optimization, reporting, and campaign performance.
- Stay current on social platforms, audience behavior, creative best practices, platform changes, and emerging paid social opportunities.
- Communicate performance insights, recommendations, risks, and decisions needed to internal stakeholders and agency partners.

Benefits? We have plenty.

- Competitive annual bonuses (20%)
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
- 401(k) retirement match (100% matching up to 4%)
- 32 days paid time off (22 personal days & 10 national holidays)
- 18 weeks of paid parental leave (offered 1 year after the start date)
- Work Away Program: Opportunity to work & play for 10 weeks from another country (Sage-approved list)
- Sage Foundation: 5 days paid yearly to volunteer
- $5,250 tuition reimbursement per calendar year starting 6 months after the hire date
- Sage Wellness Rewards Program ($600 wellness credit and $360 fitness reimbursement annually)

Why Join Us? At OPF, we foster a dynamic and inclusive company culture that emphasizes collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. Our team is composed of passionate, driven individuals who are committed to making a difference. Here's what you can expect when you join our team:
Innovative Environment: Work with cutting-edge technology and be part of a team that is constantly pushing the boundaries of fintech.
Professional Growth: We invest in our employees' growth with continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and career advancement paths.
Supportive Culture: Enjoy a supportive and inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your contributions make a real impact.
Community Focus: Be part of a company that understands the importance of small and mid-sized businesses to their communities and the nation’s financial health.
High-Performing Team: Join a team of badasses who are committed to excellence and are integral to our company's expansion and success.
About the role: We are expanding our marketing analytics function and leveling up what it can do, and this is the hands-on analytical seat on it. You will report to Analytics leadership and work alongside our data science and analytics team. Your job is the analysis: what each channel, campaign, and creative is really delivering, where businesses fall out of our funnel and why, and which spend brings us the kind of small business we can fund and grow with.
That last part is what makes this different from most marketing analyst roles. We are a lender, so a lead is not the finish line here. Your work runs through to whether that business got an offer, took it, and stayed with us, so you are measuring quality, not just volume.
We are a very AI-forward company and expect our analysts to work that way, leaning on modern AI and LLM tooling to make their analysis faster and sharper. We want high-performing people who see the whole picture and make everyone around them better.
Responsibilities: Own the recurring read on paid performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, and email, down to campaign, ad set, and creative, and increasingly on cost per funded deal and return on ad spend rather than cost per lead alone.
Analyze the full acquisition funnel, from ad click through to funded deal. Find where we lose people, quantify what it costs, and say what should change.
Build the quality metrics, not just the volume ones, so we can tell a channel that sends a lot of businesses from one that sends fundable ones.
Design and read tests (creative, landing page, audience, geo holdouts) honestly, and be clear when a difference is a real effect versus a difference in who the channel reached.
Help shape and quality-check our marketing data foundation: the tagging, attribution, and data model, including reconciling spend and validating the joins between marketing activity, leads, and funded deals.
Build dashboards and reporting that marketing and executives genuinely run on, and present findings in plain language with a clear recommendation.
Qualifications: 4 to 7 years in marketing analytics, growth analytics, performance marketing, or digital media measurement.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (economics, statistics, mathematics, business or marketing analytics, computer science, or similar).
Strong SQL and working Python with pandas. You query the warehouse yourself and do the analysis in notebooks or scripts, not a pivot table.
Hands-on experience with paid digital platforms, Meta and Google Ads in particular, and practical fluency with UTM tagging and conversion tracking.
Web and product analytics experience (GA4 or comparable): event tracking and step-level funnel analysis.
Experiment literacy: you can design an A/B or geo test, read it honestly, and explain why a result might not mean what it appears to.
Real data-quality instinct. You reconcile before you report and flag a suspicious number rather than shipping it. Strong visualization and communication with non-technical stakeholders.
Experience in lending, fintech, insurance, subscription, or another business with a long funnel and a qualification gate between the lead and the revenue (a strong plus).
Experience with dbt, cloud data environments (AWS), and modern AI tooling (LLMs, agents) on your own data (a plus)

##### Senior Paid Media Manager

Location: Denver, Colorado; Exton, Pennsylvania (Hybrid); or the Boston area.

Position Summary:

Bentley is seeking a highly strategic Senior Paid Media Manager to join our growing global marketing team. In this dynamic role, you will be instrumental in shaping our paid media strategy across search, social, and display channels while working cross-functionally with key business units to design, launch, and optimize cohesive, full-funnel marketing campaigns.

This role is ideal for a proactive marketer who enjoys both strategic planning and hands-on execution with a strong focus on data. You will partner closely with team leadership to adapt to evolving business priorities, while serving as a supportive mentor to help elevate and guide junior team members. If you thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy finding clarity and strategic opportunities within complex data, and are passionate about driving team success, we would love to talk with you!

Responsibilities:

Strategy & Budget Allocation

- Lead paid media strategy development, budget allocation, and comprehensive financial reconciliation across platforms and business units.

Campaign Execution & Testing

- Strategize, launch, and manage full-funnel marketing campaigns across search, social, and display.
- Implement robust testing frameworks to continuously optimize campaign performance and efficiency.

Analytics & Reporting

- Oversee comprehensive data synthesis, build performance dashboards, and develop advanced attribution models.
- Manage regular campaign reporting and turn ambiguous data into actionable, strategic insights for leadership.

Cross-Functional Project Management

- Act as a project manager for paid media initiatives, working seamlessly with internal teams to roll out campaigns for key business units.

Leadership & Mentorship

- Partner closely with the Paid Media Director and team leadership to support high-level objectives.
- Provide crucial support, mentorship, and guidance to junior team members to ensure the overall team's success.

Requires sitting or standing at will while performing work on a computer (or any other physical requirements). The role requires communication with managers, peers, and other colleagues of the company in person (on occasion), and by utilizing Microsoft Teams chat, calling, and meeting functions.

Qualifications:

- Minimum 6-8 years of dedicated paid media experience managing campaigns across search, social, and display channels.
- Required Platform Expertise: Hands-on experience executing and optimizing campaigns within Google Ads, Microsoft (Bing) Ads, LinkedIn Business Manager, Meta Business Manager, DemandBase, and StackAdapt.
- Advanced Analytics & Reporting: Exceptional reporting and attribution experience. Ideal candidate is proficient in GA4, Looker (Data Studio), PowerBI, and possess advanced Excel skills to navigate and find clarity in ambiguous data.
- Preferred Tech Stack: Experience with Salesforce, Marketo, ClickUp, Optimizely, Intentsify, Swydo, G2, Lunio, and Opteo is highly preferred.
- Strong project management skills with a proven track record of working cross-functionally to launch integrated campaigns.
- Proven ability to act as a strategic partner to leadership, switching focuses rapidly without dropping the ball on core responsibilities.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship.

- Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
- An attractive salary and benefits package.
- Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
- Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
- A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
- Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world's infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

We are looking for a Senior Paid Media Manager with deep client-facing and local digital marketing experience to join our expanding team. You’ll directly manage search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across both Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube) and Microsoft Ads, making optimizations and updates daily. You will also support the team with Meta Ads campaigns. Your portfolio of clients will be a mix of local and SMBs that constantly challenge you with goals to maximize performance, reach, and customer acquisition across these channels. In addition to managing paid media execution, this role partners with our local marketing teams to oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile, Local Listings, Reputation Management, and organic Social Media programs — and serves as the client’s voice for those channels on monthly performance calls.

The Senior Paid Media Manager will report to the Director, Franchise Partnerships. The position will also work with our global support teams within AdMax Local. You should be able to work well as part of a distributed team and provide innovative solutions to the new problems and opportunities that arise every week. In addition, you should have the ability to function equally well independently and as part of a team, as well as the ability to adapt to the changing digital marketing landscape and the use of AI.

This remote role may require one in-person client event per year.

Plan, develop, and execute comprehensive paid media strategies to drive revenue, direct response, qualified leads, and new user acquisition for your book of clients
Utilize business acumen to work closely with client teams to identify and fully understand business needs, campaign performance objectives, and opportunities to grow relationships and client investments
Manage Search, Performance Max, Display, Social, Remarketing, and Video advertising campaigns within the native Google, Meta, and Microsoft platforms and the proprietary AdMax Local platform
Oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile/Local Listings, Reputation Management, and organic Social Media programs executed by specialized internal teams, ensuring on-time, on-brand, and on-strategy execution for every client (this role manages and quality-checks the work)
Confidently communicate strategy and campaign progress to clients through weekly calls and emails; Present and discuss organic/local SEO and AI Visibility performance on monthly client performance calls, translating concepts, deliverables, and results into clear business impact
Provide recommendations and execute strategies for ad copy, keyword opportunities, campaign structuring, targeting, creative, display network, and other facets of Google inventory
Integrate consumer and business insights into media to enhance targeting and tracking efforts
Optimize performance marketing campaigns to meet and exceed SEM and paid social campaign benchmarks through channel-specific levers utilizing industry best practices
Responsible for monthly reporting on campaign performance with a keen eye toward media optimization to ensure efficient and effective campaign execution
Responsible for tight management of paid media budget, providing timely management of platform setup, invoicing, and accruals
Manage the creative development process, including writing creative briefs, trafficking, creative insights, ensuring timely delivery, and alignment with client direction. Requires a solid understanding of the creative process and creative development best business practices.

7+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in SEM (Search, Display, Remarketing). 1+ years of Performance Max and Shopping experience.

Proven track record of successfully planning and executing Paid Search, Paid Social, Paid Display, and YouTube campaign management and optimizations at scale
Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis, attribution, ads implementation, and platform integration (Excel skills required)
Detail-oriented, able to build project plans and presentations with strategic input
A proactive mindset, strong work ethic, and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional leads and existing teams
Experience driving campaigns from concept through to execution, and performing post-campaign analysis
Experience with analytics/tracking tools: Google Analytics (Universal & GA4), SEMRush, Google Tag Manager, Meta Business Suite
Experience optimizing landing pages and performing A/B and multivariate testing
Experience leveraging AI to improve the quality of work output and turnaround time
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a professional business environment

# Senior Paid Media Manager

Pattern

[Lehi, UT](https://jooble.org/jobs/Lehi%2C-UT)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5589054830581340993?p=1&pos=0&rgn=48590&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=720373090036411662&crId=US_0US_0)

Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list.

Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern's ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces-including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email \[email protected\].

Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek's Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

**What is a day in the life of a Senior Paid Media Manager?**

- Set up and launch paid campaigns primarily across TikTok DTC and TikTok Shop, with additional support on Meta (Facebook/Instagram), aligned with brand objectives and target audiences.
- Develop and brief ad creatives (video assets, UGC-style content, copy, calls-to-action) built first for TikTok's platform, trends, and native formats - with Meta adaptations as needed.
- Optimize live campaigns to maximize ROI by adjusting targeting, creatives, bids, and placements across TikTok and Meta.
- Monitor daily performance metrics such as CPM, CPC, CPA, ROAS, and engagement rates at both the platform and account level.
- Conduct A/B testing on creatives, audiences, offers, and campaign structures - with a focus on TikTok's unique testing environment.
- Produce regular performance reports with insights and recommendations spanning TikTok Shop, TikTok DTC, and Meta.
- Coordinate with creative and content teams to maintain a constant pipeline of TikTok-native assets and Meta-ready formats.
- Stay ahead of TikTok platform updates, algorithm changes, new ad solutions, and shopping features, while keeping a working knowledge of Meta developments.
- Troubleshoot tracking, set up conversion events, and maintain pixel health across TikTok Pixel and Meta Pixel/CAPI.
- Manage budgets and pacing across channels to ensure campaigns stay within spend targets and hit efficiency goals.

**What will I need to thrive in this role?**

- Minimum 4-6 years' experience managing TikTok Ads campaigns; Meta experience is a plus but not the primary focus.
- Strong, hands-on knowledge of TikTok Ads Manager and TikTok Shop ad formats - In-Feed, Spark Ads, TopView, GMVmax, and more.
- Working familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and core formats
- In-depth knowledge of TikTok-specific audience targeting, bidding strategies, and campaign optimization; solid foundational understanding of the same on Meta.
- Creative mindset with an intuition for what performs natively on TikTok - short-form video, trending sounds, authentic storytelling.
- Familiarity with pixel setup, server-side tracking, and attribution best practices across TikTok and Meta
- Experience with budget management, pacing, and multi-channel reporting.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

**What does high performance look like?**

- TikTok campaigns - across both DTC and Shop - consistently achieve or exceed KPIs for ROAS, CPA, GMV, and engagement.
- Meta campaigns are managed efficiently and support broader brand performance goals.
- Proactive and timely execution of campaign launches, creative refreshes, and optimizations, particularly within TikTok's faster-moving environment.
- Data-driven recommendations surfaced regularly to internal teams and brand partners, with TikTok insights leading the narrative.
- Consistent adoption and testing of new TikTok ad formats, Shop features, and beta opportunities, with Meta learnings incorporated where relevant.

**What is my potential for career growth?**

At Pattern, we are committed to employee development and recognize high performance. In this role, you will develop deep expertise in TikTok's commerce and paid social ecosystem - one of the fastest-growing areas in digital marketing - while building well-rounded paid media experience through Meta. Advancement may include progression to senior management, a specialized TikTok Shop or Paid Social lead role, or cross-functional opportunities within Pattern. You will have access to professional development resources, mentorship, and regular feedback to help guide your path.

**What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?**

**First 30 days:** Learn Pattern's systems, platforms, and workflows. Get fully oriented across active TikTok and Meta campaigns, accounts, and reporting cadences. Build relationships with your team, creative partners, and brand contacts.

**First 60 days:** Take ownership of day-to-day campaign management, optimization, and reporting - with a focus on TikTok DTC and TikTok Shop. Contribute to creative briefs and begin making data-driven recommendations for improvement across channels.

**First 90 days:** Independently manage campaigns end-to-end, with TikTok as your primary channel and Meta as a strong secondary. Consistently deliver on KPIs, bring forward new ideas for TikTok strategy or platform features, and be recognized as a reliable partner by your peers and brand contacts.

**What is the team like?**

- You will work alongside other TikTok Shop and Paid Social managers and be supervised by the Associate Director, Paid Social & Creative Strategy, with mentorship from the Head of Accounts for TikTok Shop. This is a data-driven, results-oriented team with a strong TikTok-first mindset. Collaboration is built into the workflow - you'll regularly partner with creative, analytics, and account teams to drive results, and your ideas and input are actively encouraged.

**Sounds great! What's the company culture?**

- Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern's processes and outcomes.
- Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
- Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner's expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
- Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

**What is the hiring process?**

- Initial phone interview with Pattern's talent acquisition team
- Video interview with a hiring manager
- Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders
- Professional reference checks
- Executive review
- Offer

**How can I stand out as an applicant?**

- Discuss professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples
- Provide insights on how you can add value and be the best addition to the team
- Focus on mentioning how you would be partner obsessed at Pattern
- Share experience on any side projects related to data and analytics

**Why should I work at Pattern?**

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:

\- Unlimited PTO

\- Paid Holidays

\- Onsite Fitness Center

\- Company Paid Life Insurance

\- Casual Dress Code

\- Competitive Pay

\- Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

\- 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. # Senior Paid Media Manager

ROAST

[Phoenix, AZ](https://jooble.org/jobs/Phoenix%2C-AZ)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/9116653773992879587?p=1&pos=0&rgn=4605&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8218198853979851858&crId=US_0US_0)

ROAST is a multi-award-winning independent full-service media agency, founded in 2015. We proudly work with brands like Rightmove, Experian, and LEON, with one clear goal: to deliver better return on advertising spend (ROAS) than anyone else.
How do we do it? By combining both media intelligence and data science, along with constant experimentation, we create solutions that will drive the biggest impact.
But none of this works without exceptional people - which is why we put talent first, always. Training, progression, and opportunities to learn are baked into how we work. We want our people to feel happy, supported, and inspired.
Exceptional company culture isn’t an add-on at ROAST - it’s the engine. It powers everything: creativity, collaboration, retention, results. We’re proud of the culture we’ve built, because it’s authentic and intentional. Rooted in shared values, not just surface perks.
ROAST have created a place where people belong, grow, and do their best work - together.
The Role The Senior Paid Media Manager’s primary function is to support the day-to-day management and ongoing development of ROAST’s portfolio of paid media clients.
Bringing an in-depth knowledge of digital media platforms, including Search, Social and Programmatic, this role will be responsible for the daily contact and client strategy for US paid media clients.
The key output from the role will be working closely with UK based Account Managers with activation, strategy and planning for execution of high-performance media campaigns.
Separately, the role will also act as a support function for the launch of our US services, which will include a wide variety of tasks including office administration, new business, partner relationships and recruitment.
Responsibilities Paid Media Be the local representative of ROAST paid media for our US-based client set, attending client meetings, developing client relationships, responding to questions and queries.
Work closely with UK Senior Account Managers and Department Leads to ensure all accounts have a performance strategy.
Contribute to wider client planning workflows
Responding to briefs with the support of other ROAST media teams
Regular review and assessment of tools, partners and technologies that will help improve quality and effectiveness
Guide marketing strategies based on local knowledge of customer needs and US specific landscapes.
Collaborate with creative and content teams to ensure ad content is as relevant as possible for the market.
Lead day-to-day communication with US clients where required.
Future line management of junior staff as the team expands.
Growth & New Business Support the new business process for US-based leads, including support on initial calls, taking of briefs and presenting of responses.
To work with the Departmental Heads across a range of tasks to further the scale, capabilities and quality of the ROAST offering, including:
Recruitment
Training plans
New business (both preparation and attendance)
Produce marketing material including case study writing and blog posts
Develop collateral for team growth in the US to ensure smooth onboarding of both clients and new team members.
Experience At least 5 years of working in PPC delivery (if in a mixed channel role, at least 70% of time on paid search)
**A proven track record of:**
delivering projects and results for clients with monthly budgets of $100,000+
achieving business targets (sales and revenue volume, CPA, ROI, ROAS)
developing junior team members
leading 3rd party bid management tools
leading onsite analytics packages
bringing efficiency to client activity in terms of both performance and resource levels
Experience of executing campaigns within other Paid Media channels beneficial.
Skills Strong understanding of wider digital channels and environment, including organic search.
Experience of working with, and managing, international teams
Ability to work and succeed in a fast-paced environment
Ability to independently research news stories, industry developments or opportunities and relay these to the wider business and clients.
Highly organised with an acute attention to detail
Exceptional level of English, both written and spoken
Strong numerical and analytical capabilities, including use and creation of Excel formulae and macros
Capabilities with Google Ads scripts or Java beneficial
Additional language capabilities beneficial
Working at ROAST Location: Phoenix, AZ
Annual Leave: 20 vacation days in addition to bank holidays, plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off
Hybrid working arrangements
Additional 2 weeks ‘work from anywhere in the world’
Health insurance
401K with company contribution
Opportunity for involvement in CSR, sustainability and charity initiatives
Training, including supplier sessions (e.g. Google), industry bodies (e.g. IAB), external trainers
Opportunities to learn about other digital marketing disciplines
Our hybrid-working model allows you some variety on your place of work, offering you the chance to work from home where possible. You will be expected to attend the office in line with our company policy. All staff liaise closely with their line manager to manage their time appropriately and according to their work and team requirements.
We are an equal opportunities employer.
At ROAST, we take pride in creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment where everyone is welcome and their contributions are valued. When we recruit, hire, train, promote or engage in any other employment practice, we are committed to being an inclusive employer regardless of race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, socioeconomic status, medical condition or disability, or any other protected status.
If you have a disability we would be happy to discuss reasonable adjustments to the job with you.
Please note that we will only accept applications from candidates who are legally entitled to work in the USA.
Please beware of scams online or from individuals claiming to represent us. A ROAST employee will never solicit candidates through a non-Roast email address or phone number / WhatsApp. Please refuse any request that asks you to provide payment to participate in the hiring process.

Strong understanding of B2B buyer journeys and enterprise sales cycles.

Experience with ABM platforms and CRM/marketing automation tools.

Data‑driven approach with the ability to interpret metrics and optimize campaigns.

Experience with analytics and a passion for proving marketing results across the marketing and sales funnel.

Excellent project management, communication, and relationship‑building skills.

[Poland, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/Poland%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5775217675097752610?p=1&pos=0&rgn=32560&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6046385269491395112&crId=US_0US_0)

Creatio is an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale. We help midsize and large organizations run customer workflows in the AI era. Headquartered in Boston, MA, with a global team and a large ecosystem of partners, Creatio serves thousands of customers in over 100 countries and automates tens of millions of workflows daily. Genuine care for our clients and partners is at the heart of our DNA.
We’re proud to be recognized by top industry analysts as a Leader and Strong Performer in multiple Gartner and Forrester reports.
In 2025, Creatio was named to Inc.’s Best Workplaces list, recognizing our commitment to employee wellbeing and a strong workplace culture.
Who We’re Looking For We are seeking passionate, proactive, and results-driven Senior PPC Specialist who is excited to contribute to a fast-growing and innovative company, drive lead generation and brand awareness paid campaigns for Creatio, develop and execute a data-driven growth marketing strategy for our campaigns globally. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, embraces challenges as opportunities, and is motivated to bring fresh ideas to the table.
Most importantly, we’re looking for individuals who share our values, believe in collaboration, and want to be part of a workplace where creativity, accountability, and ambition are celebrated.
The role is based in Poland.
Team Composition This role sits within the Digital Marketing // PPC Team and reports directly to the Digital Strategist.
Responsibilities Campaign Management & Optimization: Create, manage, and optimize all digital advertising campaigns, including but not limited to Facebook, Instagram, Google, and LinkedIn. Make decisions about optimizing and stopping campaigns, and coordinate these decisions with stakeholders.
Strategic Planning: Plan and schedule marketing campaigns across different channels and regions. Collaborate with internal teams to develop and execute campaigns effectively, and provide recommendations on personalization and optimization strategies.
Data Analysis & Reporting: Create and deliver reports of KPIs. Measure, monitor, and communicate key metrics, and analyze the effectiveness of campaigns across channels to maximize results and adjust campaign structure when needed.
Paid Ads Strategy Development: Identify new approaches and strategies for paid advertising. Coordinate with management on strategy planning and execution, and implement AI-driven insights to improve ROI and campaign efficiency.
LLM Ads: Launch and optimize advertising campaigns on ChatGPT and other LLM platforms.
Requirements Proven experience managing LinkedIn, Google Ads, Search Campaigns, Google Display, Microsoft Advertising, Facebook, and other paid media channels.
Experience with A/B testing and Google Ads experiments.
Strong proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4).
Experience in the B2B or software development industry is highly preferred.
Ability to launch campaigns from scratch, including pixel implementation and conversion setup.
Data-driven analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail and a focus on optimization.
Strong collaboration skills with digital, content, and design teams.
Strong project management skills to handle multiple campaigns simultaneously, including media planning, budgeting, and financial requests.
Proficiency with analytics and optimization tools such as Keyword Planner, plus advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, VLOOKUP, and similar functions).
Experience working with CRM systems and the ability to work with large data sets to extract meaningful insights.
Hands-on experience in performance analysis and lead generation funnel tracking.
Experience in market research, competitor analysis, and user feedback analysis, with a proven ability to plan and execute full-funnel acquisition strategies.
Knowledge of managing advertising campaigns on AI platforms such as ChatGPT and other LLMs.
Nice to have Google Tag Manager expertise and experience managing YouTube.
What You Should Expect From Us Growth & Development: Clear career paths, mentorship opportunities, and access to continuous learning to help you reach your full potential.
Flexibility & Well-Being: We provide flexible work arrangements and initiatives that empower you to manage your schedule effectively, stay productive, and thrive both personally and professionally.
Recognition & Impact: A culture that celebrates achievements, values your ideas, and empowers you to make real contributions from day one.
Innovative Culture: Be part of a company that embraces new ideas, modern technologies, and bold thinking to stay ahead of the curve.
Benefits & Rewards Package: We provide competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you and your family. Our rewards approach goes beyond salary, recognizing your contributions and commitment. The exact package may vary depending on your country of residence and employment type.

# Ad Operations-Senior Associate-Paid Media

Testing Site - JPMC

[Chicago, IL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Chicago%2C-IL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3386564083560672439?p=1&pos=0&rgn=11886&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1689923188818146569&crId=US_0US_0)

The Media Center of Excellence is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and optimization of large-scale programmatic media initiatives. Guide end-to-end advertising operations across Owned and Paid Media, with a focus on precise tagging, trafficking, QA/QC, and operational automation.

As an Ad Operations Senior Associate on the Paid media team, you will partner closely with internal stakeholders, agencies, and publishers to launch, monitor, and optimize programmatic, direct IO, and social campaigns. You will also handle intake, implementation and validation of all on-site conversion tagging requests via our proprietary Tag Management System.

Job Responsibilities

Create and trafficking of paid media programmatic, direct IO, and social campaigns within Campaign Manager 360 (CM360).

Own on-site tag deployment via Tag Management System, ensuring accurate capture for performance, monitoring, targeting, and analytics.

Lead troubleshooting of trafficked campaign tags, potential discrepancies, and delivery issues, driving resolution with publishers, agencies, and platform partners.

Partner with brand safety provider, Integral Ad Science (IAS), to ensure brand safety benchmarks are measured and benchmarks are met.

Maintain governance and documentation for ad ops procedures and processes.

Perform rigorous QA/QC on campaign setups, launches, and on-site conversion tagging.

Build and manage relationships with internal, agency stakeholders, and publishers, coordinate specs, timelines, SLAs, and escalations.

Translate technical concepts (identity, measurement, attribution, verification, privacy) into concise guidance for non-technical stakeholders.

Ensure compliance with privacy and data protection controls for tag deployment and data collection.

Identify, scope, and guide automation initiatives to streamline trafficking, QA, reporting, and operational workflows.

Partner with analytics and technology teams to ensure data is transformed into accessible, high‑value datasets for business decisioning.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:

5+ years in digital marketing/advertising operations, including hands-on trafficking for programmatic, direct IO, and social.

5+ years in media/site tagging, marketing analytics, and campaign measurement using web analytics tools.

Proficiency with CM360, Tag Management Systems, DSPs/SSPs; familiarity with Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, JIRA, and brand safety partners.

Demonstrated excellence in QA/QC, documentation, and governance.

Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and concisely.

Experience leading or contributing to automation initiatives in advertising operations.

# Senior Paid Media Buyer

$130k - $150k

MarkeTeam

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2196941251210913675?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8803619991743182482&crId=US_0US_0)

Senior Media Buyer, Meta and Google
You are one of the best Meta and Google buyers alive, and you know it. Come own the paid media engine for an AI-native marketing company, and help our biggest clients win with it.
Rolesnapshot
Why This Role Exists Paid media is the fastest lever we have, for us and for our clients. Marketeam.ai is an AI-native marketing platform: humans direct, and AI agents execute across paid media, AEO and GEO, SEO, design, content, social, and analytics. We need one world-class buyer who can set the standard for how paid media gets done here.

You will run our own Meta and Google programs as the proof that we practice what we sell. You will also be the expert our Customer Success Managers call when a mid-market or enterprise client needs paid media to move the number that keeps them renewing.

What You Will Own Internal pipeline
Marketeam.ai paid media hits its monthly targets for qualified leads, booked demos, and pipeline

Efficiency
Cost per qualified lead and customer acquisition cost at or below target, with spend scaled only when the numbers hold

Testing velocity
A steady weekly cadence of creative, offer, audience, and landing page tests, with clear winners and losers

Tracking you trust
Conversions API, enhanced conversions, and offline conversions from HubSpot set up correctly, so we optimize to revenue, not clicks

Client impact
Client paid media accounts you consult on hit their goals and renew

Playbooks
Your best plays turned into repeatable playbooks that our AI agents and team can run

What You Will Do
Own Marketeam.ai paid media Plan, launch, and manage every Marketeam.ai campaign on Meta and Google: Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen, Advantage+, and lead campaigns.
Own budgets and forecasts. Know where every dollar goes and what it returns.
Scale winners with discipline: vertical budget increases, horizontal duplication into new audiences, and new placements when the numbers hold.
Build the creative testing engine with design and content: hooks, angles, formats, UGC, and video.
Partner with the sales team so every lead is tracked from first click to closed deal in HubSpot.

Consult on client paid media Partner with Customer Success Managers on mid-market and enterprise accounts where paid media is the constraint.
Audit client Meta and Google accounts and write clear, prioritized fixes.
Join client strategy calls, QBRs, and renewal reviews to explain what is working and what comes next.
Set the plan, review the work of our AI agents and specialists, and raise the bar on quality.

Stay ahead of the platforms Track every major change in Meta and Google, and know what it means before our competitors do.
Test new features early and share what you learn with the team.
Help shape how Marketeam's AI agents buy media, so the platform gets smarter every quarter.

Your First 90 Days

Days 1 to 30
Audit every Marketeam.ai Meta and Google account and our tracking. Fix the biggest leaks. Present a 90-day paid media plan with targets.
Days 31 to 60

Uproot Clean

[West Virginia](https://jooble.org/jobs/West-Virginia)

### Job Description

**About the role**

\\n

We're hiring a Paid Media Buyer to live inside our ad accounts across Meta, Google, AppLovin, NewsBreak, Pinterest, native (Taboola / Outbrain), and other platforms as we expand. You'll own the technical execution and day-to-day optimization of paid campaigns: building structure, reading the data, finding the leaks, and pulling the right levers to scale.

\\n

This is a performance ownership role. You won’t be creating assets yourself, but you’ll work closely with creative teams to understand why ads win, identify performance patterns, and turn data into better creative decisions.

\\n

\\n

**Ideal Background**

\\n

The strongest candidates for this role have scaled DTC/ecommerce brands through Meta-first performance marketing environments where they owned significant spend, testing, optimization, and business outcomes.

\\n

You likely come from a high-growth consumer brand or performance marketing agency where you managed multiple **direct-response ecommerce** accounts and had direct responsibility for profitable scale.

\\n

\\n

**Strong signals:**

\\n

\\n - Managed $750K–$1M+ monthly paid media spend
\\n - Deep Meta Ads expertise as the primary growth channel
\\n - Scaled DTC/ecommerce products through paid acquisition
\\n - Owned budget allocation, testing strategy, and performance decisions
\\n - Experience working closely with creative teams to turn data into winning ads
\\n

\\n

\\n

**What you'll do**

\\n

**Daily / Weekly Cadence**

\\n

\\n - Run weekly account optimizations across every platform you own. Increase budgets on ad sets and campaigns hitting their primary KPI over rolling 3/7/14-day windows, pull back spend from underperformers, and restart ads where delayed attribution masked early performance.
\\n - Maintain a weekly creative testing cadence per platform: brief tests, launch with clean hypotheses, read them against pre-set spend or conversion thresholds, then kill or scale on schedule.
\\n - Run pacing checks daily, weekly, and MTD against budget and KPI goals. Adjust spend distribution before the gap becomes a problem, not after.
\\n - On Google specifically: negative keyword mining on Search and Shopping, smart bidding strategy reviews, Merchant Center diagnostics, quality score and ad strength reviews, and placement exclusions on Display and YouTube.
\\n - Lead routine reporting (weekly and monthly) for the accounts you own. Performance, leading indicators, blended view across platforms, and the insights and next moves, not just the numbers.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Strategic Ownership**

\\n

\\n - Build, launch, and optimize campaigns across Meta, Google (Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube), AppLovin, NewsBreak, Pinterest, native, and any new platform we test into.
\\n - Continuously audit accounts. Spot bottlenecks at the ad level vs. the site level, kill waste, double down on what's working.
\\n - Read multi-platform data and explain what's actually happening, not just what each platform reports about itself.
\\n - Make the call on how to allocate budget across platforms based on incrementality, scale capacity, and unit economics.
\\n - Brief creative needs to the creative team based on data signal, then test outputs against pre-defined success criteria.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Tools you'll use**

\\n

\\n - Native ad platforms: Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, AppLovin, NewsBreak, Pinterest Ads, Taboola/Outbrain
\\n - Analytics: GA4, Northbeam, Hex, BigQuery, Shopify backend
\\n - Planning and reporting: Notion, ClickUp, Sheets/Excel
\\n

\\n

_Equivalents are fine. We care about the muscle, not the brand of the tool._

\\n

\\n

**What we're looking for**

\\n

\\n - **3+ years buying paid media at meaningful scale**($750K–$1M+ monthly preferred), with hands-on Meta and Google experience as the foundation
\\n - **Meta-first paid acquisition expertise:** Deep Meta Ads expertise with strong Google Ads experience.
\\n - **Experience scaling** DTC/ecommerce brands through paid acquisition
\\n - **Experience operating in direct-response environments** where spend efficiency and creative performance drive growth
\\n - **Strong analytical chops:** at home in Sheets/Excel, can pull the right view in Looker Studio or equivalent, and read a P&L well enough to translate ad metrics into business impact
\\n - **Comfort with attribution chaos:** you can reconcile what Meta says, what Shopify says, and what GA4 says, and explain it to a CFO without hand-waving
\\n - **Sharp on tracking and measurement:** pixels, CAPI, server-side events, conversion APIs, UTMs
\\n - **A clear point of view on testing:** how to design clean tests, when to call a winner, when to kill a loser
\\n - **Deep curiosity around performance:** constantly asks why something worked or failed, identifies patterns, and turns insights into action.
\\n - **Strong written communication:** Slack updates, weekly performance reports, ad-hoc explanations to non-paid-media stakeholders
\\n - **Asks the right questions before acting.** We'll trust you with real money in real accounts; you need to know what you don't know, and ask for it
\\n - **Comfortable juggling multiple accounts in parallel** with shifting priorities, without dropping balls
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Nice to have**

\\n

\\n - Mobile UA experience
\\n - AppLovin / NewsBreak / Pinterest / native experience
\\n - MMM/incrementality testing
\\n - Server-side tracking setup experience
\\n - Shopify/ecommerce analytics depth
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Work Requirements**

\\n

⏰ **Schedule:** Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

\\n

**Workspace:** Fixed, professional setup (not digital nomad)

\\n

**Output:** Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)

\\n

\\n

**Benefits & Compensation**

\\n

\\n - **Competitive base salary** \+ performance-based bonus structure
\\n - **Fully remote** \- work from anywhere in the US, Canada, or Europe
\\n - **Paid time off**
\\n - **Flex days.** Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
\\n - **Fully covered medical insurance** , including health, dental, and vision. (US-based employees)
\\n - **Ownership & autonomy** \- trusted to build and execute strategy
\\n - **Professional development** \- opportunities to learn and grow with the business
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Ready to Apply?**

\\n

If you're creative-first, performance-driven, and ready to build systems that scale winning ads in a high-output, high-accountability environment, apply now.

If you’re passionate, strategic, collaborative and kind, with a dose of scrappy thrown in, we want to meet you.
