# Senior Media Buyer

Clearlink Technologies, LLC

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8384112846541787459?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8723298989312696142&crId=US_0US_0)

Who We're Looking For - Senior Media Buyer The Penny Hoarder is seeking a performance-driven media buyer to own and scale a core revenue channel.
This role is responsible for owning revenue and gross margin performance of paid media platforms, managing a multi-million-dollar budget, and driving continuous optimization across the full funnel, from ad creative to landing page experience to downstream monetization.
We are looking for a candidate with vast paid media experience who has a proven track record of driving results and are motivated to expand into a full-funnel, performance-driven environment.
This is a highly autonomous role with clear accountability for outcomes, requiring strong analytical thinking, speed in execution, and a bias toward action.
We are open to remote candidates who are willing to work East Coast (EST) hours.
The Impact You Will Make Own the paid media channels end-to-end, including strategy, execution, and performance outcomes across platforms
Manage and optimize a multi-million-dollar budget to drive efficient, profitable customer acquisition.
Analyze campaign performance daily, identify root causes of changes, and take decisive, data-informed actions to improve results.
Evaluate performance across the full marketing funnel to identify and close gaps in user experience, conversion flow, and revenue opportunities.
Translate data into clear insights, identify the key drivers of performance, and take ownership of acting on them.
Develop and execute a robust testing roadmap, including A/B testing of ad creative, copy, and landing page experiences.
Continuously launch and iterate on new campaigns, creatives, and tests to drive incremental performance gains and scale what works.
Prioritize high-impact opportunities and focus efforts on initiatives that drive meaningful business outcomes.
Collaborate cross-functionally with creative, editorial, and analytics teams to align media strategy with content and monetization goals.
Monitor key performance indicators (CPL, ROAS, profit per session, lead quality, etc.) and deliver actionable reporting to stakeholders.
Stay up to date on platform updates, industry trends, and competitive strategies to inform ongoing campaign improvements.
What You Bring 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, with hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns.
Proven track record scaling paid media campaigns profitably at meaningful spend levels (Meta, Google, Native, or similar)
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify root causes of performance, separate signal from noise, and make confident, data-driven decisions.
Proficiency in Excel, including working with large datasets and building reports.
Deep understanding of affiliate marketing models, lead generation, and revenue-per-click or revenue-per-session monetization strategies.
Demonstrated track record of proactively testing, iterating, and scaling campaigns—not just maintaining performance.
Knowledge of performance metrics (e.g., CPC, conversion rate, revenue per session) and how to optimize toward them.
Demonstrated expertise in landing page optimization, including real-world testing examples that led to measurable improvements.
Experience optimizing toward down-funnel quality metrics like lead-to-sale rate, client retention, or lifetime value.
Ability to prioritize high-impact opportunities and act with urgency in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability for performance outcomes.
Clear and effective communicator, able to present insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally.
Bonus: Experience in affiliate marketing, lead generation, or publisher-based business models.
Perks That Set Us Apart
Healthcare: We offer low-cost, competitive health coverage (domestic partners included!) with employer-paid counseling services.
Invest in the Future: Enjoy 401(k) matching after just two months of employment, with employer matching starting at ~3%.
Lifestyle Spending Stipends: Access an employer-paid spending account for physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing expenses.
Flexible Time Off: We offer competitive time-off balances that accrue weekly, just like your paycheck. (Yes, we’re paid weekly too!)
Parental Leave: We provide 2 weeks of paid parental leave during the first year and up to 9 weeks after one year of employment.
Generous Paid Holidays: Celebrate cultural diversity with additional flex holidays in addition to our company paid holidays.
Remote Work Options: Skip the daily commute, and embrace the flexibility of working from home.
Comprehensive Life Insurance: Ensure peace of mind with coverage that extends beyond the workplace with employer paid life insurance (including coverage for dependents and spouses).
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs): Join us in fostering connections, celebrating diversity, and providing a supportive community for all.
At Clearlink, we go beyond the basics, ensuring your experience with us is not just professionally fulfilling but personally enriching too.

# Senior Growth Marketing Manager - Home Services

Full-time

Geeks on Site

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6402134624196973638?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=378&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4548147029367191184&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Us**

Geeks on Site is a U.S.-based technology services company providing professional technical support to residential and business customers across the United States.

Our services include computer repair, IT support, network troubleshooting, printer setup, smart home technology assistance, and other on-site and remote technical solutions.

Through our nationwide network of technicians and support professionals, we help customers resolve technology challenges with reliable, convenient, and high-quality service.

Our distributed team combines technical expertise, customer-focused service, and operational efficiency to deliver solutions that make technology easier and more accessible.

**Job Overview**

Geeks on Site is seeking a hands-on **Senior Marketing Manager with direct marketing experience in U.S.-based Home Services companies** to plan, manage, and execute integrated marketing initiatives that drive brand awareness, qualified leads, service bookings, customer acquisition, and measurable revenue growth.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of developing and managing marketing campaigns for U.S.-based residential service businesses and understands the unique challenges of customer acquisition in the Home Services industry.

This role requires someone who can coordinate marketing specialists and external agencies, manage campaigns and budgets, and translate performance data into actionable improvements.

We are looking for a senior marketing professional who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and can take ownership of marketing performance for the Geeks on Site brand.

**This is not a purely strategic or theoretical role. This is execution + leadership + growth + ROI accountability.**

What Success Looks Like

- Consistent growth in qualified leads, service inquiries, booked appointments, and marketing-attributed revenue.
- Improved customer acquisition efficiency, with clear visibility into cost per lead, customer acquisition cost, and campaign ROI.
- Effective local and multi-market marketing campaigns aligned with Geeks on Site's service availability and business priorities.
- Strong and consistent brand positioning across all marketing channels.
- Increased brand awareness and customer engagement in targeted U.S. markets.
- Clear reporting, accountable execution, and productive collaboration between Marketing, Sales, and Operations.
- Marketing initiatives that contribute directly to customer acquisition, retention, and business growth.

**Responsibilities**

### Marketing Planning & Team Coordination

- Develop and execute quarterly marketing plans aligned with Geeks on Site's business objectives and revenue goals.
- Coordinate marketing specialists, agencies, and vendors, establishing priorities, deliverables, and performance expectations.
- Manage marketing budgets, campaign timelines, and resources, recommending adjustments based on performance.
- Collaborate with company leadership to identify growth opportunities, launch campaigns, and improve marketing processes.
- Ensure marketing initiatives support the company's overall growth strategy and customer acquisition objectives.

### Integrated Marketing & Brand Management

- Manage a comprehensive mix of marketing channels, including paid search, SEO, local SEO, paid social media, content marketing, email marketing, marketing automation, and website optimization.
- Maintain consistent Geeks on Site brand messaging, positioning, creative assets, and customer communications across all channels.
- Oversee landing pages, website performance, and conversion optimization initiatives in collaboration with design, content, and technical resources.
- Develop campaigns that strengthen brand recognition, customer trust, and market visibility.
- Support new service launches, customer retention initiatives, and geographic market expansion.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement and strengthen Geeks on Site's competitive positioning.

### Home Services Customer Acquisition

- Plan and execute local and service-area marketing campaigns designed to generate qualified calls, customer inquiries, and booked service appointments.
- Apply relevant marketing strategies, including Google Business Profile, Google Local Services Ads where available, local SEO, geographic targeting, and location-specific landing pages.
- Develop marketing initiatives tailored to the U.S. Home Services market and customer purchasing behavior.
- Evaluate campaign performance by geographic location, service category, lead quality, and conversion to booked jobs.
- Collaborate with Sales and Operations to align marketing demand with technician availability, service coverage, and fulfillment capacity.
- Identify opportunities to increase customer acquisition in existing service areas and support expansion into new U.S. markets.

### Performance, Analytics & Revenue Impact

- Track and optimize key marketing performance indicators, including:

 - Qualified Leads
 - Cost per Lead (CPL)
 - Cost per Booked Service
 - Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
 - Conversion Rate
 - Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
 - Marketing-Attributed Revenue

- Maintain marketing dashboards and provide regular performance reports with actionable recommendations.
- Test and optimize messaging, marketing channels, audiences, campaigns, and landing pages.
- Identify underperforming initiatives and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency and ROI.
- Improve lead tracking, CRM workflows, marketing attribution, and handoffs between Marketing and Sales.
- Ensure marketing investments contribute to measurable business outcomes.

**Requirements**

- 5–7+ years of progressive marketing experience, including digital marketing, lead generation, and campaign performance management.
- 2+ years of experience coordinating or managing marketing team members, agencies, vendors, or cross-functional initiatives.
- **Required: Direct marketing experience working with U.S.-based Home Services companies** , such as HVAC, plumbing, pest control, appliance repair, electrical services, residential cleaning, in-home technical support, or comparable residential service businesses.
- Proven experience developing and executing marketing campaigns targeting customers in the United States.
- Demonstrated success generating qualified leads, inbound calls, service appointments, customer acquisition, and measurable revenue for Home Services businesses.
- Strong understanding of paid media, SEO/local SEO, content marketing, email marketing, branding, marketing automation, and conversion optimization.
- Experience managing geographically targeted marketing campaigns for U.S. service markets.
- Proficiency with marketing analytics and tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Google Search Console, and CRM systems.
- Ability to manage budgets, prioritize marketing initiatives, and communicate performance in terms of business outcomes.
- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with U.S.-based leadership and global team members, with sufficient overlap with U.S. business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting multi-location or nationwide Home Services companies operating in the United States.
- Familiarity with Google Local Services Ads, Google Business Profile, call tracking, and service-area marketing performance.
- Experience developing marketing campaigns for residential technical support, IT services, computer repair, or similar service businesses.
- Experience optimizing customer acquisition across multiple U.S. geographic markets.
- Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels, lead-to-booking conversion, and marketing attribution in service-based businesses.

Ideal Profile

- Balances strategic marketing planning with practical, hands-on campaign management.
- Understands the economics of customer acquisition in the U.S. Home Services industry.
- Prioritizes qualified leads, booked services, customer acquisition, and revenue over vanity metrics.
- Can guide marketing specialists and agencies while remaining actively involved in execution.
- Collaborates effectively across departments and takes accountability for marketing performance.
- Comfortable improving existing marketing programs while developing scalable processes.
- Understands how geographic service coverage and operational capacity influence marketing decisions.
- Analytical, proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

**Benefits**

**Why This Role Matters**

At Geeks on Site, marketing plays a critical role in connecting customers across the United States with reliable technical support services.

We are looking for a Senior Marketing Manager who can strengthen our brand presence, improve customer acquisition, and transform marketing initiatives into measurable business growth.

This role offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on the performance of a nationwide service business by developing effective marketing strategies, optimizing acquisition channels, and supporting expansion into new markets.

What We Offer

- **Remote opportunity for US-based and global team members.**
- Collaboration with a distributed, execution-focused team and direct exposure to company leadership.
- Opportunity to take ownership of marketing initiatives for an established U.S. technology services brand.
- Ability to shape multi-channel marketing campaigns, improve marketing systems, and influence growth decisions.
- A high-autonomy environment that values clear communication, accountability, innovation, and measurable results.
- Opportunity for professional growth and expanded leadership responsibilities as the company continues to develop.

# Ecommerce Growth Marketing Senior Paid Media Specialist

$5,000 - $10,000 per month

Apex Brands

[West Virginia](https://jooble.org/jobs/West-Virginia)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-3674721162242819175?p=1&pos=0&rgn=49&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8096148873621225431&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

We are a DTC Ecommerce Growth Consulting & Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses attract, engage, and convert their ideal audience.

\\n

\\n

Our Mission: to help DTC ecommerce companies grow holistically

\\n

\\n

Our Vision: We imagine a world where service businesses never have to worry about meeting revenue goals, attracting consistent quality customers, retaining customers, or maintaining and growing their overall online presence.

\\n

\\n

Our Values:

\\n

\- Treat others the way we want to be treated

\\n

\- Pay close attention to detail

\\n

\- Don't neglect the small things, they matter

\\n

\- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator

\\n

\- Confidence and determination to achieve our vision.

\\n

\\n

Who We Are Looking For:

\\n

\\n

We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.

\\n

\\n

The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.

\\n

\\n

The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.

\\n

\\n

Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.

\\n

\\n

Responsibilities

\\n

\\n - Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
\\n - Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
\\n - Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
\\n - Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
\\n - Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
\\n - Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
\\n - Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends
\\n

\\n

\\n

Qualifications & Experience

\\n

\\n - Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
\\n - Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
\\n - Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
\\n - Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
\\n - Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
\\n - Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
\\n - Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
\\n - You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
\\n - You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.
\\n

\\n

\\n

Base Salary Range:

\\n

\\n - $5,000 - $10,000 USD per month
\\n

\\n

\\n

Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

Amplitude Analytics

Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com .

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

### About The Role & Team

We’re looking for a **Senior Marketing Automation Specialist** to join our Marketing Operations team and help scale the systems and programs that power our global marketing organization. You’ll be a key partner to marketers across the business, bringing strong expertise in marketing automation to execute programs, optimize processes, and ensure our campaigns reach the right audiences at the right time. You’ll own day-to-day execution in Marketo, partner closely with our Salesforce team, and help improve lead management, scoring, nurturing, and campaign performance. This is a great opportunity for a hands-on marketing operations professional who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and using technology, including AI, to make marketing more effective and efficient.

**As a Senior Marketing Automation Specialist, you will:**

- Own the end-to-end execution of marketing automation programs in Marketo, including audience creation, email and landing page builds, workflows, A/B testing, QA, tracking, and reporting.

- Partner with marketers across the organization to translate campaign and program requirements into scalable, high-quality marketing automation solutions.

- Support and optimize lead lifecycle management, including lead routing, enrichment, scoring, nurturing, and campaign attribution, in partnership with our Salesforce administration team.

- Help manage and optimize our marketing technology stack, identifying opportunities to improve processes, automation, data quality, and overall program efficiency.

- Leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline marketing operations, automate repetitive work, and improve the speed and effectiveness of our marketing programs.


**You’ll be a great addition to the team if you have:**

- You’re a strong marketing operations partner who can take a business need, translate it into a technical solution, and execute with minimal oversight.

- You have a detail-oriented mindset and take pride in building programs that are accurate, scalable, and reliable.

- You enjoy troubleshooting problems, digging into data, and figuring out why something isn’t working, then finding a better way to do it.

- You’re curious about new technology and excited to experiment with AI and automation to improve how marketing teams work.

- We value people who are collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable working across teams in a fast-moving environment.


**At a minimum, you need to have:**

- 3+ years of experience working in marketing operations or marketing automation, with hands-on experience building and executing programs in Marketo or a similar marketing automation platform.

- Experience with Salesforce, including working with leads, contacts, campaigns, and reporting, and an understanding of how marketing automation and CRM systems work together.

- Experience managing marketing programs such as email campaigns, nurtures, webinars, events, or other digital programs from setup through execution and reporting.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an understanding of marketing data, attribution, and funnel management.

- Basic HTML/CSS skills and a high level of attention to detail, particularly when building and QAing customer-facing marketing experiences.


### Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

- **Humility:** We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

- **Ownership:** We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

- **Growth Mindset:** We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

- **Customer Centricity:** We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.


**We care about the well-being of our team:** We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

- Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

- 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

- Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

- Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

- Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

- Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

- Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)


**Other fun facts about Amplitude:**

- Our customers love us! They’ve said we’re the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

- We care a lot about product innovation. We’ve made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

- We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

- We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.

- We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.

- We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.

- Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.

# Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager

Docker

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4099851835200627389?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7580573255816945243&crId=US_0US_0)

##### About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout. We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

Docker's Product-Led Growth (PLG) team owns turning product usage into revenue across the full Platform: the Container business (Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, Docker Build Cloud, Docker Scout) and the AI business (Sandboxes, AI Governance, Model Runner, MCP Toolkit, MCP Catalog). Lifecycle marketing is one of the fastest-scaling parts of that team: it already owns user and admin nurtures, renewal automation, and first-touch outreach for PQLs and inbound leads, running against a marketable base in the tens of millions.

As **Senior Lifecycle Marketer** , you'll report directly to the VP of PLG and partner closely with our existing lifecycle marketing lead. You'll take ownership of assigned products, audiences, and lifecycle stages, with real input into shaping the approach for what you own, not just shipping someone else's plan, and you'll help turn a fast-growing list of priorities into a structured, scalable lifecycle engine.

##### What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

- **Lifecycle Fluency:** You think in full user journeys, not campaigns. You've done lifecycle marketing specifically, not just growth or demand gen, and you know how nurture, activation, retention, and renewal connect across a product's full lifecycle.
- **Builder's Mindset:** You'd rather own a program end to end, strategy, build, QA, and send, than hand pieces of it off. You bring structure to ambiguity: turning a fast-growing list of priorities into themes, a build queue, and a sequenced roadmap.
- **Audience & Signal Validation:** You know how to validate an audience and its underlying signal before it ships: spot-checking record-level data, sanity-checking targeting logic, and catching a bad segment before it reaches users. You don't need to write SQL yourself, but you can work directly with data teams to confirm a list is right.
- **Cross-Functional Operator:** You operate well across marketing, sales (BDR and renewals), data, and design/agency partners, and you know how to keep programs moving even when you don't own every dependency.
- **Marketing Automation Execution:** You've personally built campaigns in Marketo or an equivalent platform, not just briefed them: audience builds, suppressions and contact governance, pre-send QA and live proofs, and launch monitoring, including troubleshooting a broken data sync in the moment.
- **Technical Translation:** You can take a technical product or a raw usage signal, a feature adoption event, a usage threshold, a new capability, and turn it into messaging that reads credible to a developer or admin, not generic marketing copy.

##### Responsibilities

- **Build the Lifecycle Engine:** Own and build lifecycle campaigns (email and in-product messaging) across Docker's Container and AI Platform products, including Sandboxes and AI Governance, for both end users and admins.
- **Scale Programmatic Sends:** Design and run large-scale programmatic sends, such as recurring account health checks, to a base in the tens of millions, working within the team's marketing automation stack (currently Marketo and Mailgun; expect a platform transition in the next 6–12 months).
- **Automate Lead and Renewal Motions:** Stand up and run automated first-touch flows for PQLs and inbound leads, in partnership with BDR and renewals stakeholders.
- **Validate Audiences & Signals:** Partner with data and growth engineering to pull the usage signals campaigns depend on (Snowflake and internal data tools), and validate that an audience and its underlying signal are correct before every send.
- **Manage Suppressions & Contact Governance:** Own suppression lists and contact governance rules so campaigns stay compliant and don't over-message or reach the wrong audience.
- **QA, Launch Monitoring & Troubleshooting:** Run pre-send QA and live proofs on every campaign, monitor launches as they go out, and troubleshoot issues in real time, including broken data syncs.
- **Translate Signals into Messaging:** Turn technical product usage and adoption signals into messaging that reads credible and useful to developers and admins, not generic marketing copy.
- **Shape and Sequence Strategy:** Take a fast-growing list of priorities and turn it into a concrete build queue: itemize the work, sequence it, and flag capacity or dependency issues early.
- **Coordinate Design & Agency Partners:** Work with design and agency partners to keep campaign quality and turnaround on track.
- **Operationalize Reporting:** Own naming, tracking, and reporting on programs so the rest of the team has visibility into what's live, what's next, and what it's driving.

##### Qualifications

- **Lifecycle Marketing Experience:** A background specifically in lifecycle marketing, not pure growth or demand gen, ideally inside a PLG or self-serve motion.
- **Proven Program Ownership:** A track record of owning campaigns end to end (strategy, build, QA, send) and shipping programs that moved a real metric: activation, retention, or renewal conversion.
- **Marketing Automation Build Experience:** Hands-on build experience in Marketo or an equivalent marketing automation platform: audience builds, program/campaign setup, suppressions and contact governance, pre-send QA and live proofs, and launch monitoring.
- **Data & Targeting Validation:** Comfortable working directly with data teams to validate record-level data and targeting logic, for example auditing who's actually in a segment or spot-checking a list against expectations. Writing SQL yourself is a plus, not a requirement.
- **Technical-to-Message Translation:** A track record of turning a technical product or a raw usage signal into messaging that reads credible to a developer or admin audience, not generic marketing copy.
- **Technical Familiarity:** Comfort navigating developer ecosystems, cloud infrastructure, or complex multi-product software platforms.
- **Independent Ownership:** Senior-level judgment and ownership as an individual contributor: you can run with ambiguity and drive a program without every step spelled out, and you collaborate well with another senior peer on the team.

##### What to Expect

##### First 30 Days

- **Immerse & Align:** Get up to speed on Docker's PLG motion, product surface area (Container and AI), and the programs lifecycle already owns. Build a working relationship with data, BDR, renewals, and design/agency partners.
- **Program & Tooling Audit:** Audit the current state of user and admin nurtures, renewal automation, and PQL/lead outreach, and get familiar with the Marketo/Mailgun stack and its upcoming transition.
- **Roadmap Calibration:** Work with the lifecycle team to turn the current priority list into themes, a build queue, and a sequenced roadmap.

##### First 90 Days

- **Ship Owned Campaigns:** Take ownership of at least one full program, such as an admin nurture flow or a PQL first-touch sequence, from build through send.
- **Contribute to Renewal Automation:** Stand up a first version of automated renewal outreach in partnership with the renewals team.
- **Build the Reporting Cadence:** Put in place naming, tracking, and reporting so the team has clear visibility into what's live and what it's driving.

##### One Year Outlook

- **Own a Mature Program Set:** Own a mature, scaled set of lifecycle programs across your assigned products, audiences, and lifecycle stages.

Cadence Design Systems

At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

### Senior Product Marketing Manager – PCIe and CXL Controller IP Role at a glance

Lead product strategy, roadmap definition, customer engagement, and go-to-market execution for Cadence PCIe and CXL Controller IP, working closely with engineering, SerDes marketing, sales, application engineering, and ecosystem partners.

### Company Overview

At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. The Cadence IP Group is looking for a highly motivated Senior Product Marketing Manager to drive market success for our PCIe and CXL Controller IP portfolio.

### Position Summary

This role owns product marketing and product-management activities for PCIe and CXL Controller IP and related subsystem opportunities. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth in PCI Express, CXL, and SoC integration with the business judgment to translate market requirements, customer roadmaps, competitive dynamics, and standards evolution into differentiated product direction and compelling customer-facing messaging.

The successful candidate will define requirements, shape roadmaps, build competitive positioning, create high-impact sales and technical marketing collateral, and partner cross-functionally to drive customer adoption and product success across high-performance computing, AI infrastructure, data center, automotive, and advanced SoC / chiplet applications.

### Key Responsibilities

- Own roadmap input, market requirements, and product definition for PCIe and CXL Controller IP based on customer needs, market trends, competitive analysis, standards evolution, market segmentation, and SWOT analysis.
- Define and execute competitive marketing strategies for the PCIe and CXL Controller IP portfolio in partnership with SerDes marketing, engineering, sales, program management, and application engineering.
- Engage with lead customers and ecosystem partners to understand system-level requirements, including AI / HPC infrastructure, data center accelerators, storage, networking, automotive, and advanced SoC / chiplet use cases.
- Translate complex technical requirements into actionable product requirements, value propositions, competitive positioning, product briefs, presentations, white papers, web content, and sales enablement tools.
- Collaborate with engineering teams on controller portfolio planning, including protocol feature priorities, configurability, integration requirements, compliance considerations, validation readiness, and collateral needs.
- Support design-win activities by helping sales and field teams position Cadence IP against competitive alternatives, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and articulate differentiation at both technical and executive levels.
- Track industry standards and ecosystem developments, including PCI-SIG, CXL Consortium, NVMe, AMBA / Arm interconnects, and related SoC / platform interface trends.
- Represent and evangelize Cadence PCIe and CXL Controller IP at customer meetings, industry events, webinars, conferences, and on appropriate digital channels.
- Synthesize unstructured customer, market, and competitive data into clear recommendations for senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Identify creative solutions to product, positioning, and customer‑engagement challenges while operating with strong ownership, urgency, and cross-functional collaboration.

### Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
- 8+ years of experience in semiconductor IP, SoC, hardware design, verification, systems engineering, product management, product marketing, applications engineering, or a closely related technical role.
- Strong working knowledge of PCI Express and/or CXL technologies, including controller architecture, protocol features, SoC integration, performance, power, debug, compliance, and ecosystem requirements.
- Demonstrated ability to quickly understand complex hardware and software solutions and communicate their value to both technical and business audiences.
- Experience working directly with customers, sales teams, engineering teams, or field application teams in a semiconductor or IP business environment.
- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to create clear technical collateral and influence cross-functional stakeholders.

### Preferred Qualifications

- MBA or MS in a technical field with strong business aptitude.
- Hands‑on design, architecture, verification, application engineering, or product‑management experience with PCIe, CXL, NVMe, Ethernet, SerDes, or related high-speed interface IP.
- Familiarity with PCIe Gen5/Gen6/Gen7, CXL 2.0/3.x/4.0, PIPE, IDE, TDISP, FLIT mode, ordering rules, RAS, low-power features, compliance flows, and subsystem-level integration considerations.
- Understanding of AMBA standards and related SoC fabrics or interfaces, such as AXI, CHI, CXS, LTI/DTI, SMMU, and GIC-related integration considerations.
- Experience with PCIe/CXL IP integration in SoCs, chiplets, packages, boards, or data-center platforms, including interactions between controller, PHY/SerDes, firmware, software, and system validation.
- Participation in or close familiarity with industry standards bodies such as PCI-SIG, CXL Consortium, NVMe, OCP, or related ecosystem initiatives.
- Proven ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and drive alignment across geographically distributed teams.
- Prior customer-facing experience presenting to architects, engineering leaders, executives, sales teams, and partner organizations.

### Success Profile

- Technically credible: able to engage deeply on PCIe/CXL architecture while communicating business impact clearly.
- Market-driven: connects customer roadmaps, ecosystem changes, and competitive dynamics to actionable product direction.
- Collaborative: effective across engineering, sales, field applications, program management, and executive stakeholders.
- Clear communicator: produces crisp, differentiated messaging and high-quality customer-facing collateral.
- Execution-oriented: moves product strategy, sales enablement, and customer engagement forward with ownership and urgency.

# Growth Marketing, Senior Manager (Remote)

Continued

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

- Remote job

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5768759400830455295?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=658827102864404746&crId=US_0US_0)

Location: Remote

Work anywhere in the US, must live in the US

Marketing is changing, and at Continued , we aren't just keeping up—we’re building the infrastructure to stay ahead. Our team is seeking a Growth Marketing, Senior Manager to lead our marketing tech stack integration, and marketing operations, optimize our growth funnel, and pioneer next-generation acquisition strategies.

Are you highly curious? Comfortable in a fast-paced environment? Thrive in a collaborative team-setting? Pay special attention to details? Appreciate and can tap-into the unique skills of others? Are you a strong-contributor in a remote work setting?

## ABOUT CONTINUED

A leader in EdTech, Continued is a team of passionate individuals dedicated to empowering professionals and enhancing careers. We are fast-paced, nimble, and we laugh a lot. We are proud to be certified as a great workplace, ranked #4 in Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Education & Training, ranked #35 in Fortune's 2025 Best Medium Workplaces, and ranked #18 in Fortune's 2025 top 25 Small & Medium Workplaces for Women by the independent analysts at Great Place to Work®. We are 100% virtual, scattered across the country, but we maintain a tight-knit culture driven by curiosity, a love of learning, and a desire to solve complex problems. Learn more about us at continued.com.

## THE MISSION

To own and evolve our email marketing program while simultaneously leading and guiding our customer data platform across other digital marketing channels and direct mail. This is a high-impact role that sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, marketing operations, data infrastructure, and intelligent automation.

You will join a team that is actively investing in centralized audience segment and being AI-first. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage batch-and-blast campaigns — it is for a modern marketer who understands that the future of email, direct mail, and cross-channel orchestration lives inside a well-architected customer data platform.

## WHAT YOU’LL DO

Lead the audience segment buildout within our licensed platform: collaborate with our data team to manage audience traits, event taxonomy, identity resolution rules, and apply integration architecture with ESP’s and downstream channels

Own the email marketing program end-to-end: campaign strategy, segmentation, automation flows, A/B testing cadence, and performance reporting

Establish and enforce data hygiene standards, CAN-SPAM and other compliance protocols, and unsubscribe/suppression management across sends and mailings

Collaborate with the data team to maintain a subscriber data governance framework: aid in defining what we collect, how we store it, and how it flows across the stack

Partner with the data team to align CDP data structures to the broader data roadmap and migration project

Drive a cohesive omni-channel strategy by aligning direct mail logistics with digital campaigns to ensure consistent audience targeting, personalization, and suppression.

Lead AI automation adoption across email and direct mail: deploy AI tools for, send-time optimization, predictive segmentation, A-b testing and performance analytics

Manage reporting dashboards that connect marketing channels for engagement to renewal rates, and revenue contribution

Evaluate and recommend additional MarTech tooling to support channel expansion and automation maturity

Serve as the internal subject matter expert on email and related CDP capabilities

Managerial responsibilities of one or more team members

## WHO YOU ARE

You are a data-literate, technically fluent prospect, winback and engagement marketer who is equally comfortable in a CDP workspace as you are building journeys in an ESP. You research and follow trends in marketing technology. You are passionate about data quality. You are energized by collaboration and cross-team success.

6+ years in email marketing, growth marketing, or marketing automation

Hands-on experience with a CDP — Twilio Segment preferred

Direct experience with a marketing automation platform (specifically with Marketo, or HubSpot. Also Klayvio, Customer.io or equivalent)

Demonstrated ability to design and execute segmentation strategies using first-party behavioral and transactional data

Working knowledge of CAN-SPAM and other privacy regulations, email deliverability best practices, and list hygiene management

Experience working cross-functionally with data engineering, analytics, and product teams

Direct mail program experience or exposure to omnichannel orchestration

Experience in a subscription or auto-renew business model

Active, hands-on use of AI tools in a marketing workflow

Experience in a regulated or compliance-sensitive vertical (healthcare, education, financial services)

Solid familiarity with Marketo

## YOUR MINDSET

You default to data before opinions — you build the audience, test the hypothesis, and read the results

You are a builder, not just a manager — you are comfortable rolling up your sleeves in the platform while also influencing strategy

You move with urgency and communicate proactively, especially when blockers arise

You are energized by ambiguity and see an evolving role as an opportunity, not a risk

You hold yourself and your work accountable and to a high standard, and you raise the bar for the people around you

You strive for and uplift internal and cross-team accomplishments

## OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Must be able to work from home during core US business hours

Must be located in the United States and be legally eligible to work for us without sponsorship.

Must have the ability to fulfill the job requirements with or without reasonable accommodations

Travel is required for an all-company meeting, and may be required once or twice per year for team or project meetings

## WHY JOIN US?

Full-time W2 position, work core business hours in your time zone

Work from home with a company-provided MacBook and internet stipend

21 days of flexible PTO + your birthday + holidays (with flexible substitution)

½ day Summer Fridays Memorial Day to Labor Day

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision group health insurance, flexible spending accounts, and more

401k match, professional development budget, robust wellness programs, pet insurance and many more perks and benefits

Reports To: Vice President of Marketing
Employment Type: Full-Time
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8-hour workday between 7:30 AM and 5:30 PM
Compensation: $75,000 - $85,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications. This is a full-time, salaried, exempt position.
What We Offer 401(k) with Company Matching
Life Insurance

About K2D Group K2D Group is a growing organization focused on helping law firms and legal professionals build stronger, more successful businesses. Through our portfolio of specialized brands and services, we provide comprehensive solutions designed to support law firms at every stage of growth.
Our expertise spans marketing and client acquisition, social media and content production, recruiting and staffing, HR and compliance, financial management, operations, and more.
At K2D Group, we embrace innovation, automation, and artificial intelligence to improve efficiency, scale operations, and deliver measurable results. We believe the future of marketing lies in combining human judgment with powerful AI-driven systems.
Position Overview K2D Group is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and technology-driven Senior AI Marketing Operations Specialist to support the execution and optimization of marketing initiatives across multiple digital advertising platforms.
This is not a traditional digital marketing position.
The primary responsibility of this role is to operate, monitor, and execute marketing workflows using the company's proprietary AI systems. These systems generate detailed instructions, recommendations, and workflows that guide campaign execution, optimization, reporting, and other marketing activities.
The successful candidate will serve as the human operator responsible for ensuring AI-generated marketing tasks are executed accurately, efficiently, and consistently across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads, and SEO.
While AI will drive much of the strategy, analysis, and task generation, the individual in this role must have the marketing knowledge and critical-thinking skills necessary to recognize errors, validate recommendations, identify potential issues, and ensure successful implementation.
Working directly with the Vice President of Marketing, this individual will play a key role in scaling marketing operations through AI-powered execution, quality control, and continuous process improvement.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working within structured systems, following detailed workflows, managing multiple platforms, and adapting quickly as AI technology evolves.
Key Responsibilities AI Marketing Operations & Execution Operate the company's proprietary AI marketing systems to execute assigned marketing tasks and workflows.
Follow detailed AI-generated instructions to implement marketing activities across multiple platforms.
Review AI-generated recommendations, instructions, and outputs for accuracy, completeness, and feasibility.
Execute marketing tasks according to established workflows, priorities, and deadlines.
Identify incorrect, conflicting, or incomplete AI instructions and elevate concerns when necessary.
Monitor AI-driven processes to ensure tasks are completed correctly and consistently.
Maintain accurate records of completed activities, campaign changes, and workflow execution.

# Senior Email Marketing Analyst

Full-time

Reesmarx

[Fort Lauderdale, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Fort-Lauderdale%2C-FL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6331390324427248978?p=1&pos=0&rgn=9251&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8851833780780150849&crId=US_0US_0)

**Senior Email Marketing Analyst**

**Company Overview**

Our client is a national specialty retailer serving consumers and professional customers through stores, e-commerce, and a commercial sales division. The business supports a large multichannel customer base with high-volume, seasonally driven marketing activity.

**Job Overview**

The Senior Email Marketing Analyst is a hands-on individual contributor responsible for the strategy, execution, optimization, and analysis of high-volume email and SMS programs. This person will use segmentation, automated journeys, testing, deliverability, and performance analysis to improve customer engagement, conversion, retention, and channel revenue.

This position is based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, and requires at least three days onsite each week. Hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience is required. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

**Responsibilities**

- Own promotional, lifecycle, transactional, and automated email and SMS campaigns from planning and audience selection through build, quality assurance, deployment, and performance review.
- Build and optimize customer segments, dynamic content, personalization, and triggered communications using behavioral and transactional data.
- Create and manage automated journeys across welcome, abandoned browse, abandoned cart, post-purchase, loyalty, retention, re-engagement, and win-back programs.
- Determine email and SMS frequency, timing, and customer cadence in coordination with merchandising and promotional calendars.
- Develop A/B and multivariate tests across content, offers, audiences, send times, frequency, and calls to action, then apply the findings to future campaigns.
- Monitor conversion, revenue, engagement, unsubscribe, deliverability, list-health, and retention metrics while maintaining campaign accuracy and compliance.
- Diagnose performance changes, identify the underlying business drivers, and present clear recommendations to Digital Commerce, Merchandising, Creative, CRM, Analytics, and IT partners.

**Qualifications / Skills**

- Hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience managing campaign deployment, customer segments, automated journeys, testing, and reporting is required.
- Experience supporting high-volume B2C email programs is required, with five or more years of email marketing experience preferred.
- Experience within retail or e-commerce is preferred, although comparable high-volume consumer businesses will be considered.
- Strong experience with lifecycle marketing, audience segmentation, behavioral targeting, dynamic content, personalization, and triggered communications.
- Ability to interpret channel performance and recommend actions that improve conversion, retention, engagement, and revenue.
- Knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, consent management, CAN-SPAM, and TCPA requirements.
- A bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent professional experience. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, email QA tools, web analytics, and reporting platforms is preferred.

# Senior Marketing Analytics Manager

$150k - $175k

Garner Health

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4502095369379436403?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2483338679410950537&crId=US_0US_0)

What you'll be part of
Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system - and we're the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

What you'll be part of
Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system - and we're the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster. The result is a rare "win win" - better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. - and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

**Where you will work:**
If HQ: This role will be based in our New York City office (in the Financial District). You must be willing to work in the office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

**What you will do:**

Targeting & segmentation (campaign operations): Own the audience targeting, segmentation (SQL queries of Snowflake data tables to be built into our Iterable system), and personalization data behind our email, SMS, and direct mail campaigns. Partner with Engineering to troubleshoot upstream Data issues that affect our marketing campaigns, as well as enhance and automate the data mechanics and pipelines so the program can scale.

Analytics & Reporting: Own how member activation and engagement are measured end-to-end (e.g., Looker dashboards). Define, build, and maintain the KPIs, metric definitions, performance reports, and dashboards Growth Marketing runs on - funnel and lifecycle metrics, email/SMS campaign activity, channel efficiency, operational health, and KPI target setting.

Product & engagement analytics: Bridge marketing activity to member behavior in the Garner app so the team can optimize communications over time.

Experimentation: Develop and execute on the Growth Marketing team's A/B testing program and performance reporting.

Data governance: Build our data foundation alongside Data Management & Engineering, Reporting & Business Intelligence, Growth Product to ensure our data is analysis-ready and trustworthy. Build workflows, documentation, QA practices, and tooling that ensure our metrics are standardized across systems and campaigns.

Systems & technology stack: Uplevel our data sophistication by designing and building at the systems level, leveraging AI in order to maximize scale and leverage.

**What you will bring to the team:**

4-6+ years in marketing & growth & analytics, business intelligence, growth analytics, marketing analytics, or a similar data-centric role.

Growth & marketing, B2C, B2B2C, and Product-led Growth subject matter expertise preferred but not required (e.g., customer funnel analytics, cohort and retention curves, channel attribution, lifecycle email/SMS/direct mail performance, targeting/segmentation, personalization)

Expertise in the modern data stack. Hands-on proficiency with Snowflake, SQL, Python, and visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar). Experience with ESP/CRM event data (Iterable, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Klaviyo, or similar) is a strong plus.

Experience in experimentation & reporting. Familiarity with A/B and incrementality test design, statistics, measurement, and optimization.

Analytical rigor and problem framing. You turn a vague business question into the right analysis, define a defensible metric, and state your assumptions rather than jumping to a chart. You're a strong communicator who's comfortable using insight to drive decisions for a marketing audience and executives.

AI fluency. Comfort with and excitement about harnessing AI agents to build analyses, design dashboards, and validate results.

Self-starter approach with the ability to "roll up your sleeves" and juggle multiple priorities & deadlines, doing whatever is necessary to ensure company success. You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.

A desire to be a part of a high-performing, mission-driven team that operates with intense urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback.

Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

**What you'll get here:**
You'll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You'll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission. At Garner, you'll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It's demanding by design. You'll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.

**Compensation Transparency:**
The target salary range for this position is $150,000 - $175,000. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans, including but not limited to: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health and more.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:**
Garner Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. ### Job Description Job Description **Who we are** **:** Founded in 2001, Vivid Seats (NASDAQ: SEAT) is a leading online ticket marketplace committed to becoming the ultimate partner for connecting fans to the live events, artists, and teams they love. We believe in the power of experiences and are fiercely dedicated to building products that inspire human connections. Named as one of **Built** **In's** **top places to work in 2025** , we believe that our People are our greatest competitive advantage. To support our People, we have built a company culture that empowers our employees to embrace challenges, encourages unity through collaboration, and seeks to constantly evolve by leveraging data and inspiring innovation. We believe in harnessing emerging technology to power performance and unlock creativity. As part of our culture of innovation, we actively embrace the use of AI tools to enhance decision-making, improve workflows, and produce better outcomes for our customers. **The Opportunity:** **As a Senior Email Marketing Specialist** , you will play a critical role in delivering personalized customer experiences that connect fans with the events they love. As a member of the CRM team, you will be responsible for the hands-on execution, optimization, and quality assurance of email, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns across the customer lifecycle.  This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both the technical and strategic aspects of CRM marketing. You'll leverage Braze, Liquid templating, customer data, and HTML email development to build dynamic, personalized campaigns that drive engagement, app adoption, repeat purchases, and revenue growth.  As Vivid Seats continues to invest in our CRM and Customer Data Platform capabilities, you'll help scale sophisticated customer journeys, automation programs, and personalization strategies that reach millions of fans across multiple channels.  You will work alongside an experienced cross-functional team and have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on customer engagement and business performance.  **How your role contributes to the success of Vivid Seats:** - Data-fueled personalization: Leverage CRM technology, customer data, and Liquid scripting to create highly personalized email, push, and in-app experiences that increase engagement, repeat purchase behavior, and customer lifetime value. - Seamless multi-touch engagement: Build, deploy, and optimize dynamic customer journeys across email, push, and in-app channels, ensuring consistent and relevant experiences throughout the customer lifecycle. - Strategic execution: Partner with CRM, Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to deliver campaigns, automation programs, and personalization initiatives that drive app adoption, customer engagement, and revenue growth.  **How your role expectations will progress in the first 30, 90 and 180 days** **30 days in:** - Complete new hire orientation and gain the tools, resources, and context needed to be successful. - Learn how ticket marketplaces operate and how CRM contributes to customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue growth. - Become familiar with Vivid Seats' CRM architecture, audience segmentation strategy, and customer lifecycle programs.  **90 days in:** - Independently build, QA, and launch email, push, and in-app campaigns within Braze. - Contribute ideas, processes, and technical solutions for campaign efficiency. - Develop a strong understanding of Vivid Seats product categories and customer lifecycles. - Create and maintain dynamic content experiences using Liquid, customer attributes, catalogs, and behavioral data. - Troubleshoot rendering, personalization, segmentation, and campaign execution issues. - Prioritize projects while effectively collaborating with stakeholders across the org.  **180 days in:** - Own end-to-end execution of CRM campaigns, including audience configuration, personalization, QA, deployment, and performance analysis. - Build and maintain scalable customer journeys, triggered campaigns, and automated lifecycle programs within Braze. - Develop reusable content modules and personalization frameworks that improve campaign scalability and operational efficiency. - Contribute to promotional planning and lifecycle marketing strategies through a strong understanding of customer behavior and business objectives. - Partner with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to implement new initiatives and enhance customer experiences across channels.  **What You'll Bring:** - **5+ years** of experience executing CRM and lifecycle marketing campaigns. - **2+ years of hands-on experience building, coding and deploying campaigns within Braze.** - Proficiency with Liquid templates, conditional logic, personalization, and dynamic content. - Strong HTML and CSS email development skills with the ability to code, QA, troubleshoot, and modify responsive email templates without engineering support. - Experience building and maintaining Canvas journeys, triggered campaigns, audience segmentation, and dynamic messaging experiences within Braze. - Must be comfortable writing and editing HTML email code and Liquid logic directly within Braze. - Experience leveraging customer data platforms (CDPs) or APIs to support audience segmentation, personalization, and customer journey optimization. - Working knowledge of SQL, APIs, webhooks, and relational data structures is a plus. - Proven ability to build and deploy highly personalized customer communications at scale. - Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail. - Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage campaign performance. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across teams. - Candidates should be prepared to discuss prior experience building dynamic personalized campaigns using Liquid and HTML within Braze or a comparable platform.  **How We Operate - Position Summary Enhances the quality of life for our members/team members by meeting or exceeding their service expectations. Sr. Talent Acquisition Specialist \| eLocal Job Title: Senior Affiliate Manager/ Partnerships Manager
Location: Remote with travel to Philadelphia 1-2 times/ Quarter
eLocal, part of Brookfield Asset Management, is a fast-growing and profitable national leader in pay-for-performance digital advertising. We connect millions of local consumers each year to the businesses they need, when they need them. We are currently seeking a highly motivated and competitive Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager to join our team and drive our company's success through exceptional affiliate marketing campaigns.
**Position Overview:**
As a Senior Affiliate/Partnership Marketing Manager at eLocal, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our digital marketing efforts. You will be responsible for developing and implementing highly data-driven and analytical affiliate marketing campaigns that not only meet but exceed our performance objectives. Additionally, you will leverage your expertise in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and landing page development to optimize our affiliate strategies for maximum conversion rates. Your success in this role will be tied directly to the company's overall growth and profitability.
**Key Responsibilities:**
Increase Traffic and Sales: Develop and execute effective affiliate marketing strategies, resulting in a significant increase in traffic and a notable boost in sales.
Secure Favorable Terms: Successfully manage relationships with affiliate partners, negotiating terms that lead to improved partnership profitability.
Expand Affiliate Network: Attract and onboard new affiliate partners, leading to growth in the affiliate network and increased account success. Experience in driving Pay Per Call campaigns is a plus.
Optimize Campaign Performance: Monitor and analyze affiliate performance metrics, implementing data-driven optimizations that enhance campaign efficiency and increase ROI.
Enhance Conversion Rates: Collaborate with the CRO team to improve landing pages, resulting in higher conversion rates.
Maintain Competitive Edge: Stay current with industry trends and best practices, ensuring eLocal remains competitive and achieves consistent growth in affiliate-driven revenue.
**Qualifications:**
You are a driven marketer with a competitive spirit who thrives in a performance-based environment.
You have a proven history of successfully expanding affiliate programs to contribute over 20% of revenue.
Proven experience in affiliate marketing and managing affiliate programs. Experience in driving Pay Per Call campaigns is a plus.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to drive decision-making.
Expertise in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and landing page development.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
**Office Commute Requirement:**
The successful candidate must be willing to travel to Philadelphia 1-2 times per quarter as part of the role, with the primary location being remote. In addition, they must be available for travel four to five times per year for Affiliate Marketing Conferences.
Why Join eLocal?
We still use our Philly area office for meetings, collaboration, and socializing, but we are proudly a virtual-first environment. Since 2020, we have been a certified Great Place to Work with 91% of our employees saying that they would strongly recommend the organization to friends and family as a great place to work.
We offer an extremely generous benefits package that reflects our values:
Competitive base salary plus commission.
Heavily subsidized Medical through Blue Cross Blue Shield (85% to 100% company-paid), Dental, and Vision.
100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life/AD&D Insurance.
Monthly wellness stipend and Wellbeing Spending Account.
Flexible, uncapped paid time off.
401(k) with company match.
Extremely positive company culture – we work hard, but people enjoy working here and working together!
Work from home arrangements.

# Senior Partner Marketing Manager - Sage Intacct Advisory Practice

Sage Intacct

[Atlanta, GA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Atlanta%2C-GA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6320256914043336991?p=1&pos=0&rgn=10460&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4753101913662413101&crId=US_0US_0)

Job TitleSenior Partner Marketing Manager - Sage Intacct Advisory Practice
Job DescriptionCPA firms, outsourced accounting providers, BPOs, and fractional CFO firms are rethinking how they grow. Many are moving beyond traditional accounting services and building higher-value Client Advisory Services practices that depend on stronger technology, repeatable delivery models, and better client insights. Sage Intacct Advisory Practice sits directly in that shift. Sage Intacct is the only solution endorsed by the AICPA, giving Sage a strong credibility point with the accounting profession and a clear opportunity to help advisory firms build, scale, and grow with Sage Intacct.

As the Senior Partner Marketing Manager for the Sage Intacct Advisory Practice, you won’t just be marketing software- you’ll be helping accounting firms transform and grow their practices with Sage Intacct by developing and executing marketing strategies for select advisory partners across North America. This role focuses on engaging top CPA and BPO firms, supporting Client Advisory Services adoption, and creating targeted messaging, content, campaigns, and communications that help partner firms understand the value of Sage Intacct for their practice growth.

You will collaborate with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Partner Development, and other cross-functional teams to align partner and program initiatives with business priorities. You will also help define demand generation, lead capture, segmentation, and performance measurement approaches that connect partner marketing activity to partner engagement, pipeline development, services growth, marketing-qualified opportunities, marketing contribution to revenue, and return on marketing investment.

This is a strong fit for a channel marketer who understands how to engage senior leaders and practice influencers inside accounting and advisory firms, translate complex value propositions into clear partner-facing messaging, and build marketing programs that are practical, measurable, and relevant to the way advisory firms grow.

Location Requirement: Hybrid 3 days per week from either our Atlanta, Austin or Toronto office
Key ResponsibilitiesPartner Marketing Strategy and Execution

- Develop and execute a NA Sage Intacct Advisory partner marketing strategy for select partners aligned with regional business goals.
- Apply Account-Based Marketing strategies to engage top CPA and BPO firms to support firm growth and client advisory services adoption.
- Define and manage demand generation, lead capture, segmentation, and performance marketing measurements.
- Build and execute a to-partner communication strategy, including messaging, infrastructure and new customer acquisition campaigns.
- Create and manage partner-facing content and messaging including toolkits, positioning guides, and marketing best practices.
- Drive awareness and partner success through success stories, social and digital campaigns.

Partner Engagement and Enablement

- Build joint marketing plans with select partners and practice leaders to support sustained growth and adoption.
- Identify scalable, programmatic marketing tactics that increase partner engagement and effectiveness.
- Activate formal value propositions to align with the needs of practice leaders, users, and influencers inside assigned partner firms.
- Collaborate with product marketing, performance marketing, customer marketing and partner development leads aligning partner and program initiatives with business priorities.

Performance Measurement

- Track and report on key metrics including marketing-qualified opportunities (MQOs), marketing contribution to revenue, and return on marketing investment (ROMI).
- Ensure accurate forecasting and alignment of marketing investments to performance goals.

Minimum Qualifications

- 5 years of channel or partner marketing experience and at least 1 year experience within the accounting and financial management services industry.
- Demonstrated experience aligning campaign strategies to pipeline development, partner engagement, and services growth objectives.
