Full-time

Ooma

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5621122602265808128?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3354554596857354834&crId=US_0US_0)

Here at Ooma we empower people to connect in smarter ways. We do this by creating powerful communication experiences through our cloud-based platform to bring people together at work and at home. Our solutions help small business owners stay connected with their customers and manage their businesses from anywhere. For larger companies we provide customized unified communications solutions to meet their unique needs. At home, we help our customers connect with their loved ones by providing the #1 rated VoIP phone service available. We also provide them with peace of mind through our innovative smart home security solution. At Ooma, all our products and services are priced competitively, because we believe advanced technology should be accessible to all.

**About the Role:**

As Senior Partner Marketing Manager, you’ll develop and execute partner marketing plans that support our go-to-market strategy, with an initial focus on AirDial and enterprise communications solutions.

You’ll work closely with channel sales, strategic partners, distributors, technology alliances, and agents to build integrated go-to-market programs that help partners uncover opportunities, generate demand, and win customers. Your work will grow partner-led pipeline, deepen reseller engagement, and contribute to revenue growth.

You’ll bring channel marketing expertise, demand generation experience, and an understanding of B2B telecommunications, cloud communications, networking, or managed services to turn partner and market insights into effective campaigns and practical sales resources.

**What You’ll Do:**

In your first year, you’ll focus on growing partner-sourced pipeline, increasing partner engagement, and improving visibility into marketing’s contribution to revenue.

- Build annual and quarterly partner marketing plans that support Ooma’s revenue and growth priorities.
- Work with channel sales leaders to identify opportunities across partner segments, industries, and customer needs.
- Develop messaging and value propositions that help partners explain Ooma’s solutions and sell with confidence.
- Create integrated demand generation campaigns across email, digital channels, webinars, events, and content syndication, tailored to enterprise and mid-market buyers.
- Launch repeatable reseller marketing programs and ready-to-use campaign kits that increase partner participation and generate pipeline.
- Equip partners with practical sales resources, including playbooks, competitive battle cards, solution briefs, and presentations.
- Support partner onboarding, training, and certification to improve readiness, engagement, and use of marketing resources.
- Manage market development funds (MDF) and co-op marketing investments, refining spending based on partner participation, pipeline, and revenue.
- Establish reporting and attribution that connect marketing investment to partner-sourced pipeline and revenue.
- Bring partner feedback into cross-functional planning and align channel sales, marketing, and product teams around shared priorities.
- Use AI tools to support marketing activities and improve efficiency.

**Experience We’re Looking For:**

- Minimum 7 years of B2B marketing experience, including 5 years in partner, channel, alliance, or field marketing.
- Demonstrated success generating partner-sourced pipeline and contributing to revenue growth.
- Strong understanding of indirect sales models, including distributors, agents, VARs, MSPs, consultants, and strategic alliances.
- Hands-on experience developing and executing integrated demand generation campaigns.
- Proven ability to manage multiple projects, lead cross-functional initiatives, and move programs from planning through execution.
- Proficiency in measuring marketing ROI, pipeline contribution, and revenue outcomes.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present recommendations and results confidently to executives.
- Experience in telecommunications, UCaaS, networking, cloud, cybersecurity, or a related technology industry is a plus.
- Familiarity with enterprise technology buying cycles would be helpful.
- Experience managing MDF programs and partner marketing investments is preferred.
- Knowledge of channel operations, partner onboarding, and enablement frameworks would be an added advantage. #LI-CC1

**What We Offer:**

Working at Ooma means being a team player, while allowing your individual voice to come through. And, you'll receive competitive compensation, benefits and generous company perks.

- Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision insurance for you and eligible dependents
 - HMO, PPO’s or a PPO with a HDHP (including HSA, which Ooma helps fund)
- Employer Paid Income Protection Benefits (Basic Life and AD&D, Short- and Long-term disability)
- FSA Healthcare & Dependent Care
- Commuter Benefits
- Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Legal
- 401(k), including employer match, and Roth
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
- Paid Time off, Sick Time, as well as corporate holidays observed
- Employee Assistance Program
- Life Balance benefits with Travel Assistance Services and Identity Theft
- Additional Benefits include a Discount Program, Credit Union, Medicare Assistance, etc.

For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions. From agriculture to energy to weather intelligence, our proprietary Operational Decisioning Platform transforms raw data into decision-grade insights—enabling companies to optimize supply chains, ensure market stability, and safeguard infrastructure against disruption. We don’t follow trends—we set the standard for precision, trust, and operational impact. DTN is at an exciting inflection point. Our purpose-built solutions—powered by AI and honed by decades of vertical expertise—are helping some of the world’s most significant enterprises thrive amid operational constraints and uncover new opportunities in a fast-changing world.
Job Description: DTN is seeking a strategic, results-driven Senior Partner Marketing Manager to lead the marketing strategy and execution for our partner ecosystem, including technology alliances, resellers, system integrators (SIs), and strategic distribution partners. In this highly visible role, you will work at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing to develop programs, content, and campaigns that transform partner relationships into measurable pipeline and revenue growth. You will own partner marketing initiatives from strategy through execution, including joint go-to-market planning, partner enablement, co-branded campaigns, and performance measurement. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with a hands‑on approach to execution. You will bring strong relationship‑building skills, a builder mentality, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives while collaborating effectively across internal teams and external partners.

Own the annual partner marketing calendar, coordinating co-branded campaigns, webinars, industry events, digital placements, and partner communications
Manage the partner marketing budget and Market Development Funds (MDF), including allocation, co-op fund administration, ROI measurement, and leadership reporting
Develop high-quality co-branded marketing and sales enablement materials, including solution briefs, competitive battlecards, joint case studies, email campaigns, social assets, and customer-facing integration stories
Build and maintain a partner enablement portal offering on-demand training, product updates, and sales resources while driving partner engagement and adoption
Collaborate with Product Marketing to translate product releases, technical capabilities, and competitive positioning into compelling partner-ready messaging
Plan and execute joint demand generation programs, including digital campaigns, webinars, account-based marketing (ABM), trade show sponsorships, regional roadshows, and virtual events
Partner with alliance sales teams and DTN's field sales organization to align marketing activities with pipeline targets, accelerate deal velocity, and support revenue growth
Define, track, and report partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, presenting performance insights and recommendations to the VP of Product Marketing and Senior Director, Partnership Leader
Serve as the primary marketing liaison to the Channel & Alliances team, supporting partner recruitment, tiering, program benefits, and ecosystem growth
Collaborate with Revenue Operations to ensure accurate partner pipeline attribution, tracking, and reporting within Salesforce
Work closely with Demand Generation, Content, and Product Marketing to integrate partner initiatives into broader company campaigns
Lead partner communications, including monthly newsletters, product launch announcements, and executive briefings
What You Will Bring to the Position 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, including at least 3 years in partner, channel, or alliance marketing
Demonstrated success building and scaling partner marketing programs that generate measurable pipeline within a $100M+ B2B software or data business
Strong understanding of partner and channel ecosystems, including resellers, value-added resellers (VARs), system integrators, global system integrators (GSIs), and technology alliances
Experience developing SaaS partner ecosystems, including relationships with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and other major technology partners, as well as migration-focused marketing campaigns
Proven experience managing Market Development Funds (MDF), including budgeting, co-op fund administration, and ROI measurement
Excellent written communication and content development skills, with experience creating compelling co-branded marketing materials and partner-facing collateral
Hands‑on experience using Salesforce for pipeline management, HubSpot for campaign execution, and partner portal platforms
Strong analytical capabilities, including dashboard development, funnel analysis, pipeline attribution, and communicating performance insights to senior leadership
Strategic thinking and the ability to connect partner marketing initiatives to measurable business outcomes
A builder mentality, with the ability to create structure, develop processes, and execute effectively in a high-growth environment
Exceptional collaboration, influencing, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish strong partnerships across internal teams and external organizations
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously, execute with urgency, and consistently deliver on commitments
Data-driven decision-making skills, with a commitment to accurate reporting and continuous program improvement
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
What Will Make You Stand Out Experience in B2B data, analytics, agriculture technology, energy, or supply chain industries
Familiarity with cloud marketplace co-selling programs involving AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience marketing AI/ML-enabled products and translating technical capabilities into compelling partner-facing messaging
Experience working within an organization scaling from $200M to $500M+ in annual revenue

# Senior Partner Marketing Manager

$100k - $140k

Celigo

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.
We're looking for a strategic alliance marketer to serve as Celigo's face to our most important technology partners, and as the internal leader who brings Celigo's full marketing organization to each partnership. You'll work across two large organizations with different goals, find the win-win paths, and orchestrate Celigo's demand gen, content, PMM, and field teams to execute against a shared agenda. The partner's reach is an asset you're there to harness for Celigo. Celigo's resources and execution are what you bring to the table.
The right person is a strategic thinker and cross-functional leader who can hold their own at the partner table while rallying internal teams, equally comfortable influencing Celigo leadership and navigating a large partner org.
What would you do if hired? Lead co-marketing for strategic alliance partners. You're Celigo's face to partners like AWS, Microsoft, Shopify, and SAP, and the internal champion who aligns Celigo's demand gen, content, PMM, and field teams around a shared alliance agenda. Translate partner go-to-market priorities into co-marketing programs that generate pipeline for Celigo.
Develop joint value propositions and messaging. Work with Celigo's PMM team to craft partner-specific messaging that articulates how Celigo and each alliance solve customer problems together. Ensure it's consistent across landing pages, one-pagers, event assets, and sales materials.
Manage co-marketing funds and MDF. Own the planning, execution, and reconciliation of co-marketing budgets. Track spend, ensure compliance with partner program requirements, and maximize ROI.
Drive partner-sourced demand generation. Design and run demand gen programs through partner channels. Including marketplace listings, campaigns, co-hosted webinars, partner newsletters, and joint paid media, that generate net-new pipeline for Celigo.
Enable partner sales and solutions teams. Coordinate with Celigo's PMM and content teams to develop the materials partner field teams need, including solution briefs, battle cards, and joint pitch materials tailored to each alliance's audience.
Represent Celigo at partner-hosted events and marketplaces. Coordinate Celigo's participation in alliance-driven moments. Manage content submissions, event presence, and marketplace listing optimization.
Track and report on alliance marketing performance. Own the metrics: pipeline influenced, leads sourced through partner channels, MDF utilization, and co-sell activity. Surface insights to alliance and marketing leadership on a regular cadence.
Serve as the marketing POC for alliance partner teams. Build relationships with marketing counterparts at each strategic partner. Coordinate joint planning cycles, respond to partner requests, and keep programs moving.
Who are we looking for? Skills & Abilities
Demonstrated ability to find win-win paths between two large organizations with different goals. This is a differentiator: building programs two complex orgs both want to invest in takes a different kind of thinking than running a campaign.
Skilled at navigating large partner organizations: finding the right counterparts, building relationships across teams, and getting programs over the finish line.
Fluent in demand generation tactics: digital campaigns, webinars, content syndication, marketplace optimization, and field events.
Strong written communication: You can write a joint value proposition that is crisp, not committee-speak.
Comfortable with data: you track programs in CRM or marketing automation, understand pipeline influence, and can build a report without help.
Familiarity with iPaaS, integration, or ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Salesforce, SAP, etc.) is a plus.
Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable managing multiple partner relationships simultaneously.
Education & Experience
7+ years of B2B marketing experience, including at least 2 years focused on partner, alliance, or channel marketing in a SaaS environment.
Hands-on experience with one or more major platform ecosystems: AWS (Marketplace, Co-Sell, ISV Accelerate), Microsoft (AppSource, IP Co-Sell, Partner Center), SAP (PartnerEdge), Shopify (Partner Program), or a comparable enterprise platform.
Proven track record of co-marketing programs that produced measurable pipeline, not just activity.

# Paid Social Senior Strategist

$95k - $115k

Full-time

Tinuiti

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5467129008174485956?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6104363601614587184&crId=US_0US_0)

## **Who we are:** Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

## **We’d love to hear from you if:**

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a **Paid Social Senior Strategist** , you will lead full‑funnel Paid Social strategy and day‑to‑day performance (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest Performance+, Snapchat, Reddit; LinkedIn/X as relevant) to grow new customers, revenue, and LTV—while keeping efficiency on track. You’ll turn data and creative learnings into clear decisions, run smart innovations, and scale winning ideas. You’ll use automation and Bliss Point insights to focus spend where it works best, and you’ll partner closely with Creative, Analytics, Product/Bliss Point, and Client Leadership in your Pod. You’ll also mentor Specialist and Senior Specialist teammates and turn best practices into repeatable playbooks.

**Key responsibilities**

**Client‑Centric**

- Turn executive business goals into a growth‑focused Paid Social plan across prospecting, retargeting, and loyalty; set expectations, offer clear options/trade‑offs, and secure alignment.
- Lead QBR stories that connect media to business impact (revenue, CAC, LTV) and handle high‑stakes adjustments with trust and transparency.

**The Tinuiti Way**

- Pair deep Paid Social craft (creative, audience, signal quality) with growing multi‑channel understanding (Search, Commerce, CRM, Creative); teach clients and teammates and codify reusable playbooks.
- Connect the dots across channels for clients: explain how Social works with Search, Commerce/Retail Media, Lifecycle, TV/Audio, and Creative; propose simple, integrated plans (who does what, when, and why) and a measurement approach to prove combined lift (MMM/lift where feasible; clear proxy reads otherwise).


**Product‑Led**

- Orchestrate platform features and automation to unlock growth (e.g., Meta Advantage+/value optimization/CAPI, TikTok Smart Performance, Pinterest Performance+); pilot safely, measure, then scale.
- Apply Bliss Point insights (Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights, Brand Equity) to guide budgets, innovations, and creative/audience bets; provide structured feedback to improve tools.

**Data & Measurement‑Driven**

- Design sound lift/holdout tests when feasible (or strong powered A/Bs), define success thresholds up front, and maintain a steady read cadence; forecast expected impact and risk.
- Keep signals healthy and reliable (pixel/CAPI, event mapping/priorities, UTMs/GA4); explain data caveats when recommending changes and reallocation.

**Owner Mindset**

- Think and act like an owner: spot recurring waste across accounts, fix the root cause, and set simple standards the team can keep.
- Raise the bar, together: coach reliable routines (prep, review, follow‑through), share before/after results, and turn wins into easy-to-use playbooks.

**Ways of working and values**

- **Greatness attracts** Greatness: Operate at a high craft standard, seek feedback, and embrace technology/AI.
- **Clients grow, we grow:** Lead with innovation, precision, and proof—anchored to business outcomes.
- **Culture of ownership:** Act with speed, eliminate waste, and hold yourself accountable end‑to‑end.

**Professional & Technical Qualifications**

- Experience: 7+ years managing Paid Social at scale across Meta and TikTok; experience with Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit, LinkedIn, or X is a plus.
- Hands‑on with: Meta Advantage+/value optimization/CAPI; TikTok Smart Performance; Pinterest Performance+; creative testing frameworks; audience design/signals; basic catalog/DPA for social commerce.
- Technical: Comfortable with GA4 and platform analytics; can design tests, define success, forecast outcomes, and connect media to revenue, CAC, and LTV.
- Communication and leadership: Executive‑ready storytelling, expectation setting, and conflict resolution; demonstrated mentorship of P2–P3 talent.

**KPIs**

- **Growth:** Increase qualified reach, new‑customer acquisition, revenue, and LTV from Paid Social.
- **Creative:** Faster “innovation” cycles with a higher creative win rate; reduce fatigue.
- **Audience and signal** : Expand high‑intent audiences; improve pixel/CAPI/event health; fewer “limited learning” cases.
- **Innovation cadence** : Plan and adopt a steady flow of practical innovations (creative, audience, bidding, format); record decisions and learnings.
- **Product/AI adoption** : Pilot and scale automation and Bliss Point–guided allocations with proven, incremental impact.
- **Efficiency (guardrail)** : Hold or improve CAC/ROAS while growing profitable volume.

The hiring salary range for this role is $120,000-$140,000. We also offer an incentive pay program (RevShare) comprising a monthly variable revenue payment opportunity and a discretionary annual performance bonus.

The role is hybrid in New York City only.

Hiring salaries are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, parity with other team members, and alignment with market data. Our power is at the intersection of Connections, Creative and Commerce – that’s what is in our DNA. By harvesting insights and utilizing audience data, we work with our clients to develop scroll-stopping content and creative that performs and elevates the brands we work with across all digital media platforms. Our people are energized by challenges and sprint to find unorthodox solutions. We plan, activate and measure as one team, and we’re not afraid to push boundaries and test our way to success. Coders are Relentless, Gritty, Nimble humans who are always striving to be better. With teams across the U.S., you’ll find more than a job at Code3. You’ll find a place to grow, make an impact, and do your best work alongside a team that’s invested in your success. _Eastern Time Zone preferred_ **The Opportunity** As a Senior Paid Social Strategist, you'll serve as the strategic lead across a portfolio of clients, helping shape how some of today's most recognizable consumer brands grow through paid social platforms including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube. You'll develop full funnel media strategies, uncover new testing opportunities, guide creative direction through performance insights, and translate complex data into clear business recommendations. You'll partner closely with client strategy, measurement, creative, and platform teams to deliver integrated solutions that move beyond campaign performance and drive measurable business growth. Success in this role requires equal parts analytical thinking, creative curiosity, and commercial acumen. You'll understand not only how campaigns perform, but why they perform – and how consumer behavior, creative, cultural moments, and emerging platform capabilities can create new opportunities for your clients. Understand consumer trends, cultural moments, and platform behaviors to help brands show up in relevant and authentic ways. - Collaborate with internal teams and platform partners to bring innovative ideas to clients, including alpha/beta opportunities, new measurement solutions, and emerging platform capabilities. - Stay ahead of platform updates, retail and eCommerce trends, and competitive activity to identify opportunities before they become best practice. - Lead the creation of clear, compelling storytelling through presentations, POVs, and executive-ready performance summaries. - Mentor junior team members and help elevate strategic thinking and execution across the team. **Who will love this role** : - A self-starter who brings structure and clarity to ambiguity - A naturally curious strategist who loves understanding why people buy – not just how campaigns perform - ## **Senior Brand Marketing Manager**

### **About Cowboy Colostrum**

Cowboy Colostrum is a female-founded supplement brand making high-integrity, ethically sourced bovine colostrum for hair, gut, immune, skin and muscle health. We launched nationwide at Target in October 2026 and are growing the line with new products and flavors. Our team is creative, collaborative and moves fast, and most of our marketing team joined within the last year.

### **The role**

The Senior Brand Marketing Manager leads brand planning and integrated marketing for Cowboy Colostrum. You will turn brand strategy into campaigns, launch plans, retail programs and innovation recommendations that build the brand and grow the business, working closely with the creative, growth, influencer, retail and operations teams. The role fits someone who combines strategic thinking, creative judgment and commercial sense with strong execution, and who can lead complex projects independently.

### **What you'll do**

You will own how Cowboy shows up everywhere a customer meets the brand, and make sure each launch and campaign is clear, consistent and measurable.

- Lead integrated campaigns from strategy through results, owning the objectives, the alignment across teams and the outcome.
- Turn brand strategy into clear briefs and go-to-market plans for each launch, from positioning through channel readiness, launch and post-launch review.
- Keep messaging consistent across paid and organic social, email, out of home, podcast, experiential and in-store.
- Work with the retail and sales teams on in-store and shopper materials, such as signage, displays, retailer-specific offers and digital retail ads.
- Build retailer-facing presentations, sales sheets and campaign recaps for partners such as Target.
- Work with operations so packaging, production timelines and marketing plans line up with retail execution.
- Help shape innovation: spot consumer and category opportunities, research emerging benefits, formats, flavors and ingredients, and develop concepts and positioning.
- Use consumer research, category data and sales data to guide decisions and recommend next steps.
- Direct creative with the design team, and manage agency and freelance partners, briefs and brand budgets.
- Keep projects on track with the teams involved, and flag risks, dependencies and decisions early so they get resolved.
- Maintain brand tracking: KPI dashboards, the brand budget, the innovation timeline and launch schedules.
- Follow industry trends, consumer behavior and competitors so the brand stays relevant.
- Support broader marketing work as needed to grow the brand.

### **What you bring**

We are looking for a brand marketer who has led integrated campaigns and national retail launches, and who combines strategy, creative judgment and commercial sense.

- 6+ years in brand marketing, ideally in CPG, nutrition, wellness or lifestyle.
- A track record of leading integrated campaigns across several channels and teams.
- Experience developing new product concepts and go-to-market plans, including national retail launches with a retailer such as Target, Walmart or Amazon.
- Experience with consumer insights, and with supporting cross-functional campaign development and management.
- Proven ability to manage projects end to end.
- Strong skill in building brand presentations and post-campaign reports.
- Strong presenting skills with internal teams, external partners and leadership.
- Experience with retail partners, trade marketing, trade shows and asset management.
- A bachelor's degree in marketing, communications or a related field, or equivalent experience.

### **How you work**

You are a strategist who also gets things done, and you do your best work on a fast-moving team.

- You can move a workstream forward on your own, and you know when to bring in leadership.
- You turn cultural and consumer insights into ideas that people remember and that move the business.
- You connect consumer insight, creative ideas and business results, and can explain why a plan makes sense.
- You are organized and analytical, with an eye for detail, so deadlines and details do not get missed.
- You communicate clearly and keep teams aligned and informed.
- You can turn sales, category and consumer data into clear recommendations.
- You are comfortable managing several product lines at once while keeping the brand cohesive.
- You are curious about culture and consumer trends, and genuinely excited about health and wellness.
- You stay calm and flexible when priorities shift, and bring a positive, solutions-oriented attitude.

# Programmatic Senior Account Executive Holdco

Location:New YorkCompany:Klever

## Description:

**SENIOR ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE — HOLDCO**

We are Klever, The Human Ad Tech Company. We are looking for a driven, full-cycle Senior Account Executive to join our team and help accelerate new business growth within our holding company ("Holdco") business. In this role, you will work in close partnership with our VP of Strategic Holdco Sales to identify, pursue, and close new revenue opportunities across major advertising holding companies (e.g. WPP, Publicis, Omnicom, IPG, Dentsu, Havas, Stagwell) and their agency networks and trading desks.

The ideal candidate is a consultative new-business hunter with exceptional communication and organizational skills, who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced, quota-driven environment. You will run the full sales cycle end to end — from prospecting through close — building relationships across trading desks, agency brands, and brand marketers to unlock new Holdco opportunities and hit aggressive new business revenue targets.

Beyond running deals, you will act as the strategist behind your Holdco book of business — proactively building and maintaining a structured account growth plan for each priority agency (existing business health, new business targets, key contacts, travel, and next steps), rather than waiting to be told where to focus.

- Own the full sales cycle for new Holdco business: prospecting, discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.
- Convert qualified meetings with Holdco trading desks, agency brands, and brand marketers into pipeline and closed revenue.
- Partner closely with the VP of Strategic Holdco Sales to develop and execute account strategies for target Holdco groups, agency brands, and buyer personas.
- Prospect and build relationships across trading desk leads, agency planners, and brand teams within target Holdco accounts (WPP, Publicis, Omnicom, IPG, Dentsu, Havas, Stagwell, etc.), identifying net-new logos and net-new agency/brand relationships.
- Run consultative sales conversations with media buyers, agencies, and brand marketers, translating client needs into Klever's Movement Intelligence / Proximity value proposition.
- Craft and deliver winning proposals in response to Holdco-level RFPs, RFQs, and RFIs, often under tight, high-stakes timelines.
- Partner with RevOps for pipeline reporting, forecasting, and deal progression tracking within Salesforce.
- Hit quarterly and annual new business revenue targets, maintaining accurate pipeline coverage and forecast discipline.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Management, Trading, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure a smooth handoff and onboarding of newly closed Holdco business.
- Represent Klever at industry conferences, Holdco events, and in-market visits, serving as an ambassador for the brand.
- Travel regularly (approx. 20–40%) to meet Holdco stakeholders in person and attend pitch meetings and industry events across multiple markets.


This role is not just a hunter seat — you will be the strategist behind each Holdco agency relationship, proactively building and owning the account plan rather than waiting for direction from the VP of Strategic Holdco Sales.

- Build and maintain a rolling 90-day account growth plan for each priority Holdco agency, covering existing business health, new business target accounts, key contacts, and next steps — reviewed and refreshed with the VP of Strategic Holdco Sales each quarter.
- Map existing business status account-by-account (renewals, flight timing, QBR cadence, expansion opportunities) alongside a live new-business target list with decision makers and meeting stage.
- Proactively identify the right decision maker within each target account and the warm-introduction path to reach them, rather than waiting on inbound interest.
- Build and prioritize a travel calendar around account value and deal stage — in-market visits, QBRs, wrap meetings, and target-account pitches — and come prepared with a clear objective for each trip.
- Own the QBR and campaign-wrap cadence for assigned accounts, using performance data to build the case for renewal, budget expansion, or a new test opportunity.
- Translate account learnings into a running set of next steps and key actions, tracked and reported on a monthly/quarterly cycle so the VP of Strategic Holdco Sales always has visibility into where each account and target stands.


- 4–7 years of experience in programmatic/ad tech new business sales; direct experience selling into or working with advertising holding companies (WPP, Publicis, Omnicom, IPG, Dentsu, Havas, Stagwell, etc.) strongly preferred.
- Proven track record of independently running a full sales cycle and hitting new business revenue targets.
- Strong consultative sales skills; comfortable running discovery, demos, and negotiations with media buyers, agencies, and brand marketers.
- Proven ability to build relationships and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder Holdco organizations.
- Working knowledge of programmatic channels (display, native, audio, CTV/OTT/OLV, DOOH) and DSPs (TTD, DV360 preferred).
- Data-driven and analytical; skilled at building account strategies for target verticals and buyer personas.
- Proficiency in Salesforce or other CRM platforms for pipeline and forecast tracking.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong proposal-writing ability.
- Willingness to travel domestically, and occasionally internationally, to meet Holdco stakeholders.
- Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, quota-driven, travel-inclusive environment; adapts quickly to new tools and the evolving media landscape.
- Strong account-planning instincts — comfortable structuring a multi-account territory into a clear, prioritized plan (existing business, new business targets, key contacts, travel, next steps) without being told to.
- Proactive and organized; tracks a large number of concurrent relationships and next steps across multiple agency offices without dropping follow-through.

Senior Paid Media Manager, Lofi

About Lofi

Lofi is the AI platform that connects the entire paid media workflow end to end for multi-location brands and franchises. We're building the new way to run performant, localized ads. This role isn't about slotting into a machine that already runs, it's about helping build it. You'll have a direct hand in shaping how paid media gets managed as the industry shifts toward AI-driven operations, working alongside a great team with real ownership and real influence over where the product and the practice go next.

The role

We're looking for a Paid MediaManager who is a hands-on operator: someone who builds and runs campaigns themselves, brings ideas without being asked, takes full ownership of outcomes, and can hold their own in front of the most sophisticated paid media clients.

This is an IC role, not a people-management role. You'll be in the platform every day, optimizing accounts and presenting results directly to clients, marketers who know paid media well and expect to be educated, not just served. You'll also be one of the people shaping how Lofi's platform evolves, with a front-row seat in transforming the industry.

Who you are

- A proactive doer who is full of ideas and takes ownership end to end. You don't wait for direction; you spot opportunities and act.
- An exceptionally sharp communicator and presenter. You can walk a sophisticated client through performance, strategy, and trade-offs and leave them more informed and more confident.
- Comfortable being the expert in the room. You can educate seasoned in-house marketers, not just execute for them.

- Thrives in a fast-paced, early-stage environment and operates well with autonomy.

- Plan, launch, optimize, and scale campaigns hands-on across paid search (Google, Bing), paid social (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.), CTV (MNTN, Hulu, etc.), Digital Audio (Spotify, Pandora, etc.), display/programmatic, retargeting, and CRO.
- Use Lofi's AI-powered platform as leverage, letting automation, predictive modeling, automated bidding, and creative optimization handle the grunt work so you can operate at a higher level across more accounts.
- Translate AI-generated insights and performance data into actionable strategy and clear client recommendations.
- Own client relationships and reporting: build dashboards, present results, and serve as the expert clients trust.
- Manage and allocate budgets across channels based on performance and growth opportunities; forecast and recommend where to scale or reallocate.
- Run A/B tests and experiments across channels, creative, and messaging, and act on KPIs like CAC, ROAS, LTV, and conversion rates.
- Shape the product: feed insights from the front lines back into how the platform works and where it goes next.

What we're looking for

- 5+ years in Paid Media with hands-on, at-scale multi-channel paid media management.
- Deep command of performance marketing, attribution, and analytics.
- Proven ability to manage sophisticated clients and present with authority.
- Proficiency with Google Analytics, ad platforms, CRM systems, and marketing automation tools.
- Experience using AI for paid media workflows.

Location

NYC preferred; remote considered for the right person.

Compensation

$130,000–$170,000 annually for NYC-based hires, depending on experience. Compensation for remote hires will be adjusted based on location. Open to contract arrangements.

# Senior Performance Marketing Manager (Brooklyn)

Location:Flatbush, NYCompany:Liberty Home Guard

## Description:

**Title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (Paid Search, Paid Social, Video & Attribution)**

**The Impact You Will Have:**

Liberty Home Guard is the country's fastest-growing and best-rated home warranty provider, named U.S. News Best Home Warranty Company Overall for 2026-27. We are seeking a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to own the strategy, execution, and measurement of our paid acquisition program across paid search (Google Ads and Microsoft Ads), paid social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and similar platforms), digital video (YouTube), and Connected TV (CTV) bought programmatically through a demand-side platform. Paid search is the foundation of the program; CTV, paid social, and video are how we build demand above it, and multi-touch attribution is how we hold every channel to the same standard. This is a hands-on role for a marketer who is equally comfortable inside an ad account and inside a spreadsheet: someone who has managed substantial budgets, treats attribution and incrementality as core parts of the job rather than reporting afterthoughts, and stays ahead of a rapidly changing paid media landscape.

The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience managing Google Ads and Microsoft Ads campaigns, has bought and optimized Connected TV through a DSP, has run paid social and video campaigns, has successfully overseen six-figure monthly advertising budgets, and understands how to drive measurable growth while maintaining strong return on ad spend (ROAS). This person will also own our multi-touch attribution platform (Hyros) and will be the one the leadership team relies on to answer what is actually working. Home services or home warranty industry experience is a significant advantage.

The right candidate is both strategic and highly tactical: passionate about performance marketing, energized by testing and learning, and comfortable making data-driven decisions that directly affect business growth. You will manage the day-to-day optimization of campaigns across every paid channel and lead the larger strategic work of helping multiple service lines grow through paid media. In practice, you will be the marketing team's quantitative expert: the owner of how we measure, attribute, and evaluate every paid dollar we spend.

**Your duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:**

- Develop, execute, and optimize paid search campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and other relevant platforms.
- Manage monthly paid media budgets exceeding $100,000 across search, social, and video while maximizing lead quality, conversion volume, and return on investment.
- Create and execute campaign strategies across multiple service lines, geographic markets, and business objectives.
- Continuously monitor campaign performance, identifying opportunities to improve CTR, Quality Score, conversion rates, CPL, CPA, and ROAS.
- Conduct ongoing keyword research, competitive analysis, audience segmentation, and bidding optimization.
- Build and test ad copy, creative, landing page recommendations, audience strategies, and campaign structures through disciplined A/B and holdout testing.
- Analyze performance data using Hyros, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and other reporting tools.
- Stay current on emerging search trends, AI-driven search experiences, automation, Performance Max, changes in Google's advertising ecosystem, developments across paid social and streaming video platforms, and evolving best practices.
- Collaborate with SEO, creative, web development, sales, and leadership teams to ensure integrated digital marketing strategies.
- Produce clear reporting and actionable insights for leadership with recommendations for continued growth.
- Ensure accurate conversion tracking, offline and phone-sale conversion imports, attribution, and campaign measurement across all paid channels.
- Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), extending to TikTok, Pinterest, and similar platforms as the business warrants.
- Plan, launch, and optimize digital video campaigns on YouTube, including audience definition, creative sequencing, and view-through and search-lift measurement.
- Own our Connected TV program end to end: manage buys through our CTV demand-side platform partner, define household and geographic targeting against our customer profile, set reach and frequency goals, manage publisher and app inventory mix, rotate and test creative, and control pacing and spend.
- Measure CTV on incrementality rather than platform attribution: design and read geo holdouts and ghost-bid tests, track branded search and direct traffic lift on a lag, reconcile vendor readouts against our own CRM and analytics data, and make scale, hold, or pause recommendations on that evidence.
- Own our multi-touch attribution platform (Hyros): maintain the tracking implementation and cost-data integrations, audit data integrity, and produce journey-level reporting on cost per acquisition, ROAS, and lead-to-sale conversion by channel.
- Design and run incrementality tests (geo holdouts, ghost bids, platform lift studies) for upper-funnel channels, and distinguish true incremental contribution from platform-attributed results before budget decisions are made.
- Build and maintain the weekly and monthly paid performance reporting framework for leadership, and serve as the team's quantitative authority on what is working, what is not, and why.
- Manage relationships with media platforms, agency partners, and measurement vendors, and evaluate new channel and vendor proposals against a consistent measurement standard.

**Requirements:**

- 5+ years of hands-on PPC/Paid Search experience managing performance marketing campaigns.
- Proven success managing monthly paid media budgets of $100,000+.
- Deep expertise with Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and Meta Ads Manager.
- Strong understanding of bidding strategies, attribution models and their limitations, incrementality measurement, audience targeting, conversion optimization, and campaign automation.
- Experience managing campaigns across multiple brands, business units, or service lines simultaneously.
- Exceptional analytical skills, with the statistical judgment to separate real performance changes from noise and turn data into decisions.
- Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for modeling and analysis, including building auditable, formula-driven reports.
- Excellent communication and project management skills.
- Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
- Hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns, Meta at minimum, with TikTok or Pinterest a plus.
- Hands-on experience planning, buying, and optimizing Connected TV campaigns through a demand-side platform (for example Vibe, The Trade Desk, StackAdapt, MNTN, or comparable), including household targeting, frequency management, inventory selection, and creative rotation.
- Working understanding of how CTV is measured: view-through and impression-to-visit attribution, branded search and direct traffic lift, geo holdout and lift-study design, and the limits of platform-reported results.
- Experience managing YouTube or other digital video campaigns alongside search and social.
- Experience implementing and operating a multi-touch attribution platform (Hyros, Northbeam, Triple Whale, or comparable), including pixel and server-side tracking and cost-data integrations.
- Experience designing or interpreting incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies) and communicating results clearly to non-technical leadership.

- Experience generating high-volume lead generation campaigns.
- Familiarity with CRM integrations, call tracking platforms, and offline conversion tracking, particularly for phone-led sales models.
- Experience with Local Services Ads (LSAs).
- Experience with AI-powered campaign optimization tools and automation workflows.
- Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or R for data analysis.
- Experience running CTV alongside a brand search program and quantifying the relationship between the two.
- Familiarity with CTV and streaming inventory sources (Hulu, Tubi, Pluto TV, Roku, Sling, Peacock and similar) and their audience profiles.
- Experience producing or briefing 15- and 30-second video creative for TV and streaming placements.
- Familiarity with media mix modeling or marketing econometrics.

Marshall Advertising, one of Florida’s largest independent media buying agencies, is seeking an experienced Senior Media Buyer to join our team in Tampa.

You should be comfortable managing a high volume of campaigns and significant client budgets while balancing deadlines, maintaining accuracy, and providing thoughtful recommendations.

\\n

\\n

AI, automation, and modern tools are part of how we work. We’re looking for buyers who are curious about new technology and comfortable using AI tools and large language models (LLMs) to support research, analysis, reporting, and everyday workflows. You don’t need to be a developer, but you should be willing to experiment, check outputs for accuracy, and use sound judgment when handling client information.

\\n

$95k

Full-time

Koola Logistics

[Carmel, IN](https://jooble.org/jobs/Carmel%2C-IN)

Director of Marketing

**Compensation: Up to $95,000 per year in total compensation, based on experience and results.** The offer will include a base salary and a performance bonus tied to agreed, measurable goals.

**Freight Is the Vehicle. People Are the Mission.**

**At Koola Logistics, we’re building a company where ambitious people can create careers, provide for their families, and grow as leaders.**

**We started in 2019 with four desks in one room. Today, we’re entering a new stage of growth, and we’re hiring a Director of Marketing** to build the systems that help us reach more customers and attract great people.

**Read this before applying:** This is a hands-on growth marketing role. We need someone who has built campaigns, improved website conversion, tracked where leads came from, and used the results to make better decisions. Social media, design, and storytelling matter here, but they support the larger goal: **qualified customer opportunities, strong recruiting pipelines, and measurable business growth.**

**You will work directly with our founder and leadership team and help build Koola’s marketing function from the ground up.**

What You Will Own

**Customer growth and lead generation**

- Build campaigns that put Koola in front of the right shippers and decision-makers.
- Work with sales leadership to define a qualified opportunity and track it from first contact through sales follow-up.
- Test channels and messages, measure lead quality, and invest more in what produces real opportunities.
- Create landing pages, email campaigns, case studies, and sales tools brokers will use.

**Website, SEO, and paid campaigns**

- Own the website as a tool for generating and converting customer and recruiting interest.
- Improve search visibility, landing pages, forms, calls to action, and conversion rates.
- Build and manage Google Ads and other paid campaigns where they make economic sense.
- Report on traffic, leads, qualified opportunities, cost, and conversion.

**Marketing systems and measurement**

- Connect marketing activity to our CRM and recruiting processes.
- Put lead tracking, routing, automation, and follow-up systems in place.
- Build a simple dashboard showing where opportunities and candidates came from, what happened next, and what marketing contributed.
- Establish clear baselines so we can measure improvement over time.

**Recruiting marketing**

- Partner with HR and leadership to attract experienced freight brokers and other priority hires.
- Build targeted campaigns, landing pages, and follow-up processes.
- Measure qualified applicants and interviews by source.

**Brand and content**

- Define Koola’s message and build a consistent brand across customer, carrier, employee, and candidate touchpoints.
- Turn our people, customer work, leadership perspective, and company growth into useful content.
- Own the content calendar and coordinate writing, video, photography, design, and outside vendors as needed.
- Build a stronger presence for Koola and its leadership.

What We’re Looking For

- Experience owning **digital marketing campaigns with measurable lead generation results** .
- Strong working knowledge of website conversion, SEO, paid search, email marketing, CRM systems, and analytics.
- Specific examples of campaigns you ran, what you measured, what changed, and the business result.
- Experience working closely with a sales team and improving lead quality and follow-up.
- Comfort building the strategy **and** doing the work while the function is small.
- Strong writing and judgment. You can make complicated services easy for customers to understand.
- Ability to direct creative work and vendors, whether or not you personally produce every graphic or video.

B2B, logistics, transportation, recruiting, or another sales-driven industry experience is a plus.

- **When you apply, tell us about one campaign or marketing system you built. What was the goal, what did you personally own, how did you track it, and what business result did it produce?** Portfolios of graphics or social posts are welcome, but we’re most interested in the results behind the work.

Overview
We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Digital Marketing Director to lead our digital marketing strategies and elevate our brand presence across all online channels. In this pivotal role, you will craft compelling campaigns, optimize digital assets, and harness data-driven insights to drive growth, engagement, and conversions. Your expertise will shape our digital footprint, ensuring we stay ahead in a competitive landscape while inspiring teams to achieve ambitious marketing goals. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate leader eager to make a measurable impact through cutting-edge digital marketing initiatives.

Duties

Develop and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with business objectives, focusing on brand awareness, lead generation, and customer engagement.

Oversee the creation and management of multi-channel campaigns across SEO, SEM (Search Engine Marketing), social media marketing, email marketing, and display advertising platforms such as Google Ads and Facebook Advertising.

Utilize SEO tools and keyword research techniques to improve organic search rankings and increase website traffic through content optimization and technical SEO enhancements.

Lead content creation efforts including copywriting, graphic design using Adobe Creative Suite, and content management system (CMS) updates on platforms like WordPress.

Implement conversion optimization tactics by analyzing user behavior with Google Analytics and performance marketing data to refine landing pages, calls-to-action, and overall user experience.

Manage marketing automation tools to streamline campaigns, nurture leads, and improve customer retention strategies across e-commerce and B2B channels.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including web developers skilled in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL—to ensure seamless website functionality and performance improvements.

Monitor campaign performance metrics regularly, generate detailed reports on ROI and KPIs, and adjust strategies accordingly for maximum impact.

Requirements

Proven experience in digital marketing leadership roles with a strong track record of developing successful multi-channel campaigns.

Deep understanding of SEO tools, SEM practices including Google AdWords/Google Ads management, Facebook Advertising, and social media management platforms.

Proficiency in analytics tools such as Google Analytics and experience interpreting data to inform strategic decisions.

Skilled in content creation—copywriting, graphic design (Adobe Photoshop), video editing (Adobe Creative Suite)—and content management systems like WordPress or similar platforms.

Technical knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL for website optimization and troubleshooting purposes.

Expertise in conversion optimization techniques to enhance user experience and increase engagement rates.

Strong knowledge of marketing automation systems to execute targeted email campaigns and nurture leads effectively.

Excellent project management skills with the ability to lead teams of marketers, designers, developers, and external vendors toward common goals.

Exceptional communication skills with an eye for detail; capable of translating complex data into clear insights for stakeholders. Join us as a Digital Marketing Director if you’re energized by innovation and eager to shape the future of digital engagement! Your leadership will inspire teams to push boundaries while delivering measurable results that propel our brand forward in the digital age.

# Global Head of Digital Marketing Strategy & Channels, Senior Vice President

State Street Bank

[Boston, MA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Boston%2C-MA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5853530339881851892?p=1&pos=0&rgn=22682&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3322499500321993572&crId=US_0US_0)

We Are Looking For:State Street is seeking a strategic and results-oriented Head of Digital Strategy & Channels, Senior Vice President, to lead the firm's digital marketing ecosystem and core channels.This is a senior role for a proven strategist and operator: someone who has built and run digital marketing capabilities at scale, and who can move comfortably between setting enterprise vision and rolling up their sleeves to improve channel performance. This leader will take an enterprise, State Street-wide view of our key user journeys and the distinct personas we serve across our businesses, and design digital experiences and capabilities around each business's specific growth outcomes.The successful candidate will lead a global organization of digital strategists, UX specialists and operators to define and drive the strategic vision for State Street's digital experiences in partnership with marketing, technology, product, and design teams, creating seamless, personalized experiences that drive engagement and business growth. # Director of Digital Marketing & Partnerships

$110k - $125k

Full-time

Justin Alexander

[Springfield, NJ](https://jooble.org/jobs/Springfield%2C-NJ)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6152230702398040888?p=1&pos=0&rgn=30944&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4107747424233241538&crId=US_0US_0)

Justin Alexander is looking for a strategic, data-driven Director of Digital Marketing & Partnerships to lead our global digital marketing efforts across email, paid media, and media partnerships. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with a strong command of performance data, equally comfortable shaping long-term vision and driving day-to-day execution. With two direct reports, this role drives measurable impact across both B2B and D2C channels.

This position reports into the Global Director of Marketing and is based out of our Springfield, NJ headquarters on a hybrid schedule (4 days in office, Springfield, NJ; 1 day WFH).

**What You’ll Do \|** Shape digital marketing for one of the most beloved names in bridal fashion:

Email Marketing (B2B + D2C)

- Own and lead the global email strategy across both B2B and D2C audiences, including content, segmentation, personalization, data flows, and automations
- Oversee email execution end-to-end, implementing operational best practices and building processes that support channel management, actionable reporting, optimizations, and team efficiency
- Leverage data to identify optimization opportunities and refine strategies with a test-and-learn mindset
- Elevate email as a brand and communication channel, ensuring templates, copy, and creative are visually compelling, on-brand, and focus on clarity, audience and conversion
- Build and optimize automated, multi-channel journeys to enhance engagement; support new journey programs, ensuring operational feasibility, data readiness, and performance tracking
- Partner with and provide strategic direction to the Digital Marketing Manager to define KPIs and optimize deliverability, open rates/click-to-open rate (CTOR), click-through rates (CTR), conversion rates and engagement rates
- Partner with cross-functional partners including the broader marketing team, digital product, and design/merch to build scalable programs tied to key brand moments and launches
- Maintain a consistent brand voice with our retail partners while thoughtfully balancing storytelling for brides across digital communications

Paid Media & Partnerships

- Lead and oversee global paid media strategy and execution across search, social, display, video, and programmatic channels, spanning both co-op and brand programs across all markets
- Ground media strategy in our brand vision and business objectives, ensuring purposeful and cohesive execution across retail partner media and brand storytelling
- Own end-to-end digital marketing investment, including the planning process, budgets, optimizations, and billing, maximizing ROI/return on ad spend (ROAS), and driving effectiveness across all markets
- Partner with agency to define benchmarks and KPIs by channel, grounding targets in business goals and creating cross-team alignment on what success looks like and how it will be measured
- Champion a test-and-learn roadmap across all paid channels, identifying opportunities to pilot new platforms, formats, and strategies to stay ahead and competitive in the marketplace
- Manage agency relationships including scope, contracts, and performance discussions, ensuring partners are aligned, accountable, and delivering against expectations
- Work cross-functionally with marketing team, digital product, analytics, and design/merch to drive alignment between media strategy, website activations, and broader business objectives
- Partner with the broader marketing, social, influencer, analytics, and design/merch teams to ensure top-performing products are prominently featured in ad creative, and that assets are strategically and proactively briefed, developed, and optimized for each channel
- Stay at the forefront of digital marketing trends, platform changes, and the competitive landscape, bringing forward-thinking ideas that sharpen our approach
- Drive strategy and implementation for key media partnerships such as The Knot, evaluating opportunities to optimize for engagement and extend brand reach

Website

- Partner with the digital product team to strategize and execute website optimizations that improve the consumer journey and overall user experience across all touchpoints
- Collaborate with digital product and design/merch teams to ensure best sellers and new arrivals are strategically surfaced and positioned across the website during key moments
- Partner cross-functionally to inform and support SEO strategy, ensuring web content and architecture are optimized for discoverability and organic growth

Leadership

- Lead, mentor, and develop two direct reports, cultivating a culture of collaboration, continuous growth, and shared accountability
- Build strong cross-functional partnerships across the organization, championing digital marketing as a driver of business growth and ensuring strategic alignment across all key teams
- Serve as a strategic thought leader across the organization, delivering POVs, clear reporting, actionable insights, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders/partners

**What You’ll Bring**

- 8+ years of digital marketing experience, with a strong track record across email, paid media, website and partnerships
- Strong analytical mindset; fluency in performance data and comfort translating insights into strategy
- Demonstrated experience managing global or multi-market programs across both B2B and D2C channels
- Proven ability to lead and develop direct reports and build high-performing teams
- Experience managing agencies, external partners, and multi-channel budgets at scale
- Familiarity with MarTech platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or equivalent) and paid media platforms (Meta, Google, programmatic DSPs)
- Experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub, email automation, behavioral workflows, and campaign analytics
- Exceptional communicator with the ability to translate complex data and strategy into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences
- Bridal, fashion, luxury, or lifestyle brand experience a plus

**What You’ll Get** _(Compensation & Benefits)_

This role has an anticipated base salary range of $110,000 to $125,000 annually. The final offer will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.

Justin Alexander offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

- Health, dental, and vision insurance with ancillary options
- 401(k) with company match
- Paid time off (vacation, sick days, holidays)
- Family Building Benefits
- Tuition Reimbursement
- Employee discounts and more

# Vice President, Global Product Marketing Mastercard Job listing

Financialnarrative

[Harrison, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/Harrison%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1306198653380534637?p=1&pos=0&rgn=34449&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2144822807890701550&crId=US_0US_0)

Vice President, Global Product Marketing

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

### Title and Summary

Vice President, Global Product Marketing

Vice President, Global B2B & Product Marketing Consumer Products & Processing

### About Mastercard

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to power an inclusive, digital economy that works for everyone, everywhere - by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Through secure data, modern networks, strong partnerships, and deep passion for innovation, we help individuals, businesses, financial institutions, and governments reach their full potential. With a presence in more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a more sustainable future and unlocking priceless possibilities.

Join one of the most passionate, motivated, and engaged global teams in the industry - where curiosity, creativity, and impact are encouraged every day.

### The Role

The Vice President, Global Product Marketing - Consumer Products & Processing is a senior leader within Mastercard's Global Marketing & Communications organization. This role partners closely with the Consumer Products & Processing business and product teams to shape and deliver integrated B2B and B2C marketing solutions.

The goal: create a consistent, differentiated, and compelling value proposition and experience for customers, consumers, and partners-leveraging Mastercard's brand, platforms, and assets across markets and channels.

This role reports to the SVP, Global Marketing - Core Payments & Strategic Growth.

If you:

- Have a deep passion for product marketing
- Thrive at the intersection of B2B and B2C
- Are known for creativity, clarity, and influence
- Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, setting direction, and driving results in a fast paced, global environment

\- we'd love to hear from you.

### What You'll Do

- Develop and deliver marketing solutions that create a distinctive consumer, customer, and stakeholder proposition and experience across Consumer Products & Processing
- Build strong, trusted partnerships with local, regional, and global marketing and business teams, ensuring alignment to global strategy while supporting market specific opportunities
- Lead overarching external and internal engagement strategies, including:
 - Audience mapping and stakeholder relationship management
 - High impact events and customer engagement
 - Digital, social, and traditional media
 - Content strategy, creation, and distribution
- Work closely with global and regional product teams, corporate communications, and Marketing & Communications functions to ensure integrated development and execution
- Define and activate marketing strategies, programs, and tactics that address diverse objectives across business units, stakeholders, and partners-while strengthening the Mastercard brand
- Track, measure, and optimize performance against business and marketing KPIs
- Foster a culture of learning through experimentation, storytelling, testing, and optimization across the full marketing mix

### All About You

You bring a mix of strategic thinking, creative clarity, and operational discipline. Specifically, you offer:

- Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to turn complex, technical concepts into simple, compelling narratives and value propositions
- Strong experience across B2B and B2C marketing, with deep consumer understanding and a clear focus on commercial impact and performance
- Broad marketing expertise, including Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, Brand Management, and integrated go to market execution
- A track record of building effective, collaborative relationships across global, regional, and local teams, with sensitivity to cultural diversity
- A strategic mindset with the ability to make confident decisions in ambiguous, fast moving environments, and to lead through influence in a highly matrixed organization
- Proven success driving marketing transformation and operational excellence through analytics, structure, and commercial rigor
- A self starter approach, with the ability to manage complex, multi market initiatives while maintaining focus, prioritization, and follow through
- Intellectual curiosity, agility, and a strong learning mindset-especially around evolving competitors, technologies, and products
- An advanced degree (preferred)
- Experience in financial services, technology, or other data driven industries (beneficial)

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact [View email address on click.appcast.io](https://jooble.org/away/-1306198653380534637?p=1&pos=0&rgn=34449&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2144822807890701550&crId=US_0US_0) and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

### Corporate Security Responsibility

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices;
- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

In line with Mastercard's total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.
