# Director, Performance Marketing

Candidate

[Seattle, WA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Seattle%2C-WA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-82200383565096467?p=1&pos=0&rgn=50933&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6668002053135332354&crId=US_0US_0)

### **Why join us**

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

### **Marketing at Brex**

The Marketing team tells the Brex story, turning product innovation into customer obsession. We develop messaging, shape the brand, and bring our platform to life through thoughtful, compelling content. Our team spans Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, and works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Business Development, and Design to drive growth and build trust.

### **What you'll do**

You will lead Brex's performance marketing strategy and paid media investments, driving customer acquisition, revenue growth, and brand awareness across an expanding portfolio of channels.

Partnering with the Senior Director of Growth Marketing, you will scale an established acquisition engine, build an in-house center of excellence for performance and brand media buying, and lead a growing team of performance marketers. You'll own the strategy and financial performance of our media investments, balancing near-term revenue outcomes with longer-term demand creation.

With significant growth investment following Brex's acquisition by Capital One, you'll have the opportunity to shape a rapidly expanding media budget, accelerate experimentation across emerging channels, and build more sophisticated measurement capabilities to inform investment decisions.

### **Responsibilities**

- Own Brex's paid media strategy and investment across Brand and Growth, accountable for qualified pipeline, self-serve signups, and the revenue they produce. Brand sets campaign vision and brand KPIs; you turn them into full-funnel media plans.
- Manage and optimize a growing, multimillion-dollar media budget, balancing acquisition volume, LTV, and incremental revenue contribution.
- Build an in-house digital media center of excellence, transitioning brand media buying from a traditional agency model while strategically leveraging platforms and managed services.
- Scale existing paid search and paid social programs (LinkedIn, Meta), while expanding investment in YouTube, connected TV, programmatic, and other upper-funnel channels.
- Develop an integrated full-funnel investment strategy, connecting demand creation and brand awareness to downstream acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
- Partner with Marketing Operations, Data, and Finance to improve measurement, forecasting, budget pacing, and investment allocation across channels.
- Translate existing attribution and customer journey data into actionable insights, building reporting and analytical frameworks that inform media strategy and optimization.
- Drive rapid experimentation across channels, audiences, and creative, identifying opportunities to restructure underperforming campaigns and scale successful investments.
- Partner with Brand and Creative teams to develop high-performing static and video advertising, providing actionable feedback on messaging, formats, and creative effectiveness.
- Lead and develop a growing performance marketing team, establishing clear accountability, scalable execution practices, and AI-enabled workflows to increase operating leverage.

### **Requirements**

- 8+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid acquisition, or digital media, with demonstrated experience scaling multichannel advertising programs.
- Direct experience managing **$30M+ in annual paid media spend** (~$3M monthly), with measurable impact on customer acquisition and revenue growth.
- Deep expertise in performance marketing and acquisition economics, including LTV, ROI, incremental revenue, and revenue-based optimization.
- Proven ability to develop full-funnel media strategies, connecting upper-funnel brand investments to measurable improvements in downstream demand, conversion, and revenue.
- Deep hands-on expertise in outline video, connected TV, programmatic, and brand media, plus strong paid social experience across LinkedIn and Meta. Working knowledge of paid search.
- Strong financial acumen, including budget ownership, forecasting, investment modeling, and data-driven allocation of spend across channels.
- Strong analytical judgment and experience translating attribution, customer journey, and campaign performance data into actionable investment decisions.
- Demonstrated ability to assess and improve campaign structure, channel strategy, and creative performance through rigorous testing and rapid iteration.
- Strong creative judgment, with experience partnering with Brand and Design teams to develop and optimize performance-oriented static and video advertising.
- Experience leading and developing high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style and the ability to scale execution without unnecessary organizational complexity.
- A curious, action-oriented approach to problem-solving, with a track record of challenging existing strategies, making decisions with imperfect information, and executing quickly.

### **Bonus points**

- Experience scaling performance marketing in both high-volume B2C or product-led growth (PLG) environments and B2B, sales-led businesses.
- Experience transitioning media buying from an agency-led model to an in-house team, including evaluating managed-service partners.
- Experience developing incrementality testing, media mix modeling, or advanced full-funnel measurement frameworks.
- Experience in fintech, financial services, or high-growth technology companies.
- Experience leveraging AI and automation to improve media execution, analysis, and team productivity.

### **Compensation**

The expected salary range for this role is $221,480 to $276,850. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate's location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

We're looking for the person who makes sure that search leads to Compass.Compass International Holdings OverviewCompass International Holdings is a global real estate services company empowering real estate professionals with everything they need to realize their entrepreneurial potential. In addition to brokerage services, Compass International Holdings offers integrated services, such as mortgage, title, insurance, escrow, and relocation. # Head of Performance Marketing & Acquisition ($400k - $1m salary)

Baton Corporation Ltd

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2633941520797153954?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8017478387819206476&crId=US_0US_0)

### WHO WE ARE

Baton Corporation builds and maintains pump.fun — the dominant memecoin launchpad, processing $300M+ in daily volume. Last year, pump.fun generated over $500M in profit with a team of fewer than 100 people.

We ship to production daily. Bureaucracy is minimal. We solve hard technical and go-to-market problems at scale, and we're data-driven — systematic tools and the scientific method decide what works, not opinions.

Working with us isn't for everyone. We work in person. Hours are long and sometimes strange. The pace is intense. Individuals own their function end to end. When we ship a change, it reaches hundreds of thousands of users within days.

### THE ROLE

We're looking for a Head of Performance Marketing & Acquisition to build and run our paid growth engine from the ground up — the strategy, the channels, the always-on daily budget, the creative testing, the team, and the compliance guardrails that let us move fast without moving recklessly.

This is a hands-on, builder role, not a "manage an agency and review decks" job. You'll be in the weeds on campaigns and creative while building the team underneath you as we scale.

### WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own paid acquisition strategy end-to-end — set the roadmap for user acquisition and be accountable for the CAC, ROAS, and payback numbers behind it
- Deploy and manage a multi-million-dollar, always-on daily budget with full ownership across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, TikTok Shop, X Ads, programmatic, and emerging crypto-native networks as they become relevant
- Build and lead the team — hire, onboard, and manage the performance marketers and specialists needed to scale aggressively
- Run a systematic, high-velocity creative testing program — sourcing, briefing, and scaling UGC and clipping-style content alongside traditional paid creative that performs
- Build the attribution and measurement infrastructure connecting spend to activation and trading volume, not just clicks
- Partner closely with Legal and General Counsel to make sure every paid campaign fits within our compliance framework — non-negotiable given the regulatory environment we operate in
- Report on and iterate against performance — kill what doesn't work, scale what does, fast

### WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A proven track record owning and scaling paid acquisition at a leading consumer, fintech, or crypto platform — the kind of top companies in the industry known for large, always-on daily budgets — or at an agency that ran growth for products like these
- Hands-on channel fluency across Meta, Google, TikTok, and X, with real experience operating the console, not just reviewing the deck
- A scrappy, high-energy operator mindset — you're hungry, hands-on, and thrive in a fast-paced, resource-lean environment where you're building the playbook as you go, not just running someone else's
- Comfort with ambiguity and pace — you don't need a fully mapped org or process to start moving
- Strong quantitative fluency — you think natively in CAC, LTV, ROAS, and payback period

**If you're the kind of operator who'd rather ship the campaign than write the deck about it — this is your role.**

# Director of Performance Marketing

Five Star Franchising

[Springville, UT](https://jooble.org/jobs/Springville%2C-UT)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6270010580685355480?p=1&pos=0&rgn=48606&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1978542509201246808&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Director Of Performance Marketing

Five Star Franchising, headquartered in Springville, Utah, is among the nation's fastest-growing franchise portfolio companies with brands across home services. What began in 2005 with the launch of Five Star Painting has expanded into a thriving organization of multiple brands and more than 1,500 franchise locations across the U.S. and Canada. With a focus on strategic growth, we continue to expand our portfolio through acquisitions while investing in scalable marketing, technology, and operational excellence.

We are committed to empowering franchise owners to thrive by delivering best-in-class marketing, operations, and business support that drive profitable growth and remarkable customer experiences. We provide the tools, resources, and expertise needed to help franchise owners grow their businesses and maximize long-term success.

We live our DRIVE values — Driven, Real, Enthusiastic, Innovative, Vital — combining bold thinking with disciplined execution. We move fast, embrace accountability, and care deeply about results, innovation, and people.

The Director Of Performance Marketing serves as the enterprise leader responsible for maximizing the effectiveness of paid media, marketing analytics, attribution, and performance optimization across Five Star Franchising's growing portfolio of brands.

This role partners closely with Brand Marketing Directors, agency partners, franchise leadership, operations, technology teams, and executive leadership to improve customer acquisition, optimize marketing investment, strengthen reporting accuracy, and drive measurable business growth.

We're looking for a strategic, highly analytical leader who thrives on solving complex marketing challenges through data, technology, and continuous optimization.

This leader will build scalable reporting frameworks, establish performance standards across brands, strengthen agency accountability, and transform marketing insights into actionable strategies that improve franchise owner success and enterprise performance.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in digital marketing with strong business acumen, operational discipline, and executive communication skills. They know how to challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, influence cross-functional teams, and continuously improve marketing performance through data-driven decision making.

Responsibilities

- Lead enterprise Performance Marketing strategy, execution, and optimization across Five Star's portfolio of franchise brands.
- Develop paid media strategies that improve lead generation, customer acquisition, revenue growth, and franchise owner profitability.
- Partner with Brand Marketing Directors to identify growth opportunities, optimize marketing investments, and improve channel performance.
- Oversee paid media initiatives across Google Ads, Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, Local Service Ads, Display, Programmatic, and emerging advertising platforms.
- Build scalable testing frameworks across creative, audiences, landing pages, bidding strategies, messaging, and conversion funnels.
- Own attribution, conversion tracking, and marketing measurement frameworks to ensure reporting accuracy and business visibility.
- Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and performance reporting that translate complex marketing data into actionable business insights.
- Lead agency relationships through structured governance, performance benchmarks, quarterly business reviews, and continuous optimization initiatives.
- Evaluate campaign performance using key performance indicators including ROAS, MER, CPL, CPA, CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and lead quality.
- Partner with CRM, analytics, and technology teams to improve data integrity, offline conversion tracking, and marketing system integrations.
- Identify operational gaps, reporting challenges, and process improvements that increase marketing efficiency and scalability.
- Develop franchise performance benchmarks and optimization playbooks that improve results across brands and individual franchise locations.
- Present strategic recommendations, performance insights, and growth opportunities to executive leadership with clarity and confidence.
- Stay ahead of emerging advertising platforms, AI technologies, privacy regulations, attribution models, and digital marketing best practices to maintain Five Star's competitive advantage.

Requirements

- 7+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing
- Proven success managing multi-channel paid media programs and optimizing marketing performance through data-driven decision making.
- Strong analytical skills with experience measuring campaign performance, attribution, and marketing ROI.
- Experience managing agencies, strategic vendor partnerships, and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Deep expertise across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, attribution platforms, and modern reporting tools.
- Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Klaviyo, or similar systems.
- Strong understanding of lead generation, conversion optimization, customer acquisition strategy, and performance measurement.
- Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, and project management skills.
- Experience in franchise, multi-location, home services, restoration, or other service-based industries is a plus.
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Communications, or related field preferred.
- Google Ads, Analytics, Meta, or related certifications are a plus.
- Strong project management and organizational skills; experience with Monday.com or similar work management platforms is a plus.

SBC Performance

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

##### Head Of Performance Marketing

SBC Performance drives scalable growth for brands ready to expand globally. Working across eCommerce, health & wellness, education, and entertainment, our team helps brands acquire customers faster and scale across 26+ global markets. We combine data-driven paid media, performance creative, and advanced analytics to turn marketing into a predictable revenue engine.

Trusted by 200+ companies, managing $150M+ in ad spend.

Scale faster. Grow smarter.

We're looking for a Head Of Performance Marketing to build our performance function as a system, not a set of campaigns: operating model, metrics, standards, team. Own the direction end to end - strategy, people, budgets, results and scale it across sources and funnels without losing control.

What You'll Own

- Performance function - all processes, specialists, and traffic sources
- Traffic strategy - spend split across Meta, TikTok, Google; resilience if one platform gets restricted
- Funnel portfolio - web2web, web2app, app, each with clear economics and a scaling path
- Operating model - a team structure that scales without adding manual oversight
- Metrics & reporting - one real-time picture of results for leadership
- Unit economics - spend growth that turns into margin, not just volume
- People - senior specialists who can run major clients solo, with successors ready
- Partnerships & automation - a platform edge, not just reacting to changes
- Risk & compliance - bans, rejections, and policy issues kept under control
- Cross-functional alignment - Sales, Account Management, Compliance, Creative working without ad-hoc fixes

##### What We're Looking For

Must have:

- 6+ years in performance marketing, including 2+ years managing a team of performance specialists
- Hands-on media buying experience on Meta, TikTok, and Google - as a practitioner, not only as a manager
- Experience managing multi-million-dollar annual budgets and accountability for their efficiency
- Solid experience with web2web and web2app funnels - understanding the creative → funnel → conversion → economics chain
- Strong command of unit economics, attribution, and CPA / ROAS / CAC / LTV metrics
- Track record of building processes, standards, and teams - from scratch or through a scaling phase
- Experience navigating platform policies and account risk (rejections, bans, compliance)
- English proficient enough to communicate with platform representatives and partners

Nice to have:

- Experience with app traffic: mobile app installs, in-app events, post-install optimization
- Product/growth-side experience - understanding of monetization, retention, and LTV mechanics
- Direct partnerships with platform reps (Meta / TikTok / Google) and access to partner programs
- Agency experience - managing a client portfolio and external stakeholders
- Experience automating media buying via API or internal tools

##### Tools & Platforms

Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Google Ads (+ API), attribution/tracking platforms, BI / Looker, Google Sheets

What We Offer

- Hybrid job in Prague/Warsaw or remote from Ukraine
- Competitive compensation
- Flexible working hours: we start our operation day between 9:00 - 11:00 CET
- All necessary equipment
- Paid vacation and sick leaves
- Educational support: reimbursement of certification, training, and a knowledge-sharing atmosphere
- Company events and multiple internal activities
- Open feedback and transparent direct communication

# VP of Growth Marketing eMoney Advisor Job listing

Financial Narrative

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6046358158330201853?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5727649961488527988&crId=US_0US_0)

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, the VP of Growth Marketing is a strategic leader responsible for all aspects of demand, marketing operations, and client retention across the marketing organization with the goal of driving increased acquisition and growth across our client base.This position leads the ideation, planning, and execution of comprehensive marketing strategies designed to attract prospects, increase client acquisition, and deepen client relationships. This role will be responsible for campaign strategies and execution, as well as analysis and reporting, driving ROI and efficiency in our content, demand and retention processes. In this leadership role, the VP, Growth Marketing will lead, coach, and inspire a team of demand, events, marketing operations, and retention marketing professionals to ensure their work aligns with and impacts the business goals of the company.

### Job Responsibilities

- Build monthly, quarterly, and annual marketing plans for the team in line with budget and revenue growth goals.
- Lead a team of retention marketing professionals to establish effective strategies for growing adoption of our products and services across our client base, while creating campaigns designed to drive growth and expansion among this audience.
- Develop adoption metrics and KPIs to measure and track campaign effectiveness across client accounts.
- Manage the creation and optimization of upselling, cross-sell campaigns and identify opportunities to improve ROI, conversion, and audience expansion.
- Identify and propose new media channels, growth strategies, and tactics.
- Establish program measurement methodology and analyze results in terms of ROI and success criteria (attraction, engagement, qualification, acceleration).
- Oversee the marketing operations team to ensure key reporting mechanisms are providing marketing and sales with insights into demand efforts and retention efforts for better decision making.
- Design and execute a data strategy to enable the use of quality, enriched data and the associated standardized process to capture, maintain, and govern utilization.
- Ensure data hygiene and governance processes are built and adhered to within our data strategy.
- Improve marketing agility with documented processes and streamlined workflows to increase productivity and efficiency.
- Lead efforts to drive improved performance measurement and insight: model and set performance targets across channels and ensure teams have access to insights to optimize marketing performance.
- Collaborate with Sales leadership to establish alignment in processes for tracking, reporting, and actioning leads from sales hand-off through conversion.
- Support Head of Marketing in strategic planning, reverse waterfall exercise for goal setting, and budget planning and management process.
- Lead team in coordination with marketing communications, product marketing and sales enablement/operations to align activity in support of broader campaign initiatives
- Oversee and drive creation, testing, and implementation of multi-touch nurturing campaigns, including landing pages, content placement, etc.
- Create and execute a digital strategy to support the company’s business objectives including improving SEO/SEM efforts and paid social campaigns such as LinkedIn and other paid targeting via cost per lead tactics.
- Use digital metrics (e.g. site traffic, conversion rates) to test online performance and optimize marketing expenses.
- Set lead goals and stage/conversion rates in the demand waterfall, measure and optimize results.
- Oversee creation of integrated marketing campaigns; drive inbound and outbound digital and partner marketing tactics.
- Oversee a robust events strategy that includes tradeshows, webinars, hosted VIP events, and an annual Summit with an eye toward performance reporting and ROI.
- Collaborate with sales development and sales to establish, implement, and maintain lead to revenue processes aligned to business goals and GTM strategy.
- Responsible for team’s performance management as well as the workforce planning of the group alongside the Head of Marketing.

### Requirements

- Bachelor’s Degree
- 15+ years of B2B demand generation experience
- 7+ years of management experience
- Strong experience with Eloqua (or other marketing automation platform), Salesforce, and Account-Based Technology platforms
- Deep expertise in paid acquisition, lifecycle marketing, and conversion rate optimization
- Experience working with BI platforms like Looker, PowerBI, and/or Google Data Studios
- Experience with management of budgets and evaluating hiring needs across the team
- Previous experience working across all functions of Marketing, Business Development and Sales to define and develop scalable business processes designed to drive revenue
- Proven success supporting or collaborating with Enterprise‑level Sales and Marketing teams, including familiarity with long‑cycle B2B sales motions, account‑based marketing strategies, and cross‑functional go‑to‑market execution
- Experience integrating AI into marketing strategies to drive improved outcomes and operational efficiency highly preferred

### Skills

- Ability to understand and translate business objectives into marketing goals, KPIs and technical requirements and create executive level reports
- Strong analytical skills and ability to make commercially impactful recommendations based on the data
- Creative approach to developing campaigns
- Strategic, objective-driven planning and reporting
- Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment
- Self-motivated individual with attention to detail and focus on quality results.
- Trusted partner to sales
- Strong manager and natural leader with demonstrated experience managing cross-functional teams.

The salary range for this position is $202,000 - $263,000; commensurate salary to be determined based on skills, professional background and expertise.This position is also eligible, pursuant to applicable eMoney policies, for the annual bonus program, retirement contributions, health insurance, sick leave, parental leave and paid time off.

# Vice President, Performance Marketing

Touch Of Modern

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/4423805894660299849?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4654253765482803495&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Vice President Of Performance Marketing

CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs.

Location: Remote (USA or Canada)

##### About The Role:

CSC Generation is looking for a Vice President of Performance Marketing to own paid media strategy and the paid media P&L across our portfolio of 13 brands, including Sur La Table, Backcountry, and One Kings Lane. As Vice President, Performance Marketing, you will set multi-year direction, build the team and agency bench to execute against it, and represent performance marketing on CSC Generation's leadership team.

In your first year, success means establishing a unified performance marketing strategy across the portfolio, standing up the right team structure, and demonstrating measurable improvement in blended CAC and media efficiency. You will partner closely with Creative, Merchandising, and eCommerce leadership to ensure paid investment, assortment, and creative strategy reinforce each other.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

##### What You'll Do:

Performance Marketing Strategy:

- Own the performance marketing P&L and multi-year strategy across the brand portfolio, spanning paid search, paid social, shopping/feed, display, affiliate, video/TV, and emerging channels.
- Set channel and budget allocation based on incrementality, LTV, and blended CAC targets, and defend those trade-offs to the executive team.
- Translate company revenue and margin targets into a multi-year paid media investment plan.
- Build repeatable playbooks for launches, promotions, and seasonal peaks that scale across brands.
- Track competitor activity and market trends to spot new channels, formats, and positioning opportunities.

Team Leadership & Organization:

- Build and lead a team of performance marketing leaders and specialists, plus supporting agencies.
- Set operating standards for testing velocity, reporting rigor, and channel expertise, and hold your leadership team accountable to them.
- Stay close enough to the numbers to catch problems early, coach through them, and step in directly when needed.
- Hold agency partners accountable to performance benchmarks, media efficiency, and clear scopes of work.
- Own new channel expansion, including hands-on execution of initial campaigns in new channels.
- Champion a continuous A/B and multivariate testing culture across creative, landing pages, and audience targeting, turning results into scaled learnings.
- Drive adoption and demonstrated use of AI and automation tools across the team to improve decisions, increase output, and free up time for high-value work.

Executive & Cross-Functional Leadership:

- Sit on CSC Generation's marketing leadership team and represent performance marketing in company-level strategy and planning.
- Partner with Creative to ensure ad concepts and assets are built for performance from the start.
- Partner with Merchandising to align paid spend with inventory, margin, and assortment priorities.
- Partner with eCommerce, Product, and Web Development to ensure landing pages, site experience, and conversion funnels support paid traffic quality.
- Translate performance data into clear commercial recommendations for the executive team—not just channel-level metrics.
- Flag risks and opportunities early and bring solutions rather than just problems.

##### Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
- 12+ years of experience in performance marketing or paid media, including 5+ years leading managers or team leads (not just individual contributors).
- Proven ownership of a paid media budget spanning multiple channels (search, social, shopping/feed, display) at a scale consistent with a multi-brand or multi-hundred-million-dollar revenue business.
- Track record of owning performance marketing across multiple brands or business units simultaneously.
- Strong command of performance marketing economics: CAC, LTV, incrementality, marginal ROAS, and blended efficiency.
- Demonstrated ability to influence and align Creative, Merchandising, eCommerce, and executive stakeholders without direct authority over their teams.
- Proven experience building and leading teams of leaders, and managing agency relationships at scale.
- Strong executive presence and communication skills, with experience reporting directly to the C-suite or serving on a leadership team.
- Demonstrated experience using AI and automation tools to improve decisions, increase output, or improve team efficiency.
- Hands-on fluency with major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager) and analytics/reporting tools (Google Analytics, Tableau or Looker Studio), even if day-to-day execution sits with the team.

##### Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience across multiple retail or ecommerce verticals (such as outdoor, home, or specialty goods).
- Experience with multi-brand or multi-site paid media management (shared team supporting several storefronts).

##### Why Join:

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

- Executive Access: Work directly with C-suite leadership and brand CEOs, shaping how paid media investment drives growth across a $1B+ portfolio.
- Leadership at Scale: Build and lead a performance marketing organization that spans 13 brands—few roles offer this breadth of strategic ownership.
- Portfolio-Level Impact: Set the strategy, build the team, and own the P&L. Your decisions will directly shape revenue and margin outcomes across the entire brand portfolio.
- Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
- Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

##### Interview Process:

1. Recruiter Screen - A 45-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
2. Hiring Manager Interview - A deeper conversation focused on your performance marketing leadership experience, portfolio-level strategy approach, and team-building philosophy.
3. Executive Interview - Discussion with senior CSC Generation leadership on strategic vision, cross-functional partnership, and P&L accountability.
4. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at one of our hub offices (Salt Lake City, Austin, or Toronto). Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
5. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
6. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

Please Note:

- Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.

CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, contact [View email address on click.appcast.io](https://jooble.org/away/4423805894660299849?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4654253765482803495&crId=US_0US_0).

Employment is contingent on a background check, including verification of prior employment dates.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. This position is not open to and cannot be filled by a B.C. Resident.

$210k - $230k

Full-time

**Director Product Marketing Manager - Optimization Solutions**

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

Great technology starts with great people. At Samsung, we're building products and experiences that reach millions of people around the world every day. Behind every innovation is a team driven by curiosity, collaboration, and a passion for what's next.

For nearly five decades, Samsung has been at the forefront of technological advancements, investing over $100 billion and creating more than 20,000 jobs nationwide. Our mission is to integrate cutting-edge products, services, and AI technology to deliver smarter, sustainable, and more connected experiences that empower people to live better.

We take pride in the creativity and diversity of our talented people – they are at the forefront of everything we do. Their skillset and mindset drive our continued success. Only the resilient and resourceful thrive in the daily dose of the unexpected at Samsung. We unapologetically push to achieve unforeseen potential in everything we do, both at the workplace and at home. We fearlessly face challenges head-on, conquer the unconquerable, and live comfortably in the uncomfortable zone.

To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

At Samsung Ads, the best advertising feels like part of the experience – and you'll help bring it to life. Here, you'll build advertising solutions that connect brands with audiences through one of the world's largest connected TV platforms. By combining data, technology, and creativity, you'll help redefine the future of connected TV advertising.

We focus on enabling brands to connect with Samsung audiences across all devices. As an international company, Architects at Samsung work on big complex projects with stakeholders and teams located around the globe.

Our purpose is to deliver unparalleled results for our customers. Samsung Ads uniquely transforms the advertising landscape by using comprehensive data to build the world’s most intelligent connected audience platform. We deliver on Samsung Electronics’ 51-year commitment to excellence through smart, easy, effective advertising solutions to make advanced video advertising work.

**Position Summary:**

Samsung Ads is seeking a Product Marketing Director to lead product marketing for our B2B performance optimization portfolio, including Retail Media Network offerings. This role will shape how we position, launch, and grow solutions spanning new ad formats, targeting capabilities, and data partnerships—turning product innovation into compelling value for advertisers, agencies, and industry partners.

As a senior individual contributor, you will own product marketing strategy and execution across the product lifecycle. You will partner with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and go-to-market teams to translate technical capabilities into differentiated offerings, clear messaging, and actionable sales strategies that drive adoption and revenue.

You will bring a commercial perspective to product development, validate market readiness, and build positioning, packaging, and launch plans. You will also collaborate with Monetization and FP&A on rollout planning and account prioritization, and with Sales Learning & Development and the PMO on sales enablement, training, and adoption measurement.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Product Marketing within the Commercialization team, you will help turn emerging product ideas into market-tested, commercially viable solutions that deliver measurable results for Samsung Ads clients.

Your long-term mandate is to make Samsung Ads’ optimization solutions an essential investment for leading brands and agencies. You will also help define and streamline our go-to-market strategy, building alignment across teams to bring differentiated solutions to market and scale their impact.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

- **Lead B2B Product Marketing for Samsung Optimization products**\- Serve as the primary point of contact for Product Marketing for select Samsung optimization products, including Retail Media Network (RMN), working closely with cross functional teams to bring these offerings from launch into successful, always-on, must-buy offerings.
- **Develop and Execute Strong Go-To-Market that Drives B2B Samsung Optimization Solutions Adoption** \- Refine and accelerate the team’s overall go-to-market product strategy from conception to launch to recurring buys.
- **Understand the Customer and What it Takes to Win -** Capture the voice of the customer by analyzing advertiser needs, pain points, demands, and market trends, and translating those insights into prioritized product and GTM strategies to accelerate sales.
- **Package New and Existing Offerings that Meet Customer Business Objectives**\- Take new, complex products and distill them into easy-to-understand offerings for client audiences, working with partner teams to refine product market fit.
- **Build and Refine Value Propositions** \- Create clear, compelling narratives for each Samsung Optimization & RMN offering/content, bringing industry and market intelligence into the mix.
- **Define the Samsung Product Arc** \- Work with Product, Engineering, GTM, and Insights to build clear ‘sales ready’ turnkey programs, including cases, claims, and benchmarks that inspire confidence in sellers and adoption from clients.
- **Partner Cross-Functionally**\- Work daily with Product Managers, Product Strategy, Marketing and Sales to bring offerings to life. Regularly to go top-to-top and bring an informed recommendation on offering steer and deployment.

**Qualifications/Skills:**

- **CTV/Media/Advertising Product Marketing Expertise** : 12+ years of experience in leading advertising-related product marketing programs, the majority of which have been spent driving leading product marketing programs in media, programmatic, sponsorship, and/or technology-related ad sales.
- **Strong Performance Optimization knowledge** : At least 5+ years of experience in performance optimization solution building, including deep knowledge in ML optimization solutions, performance/KPI measurement, RMN. Strong familiarity with client expectations and outcomes, as well as industry standard pricing and bundling concepts.
- **Product Marketing Lifecycle Ownershi** p: Experience in leading the full lifecycle of B2B, ads, or content product marketing development, from early-stage Product Manager / BD partnership to alpha/beta to general availability, partnering with cross-functional teams as needed.
- **Proven Track Record of Successful Product Launches:** Successfully developed, launched, and deployed new products, and accelerated adoption of existing products, especially within the CTV, programmatic, sponsorship, or advertising space.
- **Outstanding cross-functional collaboration** : Particularly with Product, Engineering, Product, L&D, Monetization, and Sales teams.
- **Quantitative and GTM Familiarity** : Proficiency in data analysis, basic 3rd party market research, and crafting product arc narratives.
- **Bachelor’s degree** in a related field (product, marketing, business, media, etc)

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- **Strong Market Landscape Knowledge:** Direct experience at or with leading media, CTV/OTT advertising platforms, or related programmatic platforms (e.g. Meta, Netflix, Google, Amazon, Apple, Pinterest, Disney, Roku, etc)
- **Familiarity with Samsung Ads products** : Including but not limited to programmatic and direct offerings, device capabilities, and Samsung TV+ upper funnel offerings
- **Data-driven** : Use data and metrics regularly to understand product adoption, quantify product feedback and performance, and overall commercial impact
- **Excellent Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication, as well as persuasive presentation skills
- **Strong Operator:** Exceptionally organized and operationally-focused

**The Role**

Wpromote’s B2B Paid Search team is growing, and we’re hiring an Associate Director to own paid search strategy and execution for a portfolio of B2B clients across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You’ll carry a book of 3-5 accounts, be the person clients call when something matters, and be hands-on in the platforms. You’ll also mentor the analysts and managers who support your accounts, but you won’t have direct reports. If you want a role where you stop touching campaigns, this isn’t it.

Our clients are growth-stage and enterprise B2B companies with real complexity: long sales cycles, multiple buying committees, and revenue that shows up in a CRM weeks or months after the click. The people who do this well think in pipeline, not conversions.

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)

-Flexible schedules

-Work from anywhere options\*

-100% paid parental leave

-401(k) matching

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance

-Sponsored life insurance

-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $100,000 – $115,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above).

\*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions

\*\*While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!

### You Will Be

- Owning paid search strategy and performance across your portfolio, including forecasting, budget planning, testing roadmaps, and developing quarterly points of view that inform client decision-making

- Designing measurement strategies that connect paid search investment to pipeline, not just form fills, through offline conversion imports, CRM feedback loops, and lead quality scoring

### You Must Have

- 6+ years in paid search, with at least 3 running B2B programs where lead quality and pipeline were the accountability, not MQL volume

- Depth in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads at the architecture level: how you’d structure an account for a business with three products, six personas, and a nine-month sales cycle
- Experience with SaaS, fintech, HR/payroll, or similarly considered-purchase B2B categories
- Strong analytical instincts and fluency in GA4 plus at least one enterprise analytics or BI platform
- The ability to hold a point of view with a senior client who disagrees, and to change it when the data says you should
- Comfort operating with ambiguity and competing priorities across multiple accounts

### Nice to Have

- Agency experience, or experience managing an agency
- Familiarity with ABM and intent data platforms (6sense, Demandbase, or similar) and how they inform search targeting
- Experience mentoring or formally managing paid search talent

Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of **Crossplane** , and we’re building the **Intelligent Control Plane**—a new platform layer that makes infrastructure **programmable, autonomous, and composable** .

We are hiring a Head of Growth Marketing to own the Upbound funnel end to end. This role reports directly to the VP of Marketing. This is an AI-first role. We are not looking for someone to bolt AI onto a legacy demand generation playbook and build the growth function around AI-native tools and workflows. You will own campaigns, and the systems across our marketing stack. This is a great opportunity to build and operate a stack and growth function that will grow with the organization and support our enterprise and product led motions.

### What you will own

- Full-funnel growth for the Upbound commercial platform, with Crossplane and Modelplane driving open source top of the funnel.
- The campaign roadmap and program budget, with regular business reviews alongside marketing and sales leadership.
- Paid media. You set the channel mix, the targeting, and the efficiency bar against company and sales targets
- Lifecycle marketing and marketing operations, including the marketing automation platform, attribution model, and funnel reporting.
- Conversion, organic search, and AI answer visibility across upbound.io , and modelplane.ai
- The self-serve motion, from signup through activation to paid conversion, in partnership with the product and engineering organization.
- Build and manage a growth team built over several quarters across
- Manage and maintain relationships and efficiencies with agencies, and vendors.

### How you will evolve the growth function

- Evaluate, pilot, and adopt AI-native marketing tools. Retire the ones that do not earn their place.
- Replace manual reporting with AI-assisted analysis so the team spends its time on decisions instead of spreadsheets.
- Compress the campaign production cycle. Audience research, creative variants, landing pages, and iteration should move in days, not weeks.
- Build agentic workflows for repeatable work such as list building, enrichment, signal routing, and post-campaign analysis.
- Set the standard for how AI-assisted work gets reviewed. Speed matters. So does accuracy in a market of technical buyers who will catch a wrong claim immediately.
- Bring a point of view on what happens to the funnel as buyers research through AI assistants instead of search engines, and get us there first.

### You are a good fit if you

- Have 10+ years in B2B marketing, including at least 3 leading growth, demand generation, or acquisition.
- Have owned a meaningful program budget and can walk through how you allocated it, what returned, and what you cut.
- Are still hands-on. You get into the ad platforms, the automation platform, the dashboards, and the data yourself.
- Have already changed how a marketing team works by introducing AI tools, and can describe honestly what worked and what did not.
- Are fluent in analytics. You can size an opportunity, design a test, and defend a number in front of the sales team.
- Have marketed to technical buyers, ideally platform engineers or infrastructure teams.
- Have built or managed a small team.
- Work well with autonomy and know when to ask for support.

### It is a plus if you

- Have worked in open source, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI infrastructure.
- Have run growth for a sales-led and a self-serve motion at the same company.
- Have used intent data and account signal tools.
- Have shipped something yourself with AI. A workflow, a script, an internal tool, an agent.
- Have contributed to a technical community rather than only marketed to one.

# Marketing Director

Location:USCompany:American Home Design, Inc.

## Description:

**About the Role**

American Home Design is looking for a _Marketing Director_ to lead and own our marketing function end-to-end - from budget and performance strategy to campaign execution across TV, digital, and lead-generation channels. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable setting strategy for leadership and getting into the weeds of CPL, ROI, and campaign performance data.

This is an in-person role based at our office in the Nashville, TN area.

**What You'll Do**

**Budget & Performance**

You'll own the marketing budget end-to-end - allocating spend across markets, products, channels, and vendors, tracking cost per lead, marketing costs, and adjusting investment based on what the numbers show. You'll prepare monthly performance reporting for leadership and dig into any unusual shifts in lead volume or sales performance.

**Multi-Channel Campaign Management**

You'll oversee our full marketing mix: TV and traditional media scheduling and creative approval, paid search/PPC and paid social strategy, retargeting and direct mail, and email campaigns. You'll manage relationships with lead aggregators and purchased-lead vendors, including our Jacuzzi and RainSoft lead programs, auditing lead quality and ZIP-level performance along the way.

**Marketing Technology & Lead Nurture**

You'll own our SMS platform and automated lead-nurture campaigns, manage lead reactivation and database marketing initiatives, and coordinate with our broader marketing technology stack to keep lead routing running smoothly.

**Creative & Brand**

You'll manage our promotional calendar, approve creative and messaging across every channel, and make sure offers and disclaimers stay consistent from TV to digital to direct mail.

**Website & Digital Presence**

You'll oversee our website marketing initiatives, SEO strategy, landing pages, and online reputation, working with outside vendors to keep our digital presence and AI-search visibility strong.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

You'll partner closely with sales and call center leadership to troubleshoot lead flow, speed-to-lead, and lead quality issues, and you'll serve as the primary point of contact for our marketing vendors and agencies - negotiating budgets, evaluating new opportunities, and resolving issues as they come up.

**What We're Looking For**

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
- 5+ years of experience in a marketing leadership role, ideally with multi-channel budget ownership
- Strong analytical skills - comfortable managing CPL, and Cost of Marketing
- Experience managing paid media, traditional media, and lead-generation vendors
- Familiarity with marketing automation/CRM platforms and campaign tracking tools
- A track record of managing vendor and agency relationships, including budget negotiation
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate marketing performance into clear updates for leadership
- Experience in home services, direct response, or multi-location marketing is a plus

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive base salary plus performance-based bonus, commensurate with experience. Health/Dental/Life Insurance, PTO, 401(k), etc.

**About Us**

American Home Design has proudly served Tennessee for nearly 50 years, offering bath remodeling, windows and doors, outdoor living products, and water treatment systems. Ranked a _Top Workplace in TN_ by The Tennessean multiple years running, we offer a family-like environment that respects and rewards our team.

**How to Apply**

Send your resume to: mgoodchild@americanhomedesign.com

# Digital Marketing Director (Carmel)

## Description:

Director of Marketing

**Compensation: Up to $95,000 per year in total compensation, based on experience and results.** The offer will include a base salary and a performance bonus tied to agreed, measurable goals.

**Freight Is the Vehicle. People Are the Mission.**

**At Koola Logistics, we’re building a company where ambitious people can create careers, provide for their families, and grow as leaders.**

**We started in 2019 with four desks in one room. Today, we’re entering a new stage of growth, and we’re hiring a Director of Marketing** to build the systems that help us reach more customers and attract great people.

**Read this before applying:** This is a hands-on growth marketing role. We need someone who has built campaigns, improved website conversion, tracked where leads came from, and used the results to make better decisions. Social media, design, and storytelling matter here, but they support the larger goal: **qualified customer opportunities, strong recruiting pipelines, and measurable business growth.**

**You will work directly with our founder and leadership team and help build Koola’s marketing function from the ground up.**

What You Will Own

**Customer growth and lead generation**

- Build campaigns that put Koola in front of the right shippers and decision-makers.
- Work with sales leadership to define a qualified opportunity and track it from first contact through sales follow-up.
- Test channels and messages, measure lead quality, and invest more in what produces real opportunities.
- Create landing pages, email campaigns, case studies, and sales tools brokers will use.

**Website, SEO, and paid campaigns**

- Own the website as a tool for generating and converting customer and recruiting interest.
- Improve search visibility, landing pages, forms, calls to action, and conversion rates.
- Build and manage Google Ads and other paid campaigns where they make economic sense.
- Report on traffic, leads, qualified opportunities, cost, and conversion.

**Marketing systems and measurement**

- Connect marketing activity to our CRM and recruiting processes.
- Put lead tracking, routing, automation, and follow-up systems in place.
- Build a simple dashboard showing where opportunities and candidates came from, what happened next, and what marketing contributed.
- Establish clear baselines so we can measure improvement over time.

**Recruiting marketing**

- Partner with HR and leadership to attract experienced freight brokers and other priority hires.
- Build targeted campaigns, landing pages, and follow-up processes.
- Measure qualified applicants and interviews by source.

**Brand and content**

- Define Koola’s message and build a consistent brand across customer, carrier, employee, and candidate touchpoints.
- Turn our people, customer work, leadership perspective, and company growth into useful content.
- Own the content calendar and coordinate writing, video, photography, design, and outside vendors as needed.
- Build a stronger presence for Koola and its leadership.

What We’re Looking For

- Experience owning **digital marketing campaigns with measurable lead generation results**.
- Strong working knowledge of website conversion, SEO, paid search, email marketing, CRM systems, and analytics.
- Specific examples of campaigns you ran, what you measured, what changed, and the business result.
- Experience working closely with a sales team and improving lead quality and follow-up.
- Comfort building the strategy **and** doing the work while the function is small.
- Strong writing and judgment. You can make complicated services easy for customers to understand.
- Ability to direct creative work and vendors, whether or not you personally produce every graphic or video.

B2B, logistics, transportation, recruiting, or another sales-driven industry experience is a plus.

- **When you apply, tell us about one campaign or marketing system you built. What was the goal, what did you personally own, how did you track it, and what business result did it produce?** Portfolios of graphics or social posts are welcome, but we’re most interested in the results behind the work.

We are a team of strategists, media experts, creatives, innovators and analysts. Over 100 Milers (our humans) strong with hybrid-offices in New York City and San Francisco.

For more information, go to www.milemarkeragency.com.

**Position Summary**

The Associate Director, Biddable is responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing paid advertising campaigns across various digital platforms like Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and other bidding-based networks (retail media networks such as Walmart Connect and Instacart), focusing on strategic planning, budget allocation, keyword research, ad creative optimization, and performance analysis to achieve client marketing goals, essentially managing all aspects of biddable media through Self-Serve platforms. This is a remote/hybrid role with Mile Marker headquartered in New York City.

**Key Responsibilities**

Campaign Strategy Development:

- Collaborating with clients to understand their target audience, marketing objectives, and budget constraints to create tailored biddable media strategies.
- Identifying relevant keywords, audience segments, and ad placements across platforms.
- Setting campaign goals, KPIs, and performance benchmarks.

Campaign Implementation:

- Building and managing paid search campaigns on platforms like Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.
- Creating and optimizing paid social campaigns on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and similar platforms.
- Developing and optimizing product centric campaigns on retail media networks such as Walmart Connect and Instacart.
- Setting bids, budgets, and campaign structures based on data analysis and performance insights.
- Developing compelling ad copy and creative assets.

Performance Optimization:

- Monitoring campaign performance metrics like impressions, clicks, conversions, cost-per-acquisition (CPA), and return on ad spend (ROAS).
- Analyzing data to identify areas for improvement and make necessary adjustments to bids, targeting, and ad creatives.
- Implementing A/B testing to test different ad variations and optimize performance.
- Implementing conversion Incrementality tests within platforms to demonstrate platform value and help determine the right channel mix

Reporting and Analysis:

- Generating comprehensive performance reports for clients, highlighting key insights and actionable recommendations.
- Staying updated on industry trends, platform updates, and new bidding strategies to maintain campaign effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

- 6-9 years overall experience
- 2+ years experience at a hands-on agency
- 3+ years managing & mentoring Biddable teams
- Deep understanding of Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, and other major biddable platforms. Experience in managing conversion-based campaigns across platforms is highly preferred.
- Ability to interpret complex data sets, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
- Capability to develop and implement effective campaign strategies aligned with client goals.
- Ability to manage and effectively communicate with a team of biddable media managers and associate while providing guidance on campaign execution and optimizations.
- Effectively communicating campaign performance and insights to clients and stakeholders.

We are seeking a visionary and commercially minded Vice President, Global Brand Marketing to lead the strategic evolution for Ellis Brooklyn. Brand Strategy & Stewardship

- Define and evolve the global brand positioning, messaging architecture, and long-term marketing strategy.

- Champion a luxury brand experience while maintaining relevance within contemporary beauty culture.

Product Marketing & Innovation

- With the CEO-Founder, lead the strategic development and commercialization of all product launches from concept through market introduction.

- Identify new opportunities for cultural relevance, partnerships, collaborations, and consumer engagement.

Consumer Insights & Market Intelligence

- Build a deep understanding of the luxury beauty consumer through qualitative and quantitative research.
- Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and emerging consumer behaviors.

- Present in company's quarterly board meetings to the board.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

# Digital Marketing Director (Morristown)

Location:Convent Station, NJCompany:NPG Health

## Description:

NPG Health, a family of healthcare marketing agencies including Pryme and NaviSync, is seeking a **Director of Omnichannel Strategy & Engagement** with 8–10+ years of experience in omnichannel strategy, digital marketing, or customer engagement, ideally within the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry. This senior, client-facing leader will translate brand objectives and audience insights into connected engagement strategies across HCP and patient audiences, channels, content, and experiences. The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership, digital fluency, and commercial acumen with the ability to turn data into measurable business and brand outcomes.

This role requires a strategic leader who can connect creative, media, technology, content, CRM, social, and analytics into cohesive customer engagement programs. The Director will use audience research, social listening, segmentation, journey mapping, and performance data to shape channel strategies, content ecosystems, influencer programs, and activation plans. Success requires the ability to define strategic direction, guide cross-functional execution, and continually optimize engagement based on audience behavior and business results.

In addition to providing hands-on strategic leadership, the Director of Omnichannel Strategy & Engagement will manage and mentor team members; serve as a trusted advisor to clients and senior stakeholders; and partner closely with brand, account, media, analytics, technology, content, and creative leaders.

**ResponsibilitiesDigital Strategy Development:** Own the end-to-end omnichannel strategy for assigned brands, translating business objectives, brand strategy, and audience needs into customer journeys, audience and segmentation strategies, channel roles, content sequencing, personalization opportunities, experience flows, and annual activation roadmaps across HCP and patient audiences.

**Media Strategy and Integration:** Guide the role of paid media within the broader omnichannel ecosystem, partnering with media leaders on audience strategy, channel mix, investment priorities, activation, testing, and optimization. Ensure media plans align with customer journeys, brand objectives, regulatory requirements, KPIs, and ROI expectations.

**Analytics and Tracking Management:** Lead the analytics and measurement function, working closely with the team on establishing measurement frameworks, KPI hierarchies, data and tagging requirements, dashboard strategies, testing plans, and reporting standards.

**Social Media and Community Management:** Set the strategic direction for organic social and community engagement, leveraging social listening and audience insights to inform content strategy, influencer partnerships, and ongoing brand conversations.

**Leadership and Team Development:**

- Lead, mentor, and develop digital team members (Media, Social, CRM, Analytics), providing strategic guidance, performance feedback, and career development support.
- Set clear expectations and ensure high quality, on time delivery across multiple workstreams.
- Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented team culture.

**Requirements and skills**

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Media, a related field, and/or equivalent work experience.
- Minimum of 8-10+ years of experience in digital marketing within the pharmaceutical sector.
- Proven experience leading digital strategy and managing team members or cross functional workstreams.
- Comfortability with presenting and workshopping with clients as well as internal teams.
- Proven ability to design connected omnichannel experiences using audience segmentation, journey mapping, channel orchestration, content sequencing, personalization, and clear conversion pathways.
- Strong working knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, content management, social listening, paid media, web analytics, data visualization, customer data, and personalization platforms; familiarity with AI-enabled marketing and next-best-action approaches is preferred.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines.
- Working knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical marketing regulations and industry standards, including medical-legal-regulatory review, fair balance, privacy and consent considerations, accessibility, and responsible use of customer and patient data.

NPG Health is an equal opportunity employer and strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, age, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

# Account Director, Paid Search – Ecommerce (Miami-Fort Lauderdale Area)

Location:USCompany:Mirasma

## Description:

Account Director, Paid Search – Ecommerce

Department: Paid Media / Client Strategy

Type: Full-Time, Miami Fl

Position Overview

The Account Director, Paid Search – Ecommerce will act as a strategic partner to Mirasma ecommerce clients, leading account direction, performance strategy, and growth initiatives across Google Ads.

This role sits above traditional account management and focuses on driving measurable business outcomes, not just campaign oversight. You will work closely with founders and marketing leaders to scale paid acquisition while maintaining efficiency and alignment with overall business goals.

The ideal candidate has experience in agency or consulting environments within the ecommerce paid search space and understands how to translate performance marketing into real business growth. You should be comfortable advising not only on media buying, but also on funnel performance, creative direction, and operational considerations that impact results.

Key Responsibilities

- Own the strategic direction of assigned client accounts
- Lead growth initiatives across Google Ads, including Search, YouTube, Shopping, and Performance Max
- Advise on scaling strategies while maintaining efficiency across CPA, MER, and contribution margin
- Identify opportunities across budgets, channels, creatives, and funnels to drive growth

Client Partnership

- Act as the primary strategic point of contact for clients
- Lead client calls, performance reviews, and strategic planning sessions
- Provide clear, data-backed recommendations and direction
- Build strong relationships with founders, operators, and marketing teams

Performance Oversight

- Work closely with media buyers to ensure execution aligns with strategy
- Interpret performance data and guide optimizations and priorities
- Identify risks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement across accounts
- Ensure campaigns scale effectively while maintaining strong fundamentals

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Collaborate with creative strategists and media buyers to align on testing and execution
- Provide input on creative direction, messaging, and testing frameworks
- Ensure internal teams remain aligned with client goals and strategy

Strategic Planning

- Develop growth roadmaps, testing plans, and scaling strategies
- Align budget allocation with performance goals and business objectives
- Continuously refine strategy based on data, testing outcomes, and market trends

Qualifications

- 4–7+ years of experience in performance marketing, account strategy, or client-facing roles
- Strong experience with Google Ads for ecommerce brands, including Search, YouTube, Shopping, and Performance Max
- Background in an agency, consulting, or performance-driven environment
- Proven ability to scale accounts while maintaining or improving efficiency
- Strong understanding of direct-response marketing and full-funnel strategy
- Ability to translate performance metrics into business insights and recommendations
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead strategic conversations
- Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple accounts in a fast-paced environment

Bonus Experience

- Experience working for or operating an in-house ecommerce brand
- Exposure to financial metrics such as MER, contribution margin, and forecasting
- Strong understanding of landing pages, funnels, and conversion optimization

What Success Looks Like

- Clients view you as a strategic partner, not just an account manager
- Accounts scale in spend and revenue while maintaining efficiency
- Clear, confident communication that drives alignment and trust
- Strong collaboration across strategy, media buying, and creative
- Proactive identification of opportunities that lead to measurable growth

Compensation: $120,000–$140,000 annually

Final compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.

Benefits: Full-time W-2 employees are eligible for company-sponsored medical coverage, with Mirasma covering 100% of the employee-only premium. Dental and vision coverage are also available, along with employer-paid basic life and long-term disability insurance. Benefits begin after a 60-day waiting period and are administered through ADP TotalSource.

# Director of Digital Marketing Growth & Customer Acquisition (Melville)

Location:Melville, NYCompany:Big Think Capital

## Description:

**About the Company**

Big Think Capital is a fast-growing financial services company dedicated to helping businesses access the capital they need to grow. We’re looking for a data-driven, creative, and results-oriented marketing leader to own our digital growth and customer acquisition strategy.

**About the Role**

The Director of Digital Marketing Growth & Customer Acquisition will lead all paid and organic digital marketing efforts for Big Think Capital, driving brand awareness and new customer acquisition. This role owns the strategy, execution, and optimization of digital advertising, email marketing, SEM, and social media campaigns — with a strong emphasis on measurable, ROI-driven results in a financial services context. This is a hands-on leadership role for a self-starter who thrives on turning data into action, testing creative approaches, and solving problems in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

**Responsibilities**

- Develop and execute the overall digital marketing and customer acquisition strategy for Big Think Capital, aligned with company growth goals
- Plan, launch, and manage paid advertising campaigns (running ads directly for Big Think Capital) across search, social, and display channels
- Own search engine marketing (SEM) strategy, including keyword strategy, bid management, and budget optimization
- Lead social media marketing efforts to build brand awareness and engage target audiences
- Design, execute, and optimize email marketing campaigns and nurture sequences to drive engagement and conversion
- Build and monitor performance dashboards; use data and analytics to continuously test, measure, and improve campaign performance
- Set clear, measurable goals (CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, pipeline growth) and report regularly on performance against targets
- Identify and test new channels, creative approaches, and audience segments to drive efficient customer acquisition
- Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, creative, and leadership teams to ensure marketing efforts support broader business objectives
- Manage marketing budget allocation across channels to maximize return on investment
- Stay current on financial services marketing trends, compliance considerations, and competitive landscape

**Qualifications**

- Minimum 3 years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong preference for candidates with financial services / fintech digital marketing experience
- Proven track record running paid advertising campaigns with measurable results
- Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms and campaign management
- Strong working knowledge of search engine marketing (SEM/PPC) and social media advertising
- Demonstrated ability to build brand awareness while driving new customer acquisition
- Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills — comfortable working with performance metrics, dashboards, and reporting tools
- Creative problem-solver who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution
- Excellent communication and project management skills
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience)

**Required Skills**

Someone who is equal parts strategist and doer — a goals-oriented professional who can dig into the data, spot opportunities, and bring creative ideas to life across ads, email, search, and social. You should be comfortable owning outcomes, not just executing tactics.
